/* ===== lib/base.ui.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_screenutil/flutter_screenutil.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/palette.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/widget_extensions.dart';
import 'package:loading_animation_widget/loading_animation_widget.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import 'base.vm.dart';

class BaseView<T extends BaseViewModel> extends StatefulWidget {
  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, T model, Widget? child)? builder;
  final Function(T)? onModelReady;
  const BaseView({Key? key, this.builder, this.onModelReady}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _BaseViewState<T> createState() => _BaseViewState<T>();
}

class _BaseViewState<T extends BaseViewModel> extends State<BaseView<T>> {
  T model = getIt<T>();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.onModelReady != null) {
      widget.onModelReady!(model);
    }
  }

  // @override
  // void dispose() {
  //   super.dispose();
  // }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ChangeNotifierProvider<T>(
      create: (_) => model,
      child: Consumer<T>(
        builder: (_, model, __) => Stack(
          children: [
            widget.builder!.call(_, model, __),
            if (model.isLoading)
              Stack(children: [
                SizedBox(
                  height: height(context),
                  child: ModalBarrier(
                    color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.7),
                    dismissible: false,
                  ),
                ),
                Center(
                  child: LoadingAnimationWidget.threeArchedCircle(
                    color: primaryColor,
                    size: 50,
                  ),
                )
              ])
            else
              const SizedBox(),
            if (model.hasError)
              Scaffold(
                backgroundColor: Colors.black12.withOpacity(.9),
                body: Stack(children: [
                  ModalBarrier(
                    // color: Colors.black12.withOpacity(.9),
                    dismissible: false,
                  ),
                  Center(
                      child: Column(
                    children: [
                      const Spacer(),
                      Align(
                        alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                        child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 24),
                            child: GestureDetector(
                              onTap: () => model.clearError(),
                              child: const Icon(
                                Icons.close,
                                color: AppColors.white,
                              ),
                            )),
                      ),
                      50.sbH,
                      Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12.w),
                        child: Text(
                          model.errorMessage!,
                          style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 18.sp),
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          maxLines: 10,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (model.retryFunction != null) GestureDetector(onTap: () => model.retryFunction!(), child: const Icon(Icons.refresh)),
                      const Spacer(),
                    ],
                  ))
                ]),
              )
            else
              const SizedBox(),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/base.vm.dart ===== */
import 'dart:core';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/app-cache.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/storage-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/user.service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/web-services/app-api-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/debounce.dart';

import '../core/enum/viewState.enum.dart';
import '../core/services/navigation_service.dart';

class BaseViewModel extends ChangeNotifier {
  final debouncer = Debouncer();
  ViewState _viewState = ViewState.idle;
  NavigationService navigationService = getIt<NavigationService>();
  UserService userService = getIt<UserService>();
  final appApi = getIt<AppApiService>();
  final cache = getIt<AppCache>();

  StorageService storageService = getIt<StorageService>();
  AppCache appCache = getIt<AppCache>();

  ViewState get viewState => _viewState;

  set viewState(ViewState newState) {
    if (newState == ViewState.busy) {
      hasError = false;
    }
    _viewState = newState;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  bool isLoading = false;
  bool loader = false;

  bool hasError = false;
  Function? retryFunction;
  String? errorMessage;

  void showError(Function function, {String? msg}) {
    if (!hasError) {
      hasError = true;
      retryFunction = function;
      errorMessage = msg ?? "Request Failed, Try again";
      notifyListeners();
      stopLoader();
    }
  }

  clearError() {
    hasError = false;
    errorMessage = null;
    // if (retryFunction != null) closeFunction!();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void iLoad() {
    if (!loader) {
      hasError = false;
      loader = true;
      viewState = ViewState.busy;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void sLoad() {
    if (loader) {
      loader = false;
      viewState = ViewState.idle;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void startLoader() {
    if (!isLoading) {
      hasError = false;
      isLoading = true;
      viewState = ViewState.busy;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void stopLoader() {
    if (isLoading) {
      isLoading = false;
      viewState = ViewState.idle;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  dropKeyboard() {
    FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.unfocus();
  }
}

extension AutoNotifyExtension on ChangeNotifier {
  void update<T>(T value, T Function(T) setter) {
    setter(value);
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

mixin AutoNotifyMixin on ChangeNotifier {
  void updateV(void Function() action) {
    action();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void updateProperty<T>(T value, void Function(T) setter) {
    setter(value);
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

String? getActivities(String? code) {
  switch (code) {
    case "B2-4":
      return "/SubComponents/CreateOrUploadDistributionActivity";
    case "B1-1":
      return "";
    case "B2-5":
      return "";
    case "B1-2":
      return "";
    case "B2-3":
      return "";
    case "B1-4":
      return "";
    case "B1-3":
      return "";
    case "C1-0":
      return "";
    case "C2-1":
      return "";
    case "C2-4":
      return "";
    case "C2-2":
      return "";
    case "A2-2":
      return "SubComponents/GetCivilWorksActivities";
    case "A3-0":
      return "SubComponents/GetSpecialEcosSystemActivities";
    case "A2-1":
      return "SubComponents/GetAfforestationActivities";
    case "A1-0":
      return "Geography/GetWaterSheds";
    case "A2-3":
      return "";
    case "":
      return null;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// Code names:
// B2-4: B2 - Community Investments (Inputs/Assets Distribution)
// B1-1: B1 - Community Strengthening
// B2-5: B2 - Community Investments (Landscape Restoration)
// B1-2: B1 - Community Strengthening (Capacity Building)
// B2-3: B2 - Community Investments (Farmer-Led Irrigation Development - FLID)
// B1-4: B1 - Community Strengthening (Peace Building & Social Cohesion)
// B1-3: B1 - Community Strengthening (Micro Watershed Plans)
// C1-0: C1 - Institutional Policy Strengthening
// C2-1: C2 - State Staging
// C2-4: C2 - Monitoring and Evaluation
// C2-2: C2 - Financial Management
// A2-2: A2 - Landscape Investments (Civil Works)
// A3-0: A3 - Special Ecosystems (Nature of Intervention)

import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/enum/activity-fields.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/components-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/save-activity-utils.dart';

final iActivityService = ChangeNotifierProvider<ActivityController>((ref) {
  return ActivityController();
});

class ActivityController extends ChangeNotifier {
  refresh() {
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _activity = {};

  Map<String, dynamic> get activity => _activity;

  ///initialize the activity with data
  init({String? component, ISubComponents? subComponent, Map<String, dynamic>? map}) async {
    try {
      if (map != null) {
        _activity = map;
      } else {
        _activity = {
          'projectId': SaveActivityUtils.generateProjectId(),
          'creditId': SaveActivityUtils.generateCreditId(),
          'component': component,
          'subComponent': subComponent?.toJson(),
        };
      }
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error initializing controller:${e.toString()}');
    }
  }

  clear() {
    _activity = {};
  }

  addValue(String key, dynamic f, {bool isFile = false}) {
    // print('[addValue] [$key] [${f.runtimeType} $f]');
    if (isFile) {
      _activity[key] = (f as File).path;
    } else {
      _activity[key] = f;
    }

    // printWrapped("activity data:::\n[${_activity.toString()}]");
    notifyListeners();
  }

  // Getter to check if all required fields are filled
  bool get isFormValid {
    // Basic Information section fields
    final bool isBasicInfoValid = isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.description.key]) &&
        isNotNull(activity[AfEnum.expectedStartDate.key]) &&
        isNotNull(activity[AfEnum.actualStartDate.key]) &&
        isNotNull(activity[AfEnum.expectedEndDate.key]) &&
        isNotNull(activity[AfEnum.actualEndDate.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.budgetAmountUsd.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.amountDisbursedUsd.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.rateOfNgnToUsd.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.budgetAmountNgn.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.amountDisbursedNgn.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.status.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.componentCode.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.fid.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.uniqueId.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.financialBudgetedAmountNgn.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.financialAmountDisbursedUsd.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.hectaresRestored.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.plannedAreaOfIntervention.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.actualSizeOfIntervention.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.noOfTreesPlanted.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.totalAreaRestored.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.species.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.treesPlantedCoordinates.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.spacing.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.budgetedAmount]);

    // Watershed Information section fields
    final bool isWatershedInfoValid =
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.nameOfMacroWatershed.key]) && isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.populationOfWatershed.key]) && isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.percentageProgress.key]);

    // Optional file uploads - we might not want to make these required
    // If they are required, uncomment these lines:
    // final bool areFilesUploaded =
    //   _isNotNull(activity['termsOfReference']) &&
    //   _isNotNull(activity[AfEnum.delineatedFile.key]);

    // For now assuming files are optional
    return isBasicInfoValid && isWatershedInfoValid;
  }

  // You could create more granular getters for each section
  bool get isBasicInformationValid {
    return isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.description.key]) &&
        isNotNull(activity[AfEnum.expectedStartDate.key]) &&
        isNotNull(activity[AfEnum.actualStartDate.key]) &&
        isNotNull(activity[AfEnum.expectedEndDate.key]) &&
        isNotNull(activity[AfEnum.actualEndDate.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.budgetAmountUsd.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.amountDisbursedUsd.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.rateOfNgnToUsd.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.budgetAmountNgn.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.amountDisbursedNgn.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.status.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.componentCode.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.fid.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.uniqueId.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.financialBudgetedAmountNgn.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.financialAmountDisbursedUsd.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.hectaresRestored.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.plannedAreaOfIntervention.key]) &&
        isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.actualSizeOfIntervention.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.noOfTreesPlanted.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.totalAreaRestored.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.species.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.treesPlantedCoordinates.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.spacing.key]) &&
        isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.budgetedAmount.key]);
  }

  bool get isWatershedInformationValid {
    return isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.nameOfMacroWatershed.key]) && isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.populationOfWatershed.key]) && isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.percentageProgress.key]);
  }

  // Individual field validation getters for more specific error messages
  bool get isDescriptionValid => isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.description.key]);
  bool get isExpectedStartDateValid => isValidDate(activity[AfEnum.expectedStartDate.key]);
  bool get isActualStartDateValid => isValidDate(activity[AfEnum.actualStartDate.key]);
  bool get isExpectedEndDateValid => isValidDate(activity[AfEnum.expectedEndDate.key]);
  bool get isActualEndDateValid => isValidDate(activity[AfEnum.actualEndDate.key]);
  bool get isBudgetAmountUsdValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.budgetAmountUsd.key]);
  bool get isAmountDisbursedUsdValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.amountDisbursedUsd.key]);
  bool get isRateOfNgnToUsdValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.rateOfNgnToUsd.key]);
  bool get isBudgetAmountNgnValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.budgetAmountNgn.key]);
  bool get isAmountDisbursedNgnValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.amountDisbursedNgn.key]);
  bool get isStatusValid => isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.status.key]);
  bool get isNameOfMacroWatershedValid => isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.nameOfMacroWatershed.key]);
  bool get isPopulationOfWatershedValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.populationOfWatershed.key]);
  bool get isPercentageProgressValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.percentageProgress.key]);
  bool get isComponentCodeValid => isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.componentCode.key]);

  bool get isFidValid => isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.fid.key]);
  bool get isUniqueIdValid => isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.uniqueId.key]);
  bool get isFinancialBudgetedAmountValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.financialBudgetedAmountNgn.key]);
  bool get isFinancialAmountDisbursedUsdValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.financialAmountDisbursedUsd.key]);
  bool get isHectaresRestoredValid => isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.hectaresRestored.key]);
  bool get isPlannedAreaOfInterventionValid => isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.plannedAreaOfIntervention.key]);
  bool get isActualSizeOfInterventionValid => isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.actualSizeOfIntervention.key]);
  bool get isNoOfTreesPlantedValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.noOfTreesPlanted.key]);
  bool get isTotalAreaRestoredValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.totalAreaRestored.key]);
  bool get isSpeciesValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.species.key]);
  bool get isTreesPlantedCoordinatesValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.treesPlantedCoordinates.key]);
  bool get isSpacingValid => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.spacing.key]);
  bool get budgetedAmount => isValidNumber(activity[AfEnum.budgetedAmount]);
}

///Helper Methods
bool isNotEmptyString(dynamic value) {
  if (value == null) return false;
  if (value is String) return value.trim().isNotEmpty;
  return value.toString().trim().isNotEmpty;
}

bool isNotNull(dynamic value) {
  return value != null;
}

// You could also add more specific validation methods if needed
bool isValidNumber(dynamic value) {
  if (!isNotEmptyString(value)) return false;
  try {
    final num parsed = num.parse(value.toString());
    return parsed >= 0; // Assuming values should be non-negative
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}

bool isValidDate(dynamic value) {
  return value is DateTime;
}

import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

final iAfforestationActivityService = ChangeNotifierProvider<AfforestationActivityController>((ref) {
  return AfforestationActivityController();
});

class AfforestationActivityController extends ChangeNotifier {
  Map<String, dynamic> _activity = {};

  Map<String, dynamic> get activity => _activity;

  /// Initialize with existing map or create fresh default structure
  ///initialize the activity with data
  init({String? component, ISubComponents? subComponent, Map<String, dynamic>? map}) async {
    try {
      if (map != null) {
        _activity = map;
      } else {
        _activity = {
          'projectId': SaveActivityUtils.generateProjectId(),
          'creditId': SaveActivityUtils.generateCreditId(),
          'component': component,
          'subComponent': subComponent?.toJson(),
          AfEnum.componentCode.key.toString(): subComponent?.code,
          AfEnum.status.key.toString(): "Commenced"
        };
      }
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error initializing controller:${e.toString()}');
    }
  }

  void clear() {
    _activity = {};
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void addValue(String key, dynamic value, {bool isFile = false}) {
    _activity[key] = isFile && value is File ? value.path : value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  // bool get isFormValid {
  //   return
  //       isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.strategicCatchment.key] ) &&
  //           isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.microCatchment.key] ) &&
  //           isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.state.key] ) &&
  //           isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.localGovernmentArea.key] ) &&
  //           isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.site.key] ) &&
  //           isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.implementer.key] ) &&
  //           isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.natureOfIntervention.key] ) &&
  //           isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.interventionCategory.key] ) &&
  //           isNotEmptyString(activity[AfEnum.noOfTreesPlanted.key]);
  // }

  bool get isFormValid {
    final missingFields = <String>[];

    bool isValid = _checkField(AfEnum.strategicCatchment.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(AfEnum.microCatchment.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(AfEnum.state.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(AfEnum.localGovernmentArea.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(AfEnum.site.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(AfEnum.implementer.key, missingFields) &&
        // _checkField(AfEnum.natureOfIntervention.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(AfEnum.interventionCategory.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(AfEnum.noOfTreesPlanted.key, missingFields);

    if (!isValid) {
      print("❌ Form is invalid. Missing fields: $missingFields");
    }
    return isValid;
  }

  bool _checkField(String key, List<String> missing) {
    final value = activity[key];
    final isValid = value != null && value.toString().trim().isNotEmpty;
    if (!isValid) missing.add(key);
    return isValid;
  }
}

/// Helper functions
bool isNotEmptyString(dynamic value) {
  if (value == null) return false;
  return value.toString().trim().isNotEmpty;
}

bool isNotNull(dynamic value) => value != null;

bool isValidNumber(dynamic value) {
  if (!isNotEmptyString(value)) return false;
  try {
    final num parsed = num.parse(value.toString());
    return parsed >= 0;
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}

    Cig? cig;
    if (data != null) {
      cig = data['cig'];

      try {
        print('found state');
        _beneficiary = {
          BeneficiaryEnum.state.key: findByField<StatesResponse, String>(
            cache.states,
            (s) => s.oid ?? "",
            data['oid'] ?? "",
          )?.toJson(),
          BeneficiaryEnum.localGovernment.key: findByField<LgaResponse, String>(
            cache.lga,
            (s) => s.oid ?? "",
            cig?.localGovernmentOid ?? "",
          )?.toJson(),
          BeneficiaryEnum.communityInterestGroup.key: cig?.toJson(),
          BeneficiaryEnum.community.key: findByField<Community, String>(
            cache.communities,
            (s) => s.oid ?? "",
            cig?.communityOid ?? "",
          )?.toJson(),
        };
        print('this is the comm');
        print(beneficiary[BeneficiaryEnum.community.key]);
        print(beneficiary[BeneficiaryEnum.state.key]);
        print(beneficiary[BeneficiaryEnum.localGovernment.key]);
        print(beneficiary[BeneficiaryEnum.communityInterestGroup.key]);

        print('Error initializing controller:${e.toString()}');
      }

    }
  }

    try {
      print('found state');
      _beneficiary = {
        BeneficiaryEnum.state.key: data,
      };

///Helper Methods
bool isNotEmptyString(dynamic value) {
  if (value == null) return false;
  if (value is String) return value.trim().isNotEmpty;
  return value.toString().trim().isNotEmpty;
}

bool isNotNull(dynamic value) {
  try {
    return value != null;
  } catch (e, s) {
    print(s.toString());
    return false;
  }
}

// You could also add more specific validation methods if needed
bool isValidNumber(dynamic value) {
  if (!isNotEmptyString(value)) return false;
  try {
    final num parsed = num.parse(value.toString());
    return parsed >= 0; // Assuming values should be non-negative
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}

bool isValidDate(dynamic value) {
  return value is DateTime;
}

/// Controller to manage Inputs/Assets Distribution activity form state
class DistributionActivityController extends ChangeNotifier {
  Map<String, dynamic> _activity = {};

  Map<String, dynamic> get activity => _activity;

  bool get hasState => _activity[InputAssetDistributionEnum.state.key]?['name'] != null;
  bool get hasInputAssetCategory => _activity[InputAssetDistributionEnum.inputAssetCategory.key]?['name'] != null;
  bool get hasInputAssetType => _activity[InputAssetDistributionEnum.inputAssetType.key]?['name'] != null;

  /// Initialize with existing map or create fresh default structure
  Future<void> init({String? component, ISubComponents? subComponent, Map<String, dynamic>? map}) async {
    try {
      if (map != null) {
        _activity = map;
      } else {
        _activity = {
          'projectId': SaveActivityUtils.generateProjectId(),
          'creditId': SaveActivityUtils.generateCreditId(),
          'component': component,
          'subComponent': subComponent?.toJson(),
          InputAssetDistributionEnum.componentCode.key.toString(): subComponent?.code,
          InputAssetDistributionEnum.status.key.toString(): 'Commenced',
          'createdBy': uService.userCredentialsNotifier.value.userName,
          'createdOn': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          'deviceName': await analytics.deviceName(),
          'deviceIpAddress': "0.0.0.0",
          'deviceUserName': await analytics.deviceName(),
          'latitude': cache.position?.latitude ?? 0,
          'longitude': cache.position?.longitude ?? 0,
        };
      }
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error initializing DistributionActivityController: ${e.toString()}');
    }
  }

  void clear() {
    _activity = {};
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void addValue(String key, dynamic value, {bool isFile = false}) {
    _activity[key] = isFile && value is File ? value.path : value;
    notifyListeners();
    printWrapped(buildPayload().toString());
  }

  /// Form validation based on fields used in CreateInputsAssetsDistributionPage
  bool get isFormValid {
    final missingFields = <String>[];

    bool isValid = _checkField(InputAssetDistributionEnum.state.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(InputAssetDistributionEnum.toR1.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(InputAssetDistributionEnum.interventionCategory.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(InputAssetDistributionEnum.natureOfIntervention.key, missingFields) &&
        _checkField(InputAssetDistributionEnum.actualStartDate.key, missingFields);

    if (!isValid) {
      print(' Distribution form invalid. Missing: $missingFields');
    }
    return isValid;
  }

  bool _checkField(String key, List<String> missing) {
    final value = activity[key];
    final valid = value != null && value.toString().trim().isNotEmpty;
    if (!valid) missing.add(key);
    return valid;
  }

  /// Build API payload from the internal activity map
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> buildPayload() async {
    final a = activity;

    String? _oidOf(dynamic obj) => (obj is Map) ? obj['oid'] as String? : null;

    return {
      // Location & hierarchy
      'communityOid': _oidOf(a['site']),
      'stateOid': _oidOf(a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.state.key]),
      'localGovernmentOid': _oidOf(a['localGovernmentArea']),

      // Categories & types
      'inputAssetCategoryOid': _oidOf(a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.inputAssetCategory.key]),
      'inputAssetTypeOid': _oidOf(a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.inputAssetType.key]),
      'interventionCategoryOid': _oidOf(a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.interventionCategory.key]),
      'interventionTypeOid': _oidOf(a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.natureOfIntervention.key]),

      // Activity codes & quantities
      'componentCode': a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.componentCode.key],
      'quantity': a['quantity'] ?? 0,
      'unitCost': a['unitCost'] ?? 0,
      'totalCost': a['total'] ?? 0,
      'totalHectarage': a['totalHectarage'] ?? 0,
      'uniqueID': a['uniqueID'] ?? SaveActivityUtils.generateCreditId(),

      // Beneficiaries
      'beneficiaries': a['selectedBeneficiaries'] ?? [],

      // Indicators (PDO/CLI) if present
      'indicators': a['indicators'] ?? a[AfEnum.pdo.key] ?? a[AfEnum.cli.key] ?? [],

      // Photos
      // 'photo': a['photo'],

      // Dates
      'startDate': (a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.actualStartDate.key] is DateTime)
          ? (a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.actualStartDate.key] as DateTime).toIso8601String()
          : a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.actualStartDate.key],
      'endDate': (a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.actualEndDate.key] is DateTime)
          ? (a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.actualEndDate.key] as DateTime).toIso8601String()
          : a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.actualEndDate.key],

      // Component & subcomponent
      'componentOid': _oidOf(a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.component.key]) ?? a['componentOid'],
      'subComponentOid': _oidOf(a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.subComponent.key]) ?? a['subComponentOid'],
      'torOid': _oidOf(a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.toR1.key]),

      // IDs and meta
      'creditID': a['creditId'],
      'projectID': a['projectId'],
      'description': a['description'],
      'implementerOid': _oidOf(a['implementer']),
      'status': a[InputAssetDistributionEnum.status.key] == 'Commenced' ? 1 : 0,

      // "photo": "string",
      //   "endDate": "2025-12-12T04:32:34.746Z",
      //   "startDate": "2025-12-12T04:32:34.746Z",
      //   "componentOid": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
      //   "creditID": "string",
      //   "description": "string",
      //   "implementerOid": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
      //   "projectID": "string",

      //   "subComponentOid": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
      //   "torOid": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
      // Device meta placeholders (optional)
      'createdBy': uService.userCredentialsNotifier.value.userName,
      'createdOn': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
      'deviceName': await analytics.deviceName(),
      'deviceIpAddress': "0.0.0.0",
      'deviceUserName': await analytics.deviceName(),
      'latitude': cache.position?.latitude ?? 0,
      'longitude': cache.position?.longitude ?? 0,
    };
  }
}

  return value.toString().trim().isNotEmpty;

extension IdTypeExtension on String {
  IdTypeEnum toIdType() {
    switch (toLowerCase()) {
      case "nin":
        return IdTypeEnum.nin;
      case "international passport":
        return IdTypeEnum.internationalPassport;
      case "driver license":
        return IdTypeEnum.driversLicense;
      default:
        return IdTypeEnum.none;
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/app-cache.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/activity-response.dart';

class ActivityServiceClass {
  List<ActivityResponse> _activities = [];
  final StreamController<List<ActivityResponse>> _activityListController = StreamController<List<ActivityResponse>>.broadcast();

  // Expose the stream for listeners
  Stream<List<ActivityResponse>> get activityListStream => _activityListController.stream;

  // Constructor - initialize with empty list
  ActivityService() {
    _activityListController.add(_activities);
  }

  // Get current activities synchronously
  List<ActivityResponse> get currentActivities => _activities;

  // Update the entire list
  void updateActivityList(List<ActivityResponse> activities) {
    _activityListController.add(activities);
    _activities = List.from(activities);

    _notifyListeners();
  }

  // Clear all activities
  void clearActivities() {
    _activities.clear();
    _notifyListeners();
  }

  // Helper method to notify all listeners of changes
  void _notifyListeners() {
    if (!_activityListController.isClosed) {
      _activityListController.add(_activities);
    }
  }

  // Dispose resources
  void dispose() {
    _activityListController.close();
  }
}

class ActivityListWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget Function(BuildContext, List<ActivityResponse>) builder;
  final Widget? loadingWidget;
  final Widget? emptyWidget;
  final Widget Function(BuildContext, Object)? errorWidget;

  const ActivityListWidget({
    Key? key,
    required this.builder,
    this.loadingWidget,
    this.emptyWidget,
    this.errorWidget,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return StreamBuilder<List<ActivityResponse>>(
      stream: getIt<AppCache>().activityListStream,
      initialData: getIt<AppCache>().activityList, // Use current list as initial data
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        // Handle error state
        if (snapshot.hasError) {
          return errorWidget != null ? errorWidget!(context, snapshot.error!) : Center(child: Text('Error: ${snapshot.error}'));
        }

        // Get the activity list (empty list if null)
        final activityList = snapshot.data ?? [];

        // Handle empty state
        if (activityList.isEmpty) {
          return emptyWidget ?? const Center(child: Text('No activities available'));
        }

        // Build the list using the provided builder
        return builder(context, activityList);
      },
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/core/services/activity-service.dart ===== */
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/request/create-activity-model.dart';
import 'package:hive_flutter/adapters.dart';

final activityService = getIt<ActivityService>();

class ActivityService {
  static const String _boxName = "activity_box";
  static const String _authBoxName = 'auth_box';
  static const String _listKey = "activity_list";
  static const String _emailKey = 'email';
  static const String _activityListKey = 'activityList';
  static const String _passwordKey = 'password';
  static const String _tokenKey = 'token';

  late final Box _activityCacheBox;
  late final Box _authBox;

  Future<void> initAuthBox() async {
    _authBox = await Hive.openBox(_authBoxName);
  }

  final StreamController<List<IActivity>> _listController = StreamController<List<IActivity>>.broadcast();

  Stream<List<IActivity>> get itemStream => _listController.stream;

  ActivityService() {
    _init();
  }

  Future<void> _init() async {
    _activityCacheBox = await Hive.openBox(_boxName);
    print('_authBox:::');

    if (!_activityCacheBox.containsKey(_listKey)) {
      await _activityCacheBox.put(_listKey, []);
    }
    refreshItems();
  }

  List<IActivity> getItems() {
    final data = _activityCacheBox.get(_listKey);
    return (data as List).cast<IActivity>();
  }

  Future<void> addItem(String title, String details) async {
    final items = getItems();
    final newItem = IActivity(
      id: DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
      title: title,
      details: details,
    );
    items.add(newItem);
    await _saveItems(items);
  }

  Future<void> updateStatusToUploaded(String notificationId) async {
    final items = getItems();
    final index = items.indexWhere((n) => n.id == notificationId);
    if (index != -1) {
      items[index].status = UploadStatus.uploaded;
      await _saveItems(items);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveItems(List<IActivity> items) async {
    await _activityCacheBox.put(_listKey, items);
    _listController.add(items.toList());
  }

  Future<void> refreshItems() async {
    _listController.add(getItems().toList());
  }

  /// Save user authentication data
  Future<void> saveAuthData({required String email, required String password, required String token}) async {
    await _authBox.put(_emailKey, email);
    await _authBox.put(_passwordKey, password);
    await _authBox.put(_tokenKey, token);
    print("$email $password $token");
  }

  /// Save only token (useful for token refresh)
  Future<void> saveToken(String token) async {
    await _authBox.put(_tokenKey, token);
  }

  /// Get stored email
  String? getEmail() {
    return _authBox.get(_emailKey);
  }

  /// Get stored password
  String? getPassword() {
    return _authBox.get(_passwordKey);
  }

  /// Get stored token
  String? getToken() {
    return _authBox.get(_tokenKey);
  }

  /// Check if user is authenticated (has a token)
  bool isAuthenticated() {
    return _authBox.get(_tokenKey) != null;
  }

  Future<void> saveActivity(Map<String, dynamic> activity) async {
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> activities = getAllActivities();
    activities.add(activity);
    await _authBox.put(_activityListKey, activities);
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> getAllActivities() {
    final data = _authBox.get(_activityListKey);
    if (data == null) {
      return [];
    }

    // Safely convert each item to Map<String, dynamic>
    return (data as List).map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList();
  }

  // Update a single map in the list by its ID (or any unique identifier)
  Future<bool> updateActivity(String activityId, Map<String, dynamic> updatedActivity) async {
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> activities = getAllActivities();

    // Find the index of the activity with the matching ID
    int index = activities.indexWhere((activity) => activity['id'] == activityId);

    if (index != -1) {
      // Update the activity at the found index
      activities[index] = updatedActivity;
      await _authBox.put(_activityListKey, activities);
      return true;
    }

    return false; // Activity not found
  }

  // Delete an activity from the list
  Future<bool> deleteActivity(String activityId) async {
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> activities = getAllActivities();
    int originalLength = activities.length;

    activities.removeWhere((activity) => activity['id'] == activityId);

    if (activities.length < originalLength) {
      await _authBox.put(_activityListKey, activities);
      return true;
    }

    return false; // Activity not found
  }

  Future<void> clearAuthData() async {
    await _authBox.delete(_emailKey);
    await _authBox.delete(_passwordKey);
    await _authBox.delete(_tokenKey);
  }

  Future<void> closeAuthBox() async {
    if (_authBox.isOpen) {
      await _authBox.close();
    }
  }

  void dispose() {
    _listController.close();
    _authBox.close();
  }
}

/* ===== lib/core/services/analytics-services.dart ===== */
// import 'package:firebase_analytics/firebase_analytics.dart';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:device_info_plus/device_info_plus.dart';
import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:package_info_plus/package_info_plus.dart';

final analytics = getIt<AnalyticsService>();

class AnalyticsService {
  // final FirebaseAnalytics _analytics = FirebaseAnalytics.instance;
  late PackageInfo packageInfo;
  DeviceInfoPlugin deviceInfoPlugin = DeviceInfoPlugin();
  Future<AndroidDeviceInfo> getAndroidInfo() async {
    return await deviceInfoPlugin.androidInfo;
  }

  Future<IosDeviceInfo> getIOSInfo() async {
    return await deviceInfoPlugin.iosInfo;
  }

  Future<String> deviceName() async {
    try {
      AndroidDeviceInfo? android;
      IosDeviceInfo? ios;
      if (Platform.isIOS) {
        ios = await getIOSInfo();
      } else {
        android = await getAndroidInfo();
      }

      String androidName = "${android?.id} | ${android?.type}| ${android?.model}";
      String iosName = "${ios?.name} | ${ios?.model} | ${ios?.identifierForVendor}";
      return Platform.isIOS ? iosName : androidName;
    } catch (e) {
      return "";
    }
  }

  initPackageInfo() async {
    try {
      packageInfo = await PackageInfo.fromPlatform();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint(e.toString());
    }
  }

  // FirebaseAnalyticsObserver getAnalyticsObserver() => FirebaseAnalyticsObserver(analytics: _analytics);
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/storage-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';

class AppSettingsService {
  AppSettingsService() {
    readAppSettings();
  }

  DateTime? lastConnectTime;
  DateTime? lastDisconnectionTime;

  final storage = getIt<StorageService>();

  readAppSettings() async {
    debugPrint("readAppSettings");
    String? s1 = await storage.readItem(key: "");
    String? s2 = await storage.readItem(key: "");

    print("readAppSettings::${s1}");
    print("readAppSettings::${s2}");

    (s1 == null || s1 == "false") ? settingsOption1 = ValueNotifier(false) : settingsOption1 = ValueNotifier(true);

    (s2 == null || s2 == "false") ? settingsOption2 = ValueNotifier(false) : settingsOption2 = ValueNotifier(true);
  }

  toggleSingleMealsAU(bool show) async {
    storage.storeItem(key: '', value: show.toString());
    settingsOption1.value = show;
  }

  toggleBulkMealsAU(bool show) async {
    storage.storeItem(key: '', value: show.toString());
    settingsOption2.value = show;
  }

  toggleSavingsWalletVisibility(bool show) async {
    storage.storeItem(key: "", value: show.toString());
    settingsOption3.value = show;
  }

  late ValueNotifier<bool> settingsOption1;
  late ValueNotifier<bool> settingsOption2;
  late ValueNotifier<bool> settingsOption3;
}

/* ===== lib/core/services/db-service.dart ===== */
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/storage-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

enum UploadStatus {
  pending('Pending', Colors.orange),
  uploaded('Uploaded', Colors.green);

  final String label;
  final Color color;

  const UploadStatus(this.label, this.color);

  /// Getter: get enum from label (case-insensitive)
  static UploadStatus? fromLabel(String label) {
    return UploadStatus.values.firstWhere(
      (e) => e.label.toLowerCase() == label.toLowerCase(),
      orElse: () => UploadStatus.pending,
    );
  }
}

class DraftActivity {
  final String id;
  final String title;
  Map<String, dynamic>? details;
  final DateTime date;
  String? type;
  final UploadStatus status;

  String? get component => details?['component'];
  String? get subC => (details != null && details?['subComponent'] != null) ? (details?['subComponent'] ?? "")['name'] : "n/a";

  DraftActivity({
    String? id,
    required this.title,
    required this.details,
    DateTime? date,
    this.type = 'Afforestation',
    this.status = UploadStatus.pending,
  })  : id = id ?? const Uuid().v4(),
        date = date ?? DateTime.now();

  /// Convert to JSON
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'title': title,
        'details': details,
        'date': date.toIso8601String(),
        'type': type,
        'status': status.name, // serialize as enum name
      };

  /// Create from JSON
  factory DraftActivity.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return DraftActivity(
      id: json['id'],
      title: json['title'],
      details: json['details'] != null ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(json['details']) : null,
      date: DateTime.parse(json['date']),
      type: json['type'],
      status: UploadStatus.values.byName(json['status']),
    );
  }
}

/// Service to manage a list of INotification objects.
///
final dbService = NotificationService();

class NotificationService {
  final StorageService _storageService = getIt<StorageService>();
  final String _listKey = "activity_list";

  // Broadcast stream to notify listeners when the list changes.
  final StreamController<List<DraftActivity>> _listController = StreamController<List<DraftActivity>>.broadcast();

  Stream<List<DraftActivity>> get itemStream => _listController.stream;

  NotificationService() {
    // Immediately refresh the items when the service is instantiated.
    refreshItems();
  }

  /// Retrieves the list from secure storage.
  Future<List<DraftActivity>> getItems() async {
    final jsonString = await _storageService.readItem(key: _listKey);

    if (jsonString == null) return [];

    try {
      final List<dynamic> jsonList = jsonDecode(jsonString);

      final items = jsonList
          .map((json) => json != null ? DraftActivity.fromJson(json as Map<String, dynamic>) : null)
          .where((item) => item != null) // Remove any null results
          .cast<DraftActivity>() // Cast to proper type
          .toList();
      // final items = jsonList.map((json) => DraftActivity.fromJson(json as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList();

      return items;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("Error decoding items: $e");
      return [];
    }
  }

  /// Adds a new item with the current datetime.
  Future<void> addItem(DraftActivity draft) async {
    final newItem = draft;

    final items = await getItems();

    items.add(newItem);

    final jsonString = jsonEncode(
      items.map((item) => item.toJson()).toList(),
      toEncodable: (dynamic object) {
        if (object is DateTime) {
          return object.toIso8601String();
        }
        return object;
      },
    );

    await _storageService.storeItem(key: _listKey, value: jsonString);

    // Refresh the stream with the updated list.
    await refreshItems();
  }

  /// Refreshes the list by reading from storage and updating the stream.
  Future<void> refreshItems() async {
    final items = await getItems();
    _listController.add(items);
  }

  /// Deletes a draft activity by ID
  Future<bool> deleteDraftById(String id) async {
    try {
      final items = await dbService.getItems();
      final initialLength = items.length;

      // Remove item with matching ID
      items.removeWhere((item) => item.id == id);

      if (items.length < initialLength) {
        // Item was found and removed
        final jsonString = jsonEncode(
          items.map((e) => e.toJson()).toList(),
          toEncodable: (dynamic object) {
            if (object is DateTime) {
              return object.toIso8601String();
            }
            return object;
          },
        );

        await getIt<StorageService>().storeItem(key: 'activity_list', value: jsonString);
        await dbService.refreshItems();

        return true; // Success
      }

      return false; // Item not found
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error deleting draft by ID: $e');
      return false; // Failed
    }
  }

  // /// Dispose the stream controller.
  // void dispose() {
  //   _listController.close();
  // }
}

class FirebaseService {
  final FirebaseMessaging _fcm = FirebaseMessaging.instance;
  final UserService user = getIt<UserService>();
  final userApi = getIt<UserApiService>();

  Future<String?> getFCMToken() async {
    return await _fcm.getToken();
  }

  void actions(Map<String, dynamic> message) async {
    if (kDebugMode) {
      print("Notification payload is ${message.toString()}");
    }
    final action = message["action"];
    switch (action) {
      case "update":
        // await _checkForUpdates();
        break;
      default:
        if (kDebugMode) {
          print("default case");
        }
    }
  }

  Future addToken() async {
    debugPrint("add token");
    var token = await getFCMToken();

    try {
      Response response = await connect().patch("/user/token/add", data: {"token": token});
      print("addToken Response:::${response.statusCode}");
      return resModelFromJson(response.data);
    } on DioError catch (e) {
      debugPrint("Add Token Error: ${e.response}");
      return resModelFromJson(e.response?.data);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("not:::${e.toString()}");
    }
  }

  Future test() async {
    var deviceID = await getUniqueDeviceId();
    var token = await getFCMToken();

    try {
      Response response = await connect(useCustomUrl: "https://e9ea-102-89-44-46.ngrok-free.app/v1/customers/fcm")
          // useCustomUrl:
          //     "https://8a20-102-89-42-232.ngrok-free.app/v1/customers/fcm/")
          .put("", data: {"token": token, "deviceId": deviceID});
      print(response.data);
      return resModelFromJson(response.data);
    } on DioError catch (e) {
      print(e.message.toString());
      debugPrint("Add Token Error: ${e.response}");
      return resModelFromJson(e.response?.data);
    } catch (e) {
      print(e.toString());
      debugPrint(e.toString());
    }
  }

  void setupNotificationListeners() async {
    try {
      if (Platform.isIOS) {
        NotificationSettings settings = await FirebaseMessaging.instance.requestPermission(
          alert: true,
          announcement: false,
          badge: true,
          carPlay: false,
          criticalAlert: false,
          provisional: false,
          sound: true,
        );
      }

      FirebaseMessaging.instance.getInitialMessage().then((RemoteMessage? message) async {
        debugPrint("get initial message");

        if (message != null) {
          actions(message.data);
        }
      });

      // FirebaseMessaging.
      FirebaseMessaging.onMessageOpenedApp.listen((RemoteMessage message) async {
        debugPrint('A new onMessageOpenedApp event was published!');
        actions(message.data);
      });

      FirebaseMessaging.onMessage.listen((RemoteMessage message) async {
        debugPrint(message.data.toString());
        actions(message.data);
        if (message.data['action'].toString().toLowerCase() == "logout") {
          debugPrint("yes");
          //TODO: auto log user out at this point
          // autoLogUserOut();
        }

        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), () async {
          await userApi.getUser();
        });

        RemoteNotification? notification = message.notification;
        AndroidNotification? android = message.notification?.android;
        if (notification != null && android != null) {
          flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.show(
              notification.hashCode,
              notification.title,
              notification.body,
              NotificationDetails(
                android: AndroidNotificationDetails(channel.id, channel.name,
                    icon: '@mipmap/ic_launcher',
                    largeIcon: const FilePathAndroidBitmap('@mipmap/ic_launcher'),
                    styleInformation: const BigPictureStyleInformation(FilePathAndroidBitmap('@mipmap/ic_launcher'))),
              ));
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      print(e.toString());
    }
  }
}

/* ===== lib/core/services/navigation-observer.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class NavObserver extends NavigatorObserver {
  @override
  void didPush(Route<dynamic> route, Route<dynamic>? previousRoute) {
    super.didPush(route, previousRoute);
    if (route is MaterialPageRoute) {
      final routeName = route.settings.name;
      print("Navigated to: $routeName");
      print("Action: Push");
    }
  }

  @override
  void didPop(Route<dynamic> route, Route<dynamic>? previousRoute) {
    super.didPop(route, previousRoute);
    if (route is MaterialPageRoute) {
      final routeName = route.settings.name;
      print("Navigated from: $routeName");
      print("Action: Pop");
    }
  }
}

/* ===== lib/core/services/navigation_service.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';

final navService = getIt<NavigationService>();

class NavigationService {
  final GlobalKey<NavigatorState> navigatorKey = new GlobalKey<NavigatorState>();
  final GlobalKey<ScaffoldMessengerState> snackBarKey = GlobalKey<ScaffoldMessengerState>();

  Future<dynamic> navigateTo(String routeName, {dynamic argument}) {
    return navigatorKey.currentState!.pushNamed(routeName, arguments: argument);
  }

  Future<dynamic> navigateToReplace(String routeName, {dynamic argument}) {
    return navigatorKey.currentState!.pushReplacementNamed(routeName, arguments: argument);
  }

  Future<dynamic> navigateToAndRemoveUntil(String routeName, {dynamic argument}) {
    return navigatorKey.currentState!.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(routeName, (route) => false);
  }

  void goBack({Object? object}) {
    return navigatorKey.currentState!.pop(object);
  }
}

/* ===== lib/core/services/storage-service.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';

class StorageService {
  FlutterSecureStorage storage = const FlutterSecureStorage(
      aOptions: AndroidOptions(
    encryptedSharedPreferences: true,
  ));
  bool isLoggedIn = false;

  storeItem({String? key, String? value}) async {
    await storage.write(key: key!, value: value);
  }

  Future<dynamic> readItem({String? key}) async {
    try {
      final value = await storage.read(key: key!);
      return value;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint(e.toString());
    }
  }

  void deleteItem({String? key}) async {
    await storage.delete(key: key!);
  }

  void deleteAllItems() async {
    await storage.deleteAll();
  }
}

/* ===== lib/core/services/web-services/activity-api.dart ===== */
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/api-routes.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/storage-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/user.service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/web-services/user-api-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/res_model.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/string%20utils.dart';

import '../../../src/model/request/save-activity/create-afforestation-activity-model.dart';
import 'base-api.dart';

class ActivityApiService {
  StorageService storageService = getIt<StorageService>();
  UserService userService = getIt<UserService>();
  UserApiService userApiService = getIt<UserApiService>();

  Future getActivities_(String code) async {
    try {
      Response response = await connect().get(getActivities(code) ?? "");
      return ResModel(data: jsonDecode(response.data), status: true, success: true);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error in req:::${e.response?.data.toString()}|\n${e.error.toString()}');
      return ResModel(status: false, message: e.error.toString());
    } catch (e) {
      return ResModel(message: e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future getStrategicCatchmentInfo() async {
    try {
      Response response = await connect().get(ApiRoutes.strategicCatchmentInfo);
      return ResModel(data: jsonDecode(response.data), status: true, success: true);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error in req:::${e.response?.data.toString()}|\n${e.error.toString()}');
      return ResModel(status: false, message: jsonDecode(e.response?.data)['message'].toString());
    } catch (e) {
      return ResModel(message: e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future getStates() async {
    try {
      Response response = await connect().get(ApiRoutes.getStates);
      return ResModel(data: jsonDecode(response.data), status: true, success: true);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error in req:::${e.response?.data.toString()}|\n${e.error.toString()}');

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/app-cache.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/web-services/base-api.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/res_model.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/network_exception.dart';

class AppApiService {
  final cache = getIt<AppCache>();

  Future getAdminSettings() async {
    debugPrint("getAdminSettings");
    try {
      Response response = await connect().get("");
      if (response.statusCode == 200 || response.statusCode == 201) {}
      return resModelFromJson(response.data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Failed to admin settings');
      return resModelFromJson(e.response?.data ?? getErrorFromDio(e));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      return ResModel(message: e.toString());
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

class AuthenticationApiService {
  StorageService storageService = getIt<StorageService>();
  UserService userService = getIt<UserService>();
  UserApiService userApiService = getIt<UserApiService>();

  Future login(LoginRequest request) async {
    try {
      Response response = await ApiClient.instance.post(ApiRoutes.loginRoute, data: request.toAcreasalLogin());
      print(response.data);
      String token = response.data.toString().replaceAll("\"", "");
      if (token.isNotNullNorEmpty) {
        activityService.saveAuthData(email: request.userName ?? "", password: request.password ?? "", token: token);
      }
      await storeTokenOnly(token);
      return ResModel(data: response.data.toString().replaceAll("\"", ""), success: true, status: true);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      print(e.response?.data);
      print(jsonDecode(e.response?.data));
      return resModelFromJson(
        jsonDecode(e.response?.data) ?? getErrorFromDio(e),
      );
    } catch (e, s) {
      print(s.toString());
      print(e.toString());
      return ResModel(message: "Something went wrong");
    }
  }

  Future relogin(LoginRequest request) async {
    String? email = activityService.getEmail();
    String? password = activityService.getPassword();
    if (email.isNotNullNorEmpty && password.isNotNullNorEmpty) {
      try {
        login(LoginRequest(email: email, password: password));
      } catch (e, s) {
        print(s.toString());
        print(e.toString());
      }
    }
  }

  Future signup(SignUpRequest request) async {
    try {
      Response response = await connect().post(ApiRoutes.signUpRoute, data: request.toMap());
      await storeToken(response);
      return loginModelFromJson(response.data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Error in req:::${e.response?.data.toString()}|\n${e.error.toString()}');
      return loginModelFromJson(
        e.response?.data ?? getErrorFromDio(e),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      return LoginResponse(message: e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future requestEmailVerificationCode() async {

  storeToken(
    response,
  ) async {
    // if the request failed then return;
    LoginResponse res = loginModelFromJson(response.data);
    if (res.success == false) return;

    //store token
    String _token = '${res.data?.accessToken}';
    String _tokenType = '${res.data?.tokenType}';
    String _userToken = '${res.data?.usertoken}';

    debugPrint(_token);
    await storageService.storeItem(key: bearerToken, value: _token);
    await storageService.storeItem(key: userToken, value: _userToken);
    await storageService.storeItem(key: bearerTokenType, value: _tokenType);
  }

  storeTokenOnly(
    String token,
  ) async {
    // if the request failed then return;
    debugPrint(token);
    await storageService.storeItem(key: bearerToken, value: token);
  }
}

/* ===== lib/core/services/web-services/base-api.dart ===== */
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/constants.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/activity-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/web-services/auth.api.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/web-services/nertwork_config.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/request/auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/res_model.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/device-id-utils.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/string-extensions.dart';

import '../storage-service.dart';

Dio connect({String? useCustomUrl}) {
  final storageService = getIt<StorageService>();
  BaseOptions options = BaseOptions(
      baseUrl: useCustomUrl ?? NetworkConfig.BASE_URL, connectTimeout: const Duration(milliseconds: 350000), receiveTimeout: const Duration(milliseconds: 35000), responseType: ResponseType.plain);
  Dio dio = Dio(options);

  dio.interceptors.add(
    InterceptorsWrapper(
      onRequest: (options, handler) async {
        debugPrint(options.uri.toString());
        debugPrint(options.data.toString());
        String? id = await getUniqueDeviceId();

        ///Add device id to request
        // options.headers['device-id'] = id;

        ///log device id
        // print(id);
        String? value = await storageService.readItem(key: bearerToken);
        String? userT = await storageService.readItem(key: userToken);

        ///Add Token to Request
        if (value != null && value.isNotEmpty) {
          options.headers['Authorization'] = "Bearer $value";

          ///log token
          // print(value);
          // print(options.headers.toString());
        }

        ///Add Token to Request
        if (userT != null && userT.isNotEmpty) {
          options.headers['token'] = userT;

          ///log token
          // print(userT);
          // print(options.headers.toString());
        }

        return handler.next(options);
      },
      onResponse: (response, handler) {
        print("received response from :::${response.requestOptions.path}");
        return handler.next(response);
      },
      onError: (DioException e, handler) async {
        ///log error path
        debugPrint(
            "path: ${e.requestOptions.path}, uri: ${e.requestOptions.uri.scheme}, Error code: ${e.response?.statusCode}, Error data: ${e.response?.data}, Error response status message: ${e.response?.statusMessage}, Error message: ${e.message}, Error type name: ${e.type.name}, Error type name: ${e.type.name},   ");
        //handles auto-logout when error message contains session expiry desc.
        if (
            // e.response?.statusCode == 401 &&
            e.response.toString().contains("The user name must not be empty")) {
          // getIt<NavigationService>().navigateToAndRemoveUntil(Routes.loginRoute);
          // getIt<StorageService>().deleteItem(key: bearerToken);
          print("Session Expired");
          bool success = await reQueryToken();
          if (success) {
            try {
              // Clone the original request
              final options = Options(
                method: e.requestOptions.method,
                headers: e.requestOptions.headers,
                responseType: e.requestOptions.responseType,
                contentType: e.requestOptions.contentType,
                followRedirects: e.requestOptions.followRedirects,
                receiveDataWhenStatusError: e.requestOptions.receiveDataWhenStatusError,
                validateStatus: e.requestOptions.validateStatus,
                receiveTimeout: e.requestOptions.receiveTimeout,
                sendTimeout: e.requestOptions.sendTimeout,
              );

              final response = await Dio().request(
                e.requestOptions.path,
                data: e.requestOptions.data,
                queryParameters: e.requestOptions.queryParameters,
                options: options,
              );

              // Return the successful response to continue the chain
              return handler.resolve(response);
            } catch (error) {
              // If retry fails, forward the original error
              return handler.next(e);
            }
          }
        }
        return handler.next(e);
      },
    ),
  );

  return dio;
}

// Dio client singleton
class ApiClient {
  static final Dio _dio = Dio(BaseOptions(
    baseUrl: NetworkConfig.BASE_URL,
    connectTimeout: const Duration(milliseconds: 350000),
    receiveTimeout: const Duration(milliseconds: 350000),
    responseType: ResponseType.plain, // Automatic JSON parsing
  ));

  static Dio get instance {
    _dio.interceptors.clear();
    _dio.interceptors.add(_mainInterceptor);
    return _dio;
  }

  static final InterceptorsWrapper _mainInterceptor = InterceptorsWrapper(
    onRequest: _onRequest,
    onResponse: _onResponse,
    onError: _onError,
  );

  static Future<void> _onRequest(RequestOptions options, handler) async {
    debugPrint('[REQ] ${options.uri}');
    final storage = getIt<StorageService>();
    // String? value,userT;
    // Parallel token fetch
    final results = await Future.wait([
      storage.readItem(key: bearerToken),
      storage.readItem(key: userToken),
    ]);
    final value = results[0] as String?;
    final userT = results[1] as String?;

    if (value?.isNotEmpty ?? false) {
      options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $value';
    }

    // if (userT?.isNotEmpty ?? false) {
    //   options.headers['token'] = userT;
    // }

    debugPrint("[HEADER:]${options.headers.toString()}");
    if (options.data != null) {
      debugPrint("[BODY:]${options.data.toString()}");
    }
    handler.next(options);
  }

  static void _onResponse(response, handler) {
    debugPrint('[RES] ${response.requestOptions.path}');
    handler.next(response);
  }

  static void _onError(DioException e, handler) {
    debugPrint('[ERR] ${e.requestOptions.uri} - ${e.message}');
    //handles auto-logout when error message contains session expiry desc.
    // if (e.response?.statusCode == 401) {
    // getIt<NavigationService>().navigateToAndRemoveUntil(Routes.loginRoute);
    // getIt<StorageService>().deleteItem(key: bearerToken);
    print("Session Expired");
    // }
    handler.next(e);
  }
}

Future<bool> reQueryToken() async {
  String? email = activityService.getEmail();
  String? password = activityService.getPassword();
  if (email.isNotNullNorEmpty && password.isNotNullNorEmpty) {
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<AuthenticationApiService>().login(LoginRequest(email: email, password: password));
      if (res.success!) {
        return true;
      } else {
        return false;
      }
    } catch (e, s) {
      print(s.toString());
      print(e.toString());
      return false;
    }
  } else {
    return false;
  }
}

    response,
  ) async {
    // if the request failed then return;
    LoginResponse res = loginModelFromJson(response.data);
    if (res.success == false) return;

    //store token
    String _token = '${res.data?.accessToken}';
    String _tokenType = '${res.data?.tokenType}';
    String _userToken = '${res.data?.usertoken}';

    debugPrint(_token);
    await storageService.storeItem(key: bearerToken, value: _token);
    await storageService.storeItem(key: userToken, value: _userToken);
    await storageService.storeItem(key: bearerTokenType, value: _tokenType);
  }

  storeTokenOnly(
    String token,
  ) async {
    // if the request failed then return;
    debugPrint(token);
    await storageService.storeItem(key: bearerToken, value: token);
  }

      return ResModel(message: e.toString());
    }
  }
}

final FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin = FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();

AndroidNotificationChannel channel = const AndroidNotificationChannel(
    'high_importance_channel', // id
    'High Importance Notifications', // title/ description
    importance: Importance.max,
    playSound: true,
    showBadge: true);

@pragma('vm:entry-point')
Future<void> _firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler(RemoteMessage message) async {
  print("4....");
  // If you're going to use other Firebase services in the background, such as Firestore,
  // make sure you call `initializeApp before using other Firebase services.

  const AndroidInitializationSettings initializationSettingsAndroid = AndroidInitializationSettings(
    '@mipmap/ic_launcher',
  );

  /// Note: permissions aren't requested here just to demonstrate that can be
  /// done later
  ///
  ///

  const DarwinInitializationSettings initializationSettingsIOS = DarwinInitializationSettings(
    requestAlertPermission: false,
    requestBadgePermission: false,
    requestSoundPermission: false,
  );

  const InitializationSettings initializationSettings = InitializationSettings(android: initializationSettingsAndroid, iOS: initializationSettingsIOS);
  await Firebase.initializeApp();
  await flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.initialize(
    initializationSettings,
    // onSelectNotification: (String? payload) async {}
  );

  RemoteNotification? notification = message.notification;
  AndroidNotification? android = message.notification?.android;
  if (notification != null && android != null) {
    flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.show(
        notification.hashCode,
        notification.title,
        notification.body,
        NotificationDetails(
          android: AndroidNotificationDetails(channel.id, channel.name,
              icon: '@mipmap/ic_launcher',
              largeIcon: const FilePathAndroidBitmap('@mipmap/ic_launcher'),
              styleInformation: const BigPictureStyleInformation(FilePathAndroidBitmap('@mipmap/ic_launcher'))),
        ));
    print('Handling a background message ${message.messageId} message handler 1');
    print("Message Payload is ${message.data.toString()}");
  }
}

void main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  //Firebase Initialization Setup =====================>

  await Firebase.initializeApp(options: DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform);

  FirebaseMessaging.onBackgroundMessage(_firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler);

  await flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin>()?.requestNotificationsPermission();

  await flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin>()?.createNotificationChannel(channel);

  /// Update the iOS foreground notification presentation options to allow
  /// heads up notifications.
  await FirebaseMessaging.instance.setForegroundNotificationPresentationOptions(
    alert: true,
    badge: true,
    sound: true,
  );

  FirebaseMessaging messaging = FirebaseMessaging.instance;

  NotificationSettings settings = await messaging.requestPermission(
    alert: true,
    announcement: false,
    badge: true,
    carPlay: false,
    criticalAlert: false,
    provisional: false,
    sound: true,
  );
  //===========================================================//

  await dotenv.load(fileName: ".env");
  final appDocumentDir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
  Hive.init(appDocumentDir.path);

  // Register adapters
  Hive.registerAdapter(IActivityAdapter());
  Hive.registerAdapter(UploadStatusAdapter());
  await Hive.initFlutter();

  await dependenciesInjectorSetup();

  FirebaseService().setupNotificationListeners();
  activityService.initAuthBox();
  runApp(const ProviderScope(child: MyApp()));
}

class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  final bool? loggedIn;

  const MyApp({
    Key? key,
    this.loggedIn,
  }) : super(key: key);

  // This widget is the root of your application.
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return OKToast(
      child: ScreenUtilInit(
        useInheritedMediaQuery: true,
        designSize: const Size(390, 844),
        minTextAdapt: true,
        splitScreenMode: true,
        builder: (child, _) {
          return GestureDetector(
            onTap: () {
              final currentFocus = FocusScope.of(context);
              if (!currentFocus.hasPrimaryFocus && currentFocus.focusedChild != null) {
                FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.unfocus();
              }
            },
            child: MaterialApp(
                debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
                navigatorKey: getIt<NavigationService>().navigatorKey,
                scaffoldMessengerKey: getIt<NavigationService>().snackBarKey,
                theme: ThemeData(
                  useMaterial3: false,
                  scaffoldBackgroundColor: white,
                  textTheme: Theme.of(context).textTheme.apply(bodyColor: primaryDarkColor, displayColor: primaryDarkColor, fontFamily: GoogleFonts.poppins().fontFamily),
                  primaryColor: primaryColor,
                  visualDensity: VisualDensity.adaptivePlatformDensity,
                  colorScheme: ThemeData().colorScheme.copyWith(primary: primaryColor).copyWith(surface: white),
                ),
                onGenerateRoute: Routers.generateRoute,
                initialRoute: Routes.splashRoute,
                // getIt<UserService>().isLoggedIn ? Routes.loginRoute : Routessent now.welcomeRoute,

                // 🌐 CONNECTIVITY WRAPPER ADDED HERE
                builder: (context, widget) {
                  return MediaQuery(
                    //Setting font does not change with system font size
                    data: MediaQuery.of(context).copyWith(textScaler: const TextScaler.linear(1.0)),
                    child: ConnectivityWrapper(
                      checkInterval: const Duration(seconds: 15),
                      child: ScrollConfiguration(
                        behavior: const ScrollBehavior(),
                        child: widget!,
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}
