class Routers {
  static Route<dynamic> generateRoute(RouteSettings settings) {
    final args = settings.arguments;
    switch (settings.name) {
      case Routes.homeRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const BottomNavPage());
      case Routes.loginRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const LoginPage());
      case Routes.verifyOtp:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const VerifyOtpPage());
      case Routes.welcomeRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const Welcome());
      case Routes.authWelcomeRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const WelcomeBackAuth());
      case Routes.signupRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const SignUpPage());
      case Routes.splashRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const SplashScreen());
      case Routes.onboardingPageRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const OnBoardingPage());
      case Routes.forgotPasswordRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const ForgotPassword());
      case Routes.resetPassword:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const ResetPassword());
      case Routes.selectSubComponentRoute:
        Map<String, dynamic> map = args as Map<String, dynamic>;
        return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => SelectSubComponentPage(
                  component: map['a'] as ComponentEnum,
                  comp: map['b'] as ComponentsRes?,
                ));
      case Routes.subComponentDashboardRoute:
        Map<String, dynamic> map = args as Map<String, dynamic>;
        String? componentName;
        return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => SubComponentDashboardPage(
                  componentModel: map['a'] as ComponentModel?,
                  comp: map['b'] as IComponentModel?,
                  cname: map['cname'] as String?,
                ));

      case Routes.activitiesInfoRoute:
        Map<String, dynamic> map = args as Map<String, dynamic>;
        // ISubComponents? map = args as ISubComponents?;
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AICa1_StrategicWatershedMgtPlanPage(subComponents: map['subComponent'], component: map['component']));

      // case Routes.activitiesInfoCa1Route:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const ActivitiesInfoCa1Page());

      // case Routes.activitySubComponentInfoRoute:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const ActivitySubComponentInfoPage());
      case Routes.selectResultFrameworkRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const SelectResultFrameworkPage());

      case Routes.beneficiaryInfoRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const BeneficiaryInfoPage());
      case Routes.polyPage:
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => PolygonDrawingMap());

      case Routes.successPage:
        Map extras = args as Map;
        return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => SuccessWidget(
                  body: extras['body'] ?? "",
                  useSubMessagePrefix: extras['useSubMessagePrefix'] ?? true,
                  view: extras['view'],
                  autoImplyHome: extras['autoImplyHome'] ?? true,
                ));
      case Routes.fourohfour:
        return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => Fancy404Page(
                  onHomePressed: () {
                    navService.goBack();
                  },
                ));

      ///CREATE ACTIVITY ROUTES
      ///stategic watershed
      case "/A1-0":
        Map<String, dynamic> map = args as Map<String, dynamic>;
        // ISubComponents? data = args as ISubComponents?;
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AICa1_StrategicWatershedMgtPlanPage(subComponents: map['subComponent'], component: map['component']));

      case "/A2-1":

        ///A2 - Landscape Investments (Afforestation)fo
        Map<String, dynamic> map = args as Map<String, dynamic>;
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AICa2_AfforestationPage(subComponents: map['subComponent'], component: map['component']));
      case "/A2-2":
        // A2 - Landscape Investments (Civil Works)
        Map<String, dynamic> map = args as Map<String, dynamic>;
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AICA2_CivilWorksPage(subComponents: map['subComponent'], component: map['component']));
      case "/A2-3":
        // A2 -  Landscape Investments (Water Resources Management)
        Map<String, dynamic> map = args as Map<String, dynamic>;
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AICa2_WaterResourcesMgtPage(subComponents: map['subComponent'], component: map['component']));
      case "/A3-0":
        // A3 - Special Ecosystems (Nature of Intervention)
        Map<String, dynamic> map = args as Map<String, dynamic>;
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AICa3_SpecialEcosystemPage(subComponents: map['subComponent'], component: map['component']));
      case "/${isInputDistributionCode}":

      ///A2 - Landscape Investments (Afforestation)fo
        Map<String, dynamic> map = args as Map<String, dynamic>;
        return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => CreateInputsAssetsDistributionPage(subComponents: map['subComponent'], component: map['component']));


    // case "/62c28fe4-994a-44ef-b5c2-26b80bb7abd2":
      //   Map<String, dynamic> map = args as Map<String, dynamic>;
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => CRFMCPage(subComponents: map['subComponent'], component: map['component']));
      //
      // case Routes.crfmcSubRoute:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const CRFMCSubPage());
      // case Routes.cigsSubRoute:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_)=> const CIGsSubPage());
      // case Routes.boardOfTrusteesRoute:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const BoardOfTrusteesPage());
      // case Routes.cBARoutes:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const CommunityBusinessAgentsPage());
      case Routes.crfCigsRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => ViewCIGsBeneficiariesPage(
                  data: args as Map<String, dynamic>?,
                )); //CB2_CIGPage
      // case Routes.b2createMembersRoute:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => CreateMembersPage());
      //
      case Routes.b2createCIGBeneficiaryRoute:
        return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => BeneficiaryRegistrationPage(
                  data: args as Map<String, dynamic>?,
                ));
      //
      // case Routes.b2CreateBusinessPlanRoute:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => CreateBusinessPlanPage());
      // case Routes.b2CreateDisbursementPortfolioRoute:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => CreateDisbursementPortfoliosPage());
      // case Routes.b2CreateRepaymentRoute:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => CreateRepaymentPage());
      // case Routes.b2CreateCommunityInvestmentInputAssetsDistributionRoute:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => ComponentB2( initials: [], config: [],));
      //
      // case Routes.b2CreateLoanPortfolioRoute:
      //   return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => CreateLoanPortfoliosPage());
      case Routes.componentSuccess:
        return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => ComponentSuccessScreen(
                  activityId: 'ACT-2024-001234',
                  componentName: 'CRFC Activity Component',
                  onContinueToMapping: () => handleClick(),
                  onCancel: () {
                    // Handle cancel
                    print('Cancel pressed');
                  },
                ));

      case Routes.unavailableComponent:
        return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => ComponentAccessDeniedScreen(
                  componentName: 'Advanced Analytics Module',
                  subComponentName: 'Real-time Data Processing',
                  supportEmail: 'support@company.com',
                  onContactSupport: () {
                    // Handle contact support
                    print('Contact support pressed');
                  },
                  onBackToDashboard: () {
                    // Handle back to dashboard
                    print('Back to dashboard pressed');
                  },
                ));

      default:
        return MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => Fancy404Page(
                  onHomePressed: () {
                    navService.goBack();
                  },
                ));
    }
  }
}

class AcresalUser {
  String? email;
  String? userName;
  bool? isActive;
  bool? enable2FA;
  bool? changePasswordOnFirstLogon;
  bool? emailConfirmed;
  bool? phoneNumberConfirmed;
  Null? entityOid;
  Null? name;
  String? phoneNo;
  String? lastLoginDate;
  String? passwordExpiration;
  String? previousPasswordChanged;
  String? oid;
  String? createdBy;
  String? createdOn;
  String? modifiedBy;
  String? modifiedOn;
  String? deviceName;
  String? deviceIpAddress;
  String? deviceUserName;
  num? latitude;
  num? longitude;

  AcresalUser(
      {this.email,
        this.userName,
        this.isActive,
        this.enable2FA,
        this.changePasswordOnFirstLogon,
        this.emailConfirmed,
        this.phoneNumberConfirmed,
        this.entityOid,
        this.name,
        this.phoneNo,
        this.lastLoginDate,
        this.passwordExpiration,
        this.previousPasswordChanged,
        this.oid,
        this.createdBy,
        this.createdOn,
        this.modifiedBy,
        this.modifiedOn,
        this.deviceName,
        this.deviceIpAddress,
        this.deviceUserName,
        this.latitude,
        this.longitude});

  AcresalUser.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    email = json['email'];
    userName = json['userName'];
    isActive = json['isActive'];
    enable2FA = json['enable2FA'];
    changePasswordOnFirstLogon = json['changePasswordOnFirstLogon'];
    emailConfirmed = json['emailConfirmed'];
    phoneNumberConfirmed = json['phoneNumberConfirmed'];
    entityOid = json['entityOid'];
    name = json['name'];
    phoneNo = json['phoneNo'];
    lastLoginDate = json['lastLoginDate'];
    passwordExpiration = json['passwordExpiration'];
    previousPasswordChanged = json['previousPasswordChanged'];
    oid = json['oid'];
    createdBy = json['createdBy'];
    createdOn = json['createdOn'];
    modifiedBy = json['modifiedBy'];
    modifiedOn = json['modifiedOn'];
    deviceName = json['deviceName'];
    deviceIpAddress = json['deviceIpAddress'];
    deviceUserName = json['deviceUserName'];
    latitude = json['latitude'];
    longitude = json['longitude'];
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = new Map<String, dynamic>();
    data['email'] = this.email;
    data['userName'] = this.userName;
    data['isActive'] = this.isActive;
    data['enable2FA'] = this.enable2FA;
    data['changePasswordOnFirstLogon'] = this.changePasswordOnFirstLogon;
    data['emailConfirmed'] = this.emailConfirmed;
    data['phoneNumberConfirmed'] = this.phoneNumberConfirmed;
    data['entityOid'] = this.entityOid;
    data['name'] = this.name;
    data['phoneNo'] = this.phoneNo;
    data['lastLoginDate'] = this.lastLoginDate;
    data['passwordExpiration'] = this.passwordExpiration;
    data['previousPasswordChanged'] = this.previousPasswordChanged;
    data['oid'] = this.oid;
    data['createdBy'] = this.createdBy;
    data['createdOn'] = this.createdOn;
    data['modifiedBy'] = this.modifiedBy;
    data['modifiedOn'] = this.modifiedOn;
    data['deviceName'] = this.deviceName;
    data['deviceIpAddress'] = this.deviceIpAddress;
    data['deviceUserName'] = this.deviceUserName;
    data['latitude'] = this.latitude;
    data['longitude'] = this.longitude;
    return data;
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/model/agebrackets-response.dart ===== */
class AgeBracketResponse {
  int? count;
  String? message;
  List<AgeBracket>? data;

  AgeBracketResponse({this.count, this.message, this.data});

  AgeBracketResponse.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    count = json['count'];
    message = json['message'];
    if (json['data'] != null) {
      data = <AgeBracket>[];
      json['data'].forEach((v) {
        data!.add(AgeBracket.fromJson(v));
      });
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> result = <String, dynamic>{};
    result['count'] = count;
    result['message'] = message;
    if (data != null) {
      result['data'] = data!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    return result;
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

CigResponse cigResponseFromJson(String str) => CigResponse.fromJson(json.decode(str));

String cigResponseToJson(CigResponse data) => json.encode(data.toJson());

class CigResponse {
  num? count;
  String? message;
  List<Cig>? data;

  CigResponse({
    this.count,
    this.message,
    this.data,
  });

  factory CigResponse.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => CigResponse(
        count: json["count"],
        message: json["message"],
        data: json["data"] == null ? [] : List<Cig>.from(json["data"].map((x) => Cig.fromJson(x))),
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        "count": count,
        "message": message,
        "data": data == null ? [] : List<dynamic>.from(data!.map((x) => x.toJson())),
      };
}

/* ===== lib/src/model/community-response.dart ===== */
class CommunityResponse {
  int? count;
  String? message;
  List<Community>? data;

  CommunityResponse({this.count, this.message, this.data});

  CommunityResponse.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    count = json['count'];
    message = json['message'];
    if (json['data'] != null) {
      data = <Community>[];
      json['data'].forEach((v) {
        data!.add(Community.fromJson(v));
      });
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> result = <String, dynamic>{};
    result['count'] = count;
    result['message'] = message;
    if (data != null) {
      result['data'] = data!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    return result;
  }
}

class ResponseModel {
  final num? count;
  final String? message;
  final List<ComponentIndicator>? data;

  ResponseModel({
    this.count,
    this.message,
    this.data,
  });

  factory ResponseModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => ResponseModel(
        count: json['count'] as num?,
        message: json['message'] as String?,
        data: (json['data'] as List<dynamic>?)?.map((e) => ComponentIndicator.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList(),
      );
}

class ComponentIndicator {
  final num? baseline;
  final String? componentOid;
  final String? componentDescription;
  final String? description;
  final String? frequency;
  final bool? isParent;
  final String? name;
  final String? parentId;
  final String? pbc;
  final String? sequence;
  final String? unitOfMeasure;
  final String? valueType;
  final List<dynamic>? subComponents;
  final List<dynamic>? targets;
  final String? oid;
  final String? createdBy;
  final DateTime? createdOn;
  final String? modifiedBy;
  final DateTime? modifiedOn;
  final String? deviceName;
  final String? deviceIpAddress;
  final String? deviceUserName;
  final num? latitude;
  final num? longitude;

  ComponentIndicator({
    this.baseline,
    this.componentOid,
    this.componentDescription,
    this.description,
    this.frequency,
    this.isParent,
    this.name,
    this.parentId,
    this.pbc,
    this.sequence,
    this.unitOfMeasure,
    this.valueType,
    this.subComponents,
    this.targets,
    this.oid,
    this.createdBy,
    this.createdOn,
    this.modifiedBy,
    this.modifiedOn,
    this.deviceName,
    this.deviceIpAddress,
    this.deviceUserName,
    this.latitude,
    this.longitude,
  });

  factory ComponentIndicator.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => ComponentIndicator(
        baseline: json['baseline'] as num?,
        componentOid: json['componentOid'] as String?,
        componentDescription: json['componentDescription'] as String?,
        description: json['description'] as String?,
        frequency: json['frequency'] as String?,
        isParent: json['isParent'] as bool?,
        name: json['name'] as String?,
        parentId: json['parentId'] as String?,
        pbc: json['pbc'] as String?,
        sequence: json['sequence'] as String?,
        unitOfMeasure: json['unitOfMeasure'] as String?,
        valueType: json['valueType'] as String?,
        subComponents: json['subComponents'] as List<dynamic>?,
        targets: json['targets'] as List<dynamic>?,
        oid: json['oid'] as String?,
        createdBy: json['createdBy'] as String?,
        createdOn: json['createdOn'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['createdOn'] as String) : null,
        modifiedBy: json['modifiedBy'] as String?,
        modifiedOn: json['modifiedOn'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['modifiedOn'] as String) : null,
        deviceName: json['deviceName'] as String?,
        deviceIpAddress: json['deviceIpAddress'] as String?,
        deviceUserName: json['deviceUserName'] as String?,
        latitude: json['latitude'] as num?,
        longitude: json['longitude'] as num?,
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    return {
      'baseline': baseline,
      'componentOid': componentOid,
      'componentDescription': componentDescription,
      'description': description,
      'frequency': frequency,
      'isParent': isParent,
      'name': name,
      'parentId': parentId,
      'pbc': pbc,
      'sequence': sequence,
      'unitOfMeasure': unitOfMeasure,
      'valueType': valueType,
      'subComponents': subComponents,
      'targets': targets,
      'oid': oid,
      'createdBy': createdBy,
      'createdOn': createdOn,
      'modifiedBy': modifiedBy,
      'modifiedOn': modifiedOn,
      'deviceName': deviceName,
      'deviceIpAddress': deviceIpAddress,
      'deviceUserName': deviceUserName,
      'latitude': latitude,
      'longitude': longitude,
    };
  }

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'ComponentIndicator{baseline: $baseline, componentOid: $componentOid, componentDescription: $componentDescription, description: $description, frequency: $frequency, isParent: $isParent, name: $name, parentId: $parentId, pbc: $pbc, sequence: $sequence, unitOfMeasure: $unitOfMeasure, valueType: $valueType, subComponents: $subComponents, targets: $targets, oid: $oid, createdBy: $createdBy, createdOn: $createdOn, modifiedBy: $modifiedBy, modifiedOn: $modifiedOn, deviceName: $deviceName, deviceIpAddress: $deviceIpAddress, deviceUserName: $deviceUserName, latitude: $latitude, longitude: $longitude}';
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toPDOMap() {
    return {
      "indicatorType": "CLI",
      'baseline': this.baseline,
      'description': this.description,
      'frequency': this.frequency,
      'isParent': this.isParent,
      'name': this.name,
      'parentId': this.parentId,
      'pbc': this.pbc,
      'sequence': this.sequence,
      'valueType': this.valueType,
      'unitOfMeasure': this.unitOfMeasure,
      'subComponents': this.subComponents,
      'targets': this.targets,
      'oid': this.oid,
      'createdBy': this.createdBy,
      'createdOn': this.createdOn,
      'modifiedBy': this.modifiedBy,
      'modifiedOn': this.modifiedOn,
      'deviceName': this.deviceName,
      'deviceIpAddress': this.deviceIpAddress,
      'deviceUserName': this.deviceUserName,
      'latitude': this.latitude,
      'longitude': this.longitude,
    };
  }
}

extension SubComp on SubComponentEnum {
  ComponentEnum get getParentComponent {
    switch (this.parentComponent) {
      case 1:
        return ComponentEnum.componentA;
      case 2:
        return ComponentEnum.componentA;
      case 3:
        return ComponentEnum.componentA;
      default:
        return ComponentEnum.componentA;
    }
  }
}

extension SemiSubComp on SemiSubComponentEnum {
  SubComponentEnum get getSubComponent {
    switch (subComponent) {
      case 5:
        return SubComponentEnum.subComponentA1;
      case 6:
        return SubComponentEnum.subComponentA2;
      case 8:
        return SubComponentEnum.subComponentB1;
      case 9:
        return SubComponentEnum.subComponentB2;
      case 11:
        return SubComponentEnum.subComponentC2;
      default:
        return SubComponentEnum.subComponentA1;
    }
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/model/components-response.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/component-indicator-response.dart';

class ComponentsResponse {
  num? count;
  String? message;
  List<ComponentsRes>? data;

  ComponentsResponse({this.count, this.message, this.data});

  ComponentsResponse.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    count = json['count'];
    message = json['message'];
    if (json['data'] != null) {
      data = <ComponentsRes>[];
      json['data'].forEach((v) {
        data!.add(ComponentsRes.fromJson(v));
      });
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    data['count'] = count;
    data['message'] = message;
    if (this.data != null) {
      data['data'] = this.data!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    return data;
  }
}

class ComponentsRes {
  String? description;
  String? displayName;
  String? name;
  List<ISubComponents>? subComponents;
  List<ComponentIndicator>? componentIndicators;
  String? oid;
  String? createdBy;
  String? createdOn;
  String? modifiedBy;
  String? modifiedOn;
  String? deviceName;
  String? deviceIpAddress;
  String? deviceUserName;
  num? latitude;
  num? longitude;

  ComponentsRes(
      {this.description,
      this.displayName,
      this.name,
      this.subComponents,
      this.componentIndicators,
      this.oid,
      this.createdBy,
      this.createdOn,
      this.modifiedBy,
      this.modifiedOn,
      this.deviceName,
      this.deviceIpAddress,
      this.deviceUserName,
      this.latitude,
      this.longitude});

  ComponentsRes.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    description = json['description'];
    displayName = json['displayName'];
    name = json['name'];
    if (json['subComponents'] != null) {
      subComponents = <ISubComponents>[];
      json['subComponents'].forEach((v) {
        subComponents!.add(ISubComponents.fromJson(v));
      });
      subComponents?.sort((a, b) => (a.name ?? "").compareTo((b.name ?? "")));
    }
    if (json['componentIndicators'] != null) {
      componentIndicators = <ComponentIndicator>[];
      json['componentIndicators'].forEach((v) {
        componentIndicators!.add(ComponentIndicator.fromJson(v));
      });
      componentIndicators?.sort((a, b) => (a.name ?? "").compareTo((b.name ?? "")));
    }
    oid = json['oid'];
    createdBy = json['createdBy'];
    createdOn = json['createdOn'];
    modifiedBy = json['modifiedBy'];
    modifiedOn = json['modifiedOn'];
    deviceName = json['deviceName'];
    deviceIpAddress = json['deviceIpAddress'];
    deviceUserName = json['deviceUserName'];
    latitude = json['latitude'];
    longitude = json['longitude'];
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    data['description'] = description;
    data['displayName'] = displayName;
    data['name'] = name;
    if (subComponents != null) {
      data['subComponents'] = subComponents!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    if (componentIndicators != null) {
      data['componentIndicators'] = componentIndicators!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    data['oid'] = oid;
    data['createdBy'] = createdBy;
    data['createdOn'] = createdOn;
    data['modifiedBy'] = modifiedBy;
    data['modifiedOn'] = modifiedOn;
    data['deviceName'] = deviceName;
    data['deviceIpAddress'] = deviceIpAddress;
    data['deviceUserName'] = deviceUserName;
    data['latitude'] = latitude;
    data['longitude'] = longitude;
    return data;
  }

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'ComponentsRes{description: $description, displayName: $displayName, name: $name, subComponents: ${subComponents.toString()}, componentIndicators: ${componentIndicators.toString()}, oid: $oid, createdBy: $createdBy, createdOn: $createdOn, modifiedBy: $modifiedBy, modifiedOn: $modifiedOn, deviceName: $deviceName, deviceIpAddress: $deviceIpAddress, deviceUserName: $deviceUserName, latitude: $latitude, longitude: $longitude}';
  }
}

        componentLevelIndicators!.add(ComponentLevelIndicators.fromJson(v));

      pdoLevelIndicators = <PdoLevelIndicators>[];

    oid = json['oid'];

    modifiedBy = json['modifiedBy'];
    modifiedOn = json['modifiedOn'];
    deviceName = json['deviceName'];
    deviceIpAddress = json['deviceIpAddress'];
    deviceUserName = json['deviceUserName'];

  }

    }

      data['componentLevelIndicators'] = componentLevelIndicators!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    if (pdoLevelIndicators != null) {
      data['pdoLevelIndicators'] = pdoLevelIndicators!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    data['oid'] = oid;
    data['createdBy'] = createdBy;
    data['createdOn'] = createdOn;
    data['modifiedBy'] = modifiedBy;
    data['modifiedOn'] = modifiedOn;
    data['deviceName'] = deviceName;
    data['deviceIpAddress'] = deviceIpAddress;
    data['deviceUserName'] = deviceUserName;
    data['latitude'] = latitude;
    data['longitude'] = longitude;
    return data;
  }

  @override

    return 'ISubComponents{componentOid: $componentOid, componentDescription: $componentDescription, description: $description, displayName: $displayName, name: $name, code: $code, activityTypes: ${activityTypes.toString()}, componentLevelIndicators: ${componentLevelIndicators.toString()}, pdoLevelIndicators: ${pdoLevelIndicators.toString()}, oid: $oid, createdBy: $createdBy, createdOn: $createdOn, modifiedBy: $modifiedBy, modifiedOn: $modifiedOn, deviceName: $deviceName, deviceIpAddress: $deviceIpAddress, deviceUserName: $deviceUserName, latitude: $latitude, longitude: $longitude}';
  }

class ActivityTypes {

  ActivityTypes(
      {this.name,

      this.subComponentDescription,
      this.oid,

      this.modifiedBy,
      this.modifiedOn,
      this.deviceName,
      this.deviceIpAddress,
      this.deviceUserName,
      this.latitude,
      this.longitude});

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';

CountriesResponse countriesModelFromJson(String str) =>
    CountriesResponse.fromJson(json.decode(str));
String countriesModelToJson(CountriesResponse data) =>
    json.encode(data.toJson());

String countriesModelDataToString(dynamic data) => json.encode(data);
dynamic countriesModelDataToJson(String data) => json.decode(data);

class CountriesResponse {
  ICountry? data;
  String? version;
  int? statusCode;
  String? status;
  String? message;
  bool? success;

  ValueNotifier<CountryRes> defaultCountry = ValueNotifier(CountryRes(
      sId: "65d06d112421a196fc6e199e", name: 'nigeria', code: "NGN"));

  CountriesResponse(
      {this.data,
      this.version,
      this.statusCode,
      this.status,
      this.message,
      this.success = false});

  CountriesResponse.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    if (json['data'] != null) {
      data = ICountry.fromJson(json['data']);
    }

    version = json['version'];
    statusCode = json['statusCode'];
    status = json['status'];
    success = statusCode == 200 || statusCode == 201;
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    if (this.data != null) {
      data['data'] = data; //this.data!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    data['version'] = version;
    data['statusCode'] = statusCode;
    data['status'] = status;
    return data;
  }
}

class ICountry {
  List<CountryRes>? data;
  int? totalCount;

  ICountry({this.totalCount, this.data});

  ICountry.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    if (json['data'] != null) {
      data = <CountryRes>[];
      json['data'].forEach((v) {
        data!.add(CountryRes.fromJson(v));
      });
    }
    totalCount = json['totalCount'];
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    if (this.data != null) {
      data['data'] = this.data!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    data['totalCount'] = totalCount;
    return data;
  }
}

class CountryRes {
  String? sId;
  String? name;
  String? code;
  String? createdAt;
  String? updatedAt;
  String? countryFlag;
  int? iV;
  num? weeklyPrice;
  num? monthlyPrice;
  String get iCode {
    switch (code!.toLowerCase()) {
      case "zim":
        return "zw";
      case 'gh':
        return 'gh';
      case 'ngn':
        return 'ng';
      default:
        return code!.toLowerCase();
    }
  }

  //  String get iCode {
  //     switch (code!.toLowerCase()) {
  //       case "zim":
  //         return "zmw";
  //       case 'gh':
  //         return 'ghs';
  //       default:
  //         return "ngn";
  //     }
  //   }

  CountryRes(
      {this.sId,
      this.name,
      this.code,
      this.weeklyPrice,
      this.monthlyPrice,
      this.createdAt,
      this.updatedAt,
      this.iV,
      this.countryFlag});

  CountryRes.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    sId = json['_id'];
    name = json['name'];
    code = json['code'];
    countryFlag = json['country_flag'].toString();
    weeklyPrice = num.tryParse(json['weeklyPrice'].toString()) ?? 0;
    monthlyPrice = num.tryParse(json['monthlyPrice'].toString()) ?? 0;
    createdAt = json['createdAt'];
    updatedAt = json['updatedAt'];
    iV = json['__v'];
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    data['_id'] = sId;
    data['name'] = name;
    data['code'] = code;
    data['createdAt'] = createdAt;
    data['country_flag'] = countryFlag;
    data['updatedAt'] = updatedAt;
    data['weeklyPrice'] = weeklyPrice;
    data['monthlyPrice'] = monthlyPrice;
    data['__v'] = iV;
    return data;
  }

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'CountryRes{sId: $sId, name: $name, code: $code, createdAt: $createdAt, updatedAt: $updatedAt, iV: $iV, iCode:$iCode, weekly: $weeklyPrice, monthly:$monthlyPrice, countryFlag:$countryFlag}';
  }
}

CountryRes allAfricanCountryRes = CountryRes(

    countryFlag: 'ngn',
    createdAt: "",
    updatedAt: "",
    iV: 1,

class InputAssetCategory {
  final String oid;
  final String name;
  final String acronym;
  final dynamic readInputAssetTypes;
  final String createdBy;
  final DateTime createdOn;
  final String modifiedBy;
  final DateTime modifiedOn;
  final String deviceName;
  final String deviceIpAddress;
  final String deviceUserName;
  final num latitude;
  final num longitude;

  InputAssetCategory.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json)
      : oid = json['oid'] ?? '',
        name = json['name'] ?? '',
        acronym = json['acronym'] ?? '',
        readInputAssetTypes = json['readInputAssetTypes'],
        createdBy = json['createdBy'] ?? '',
        createdOn = DateTime.tryParse(json['createdOn'] ?? '') ?? DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0),
        modifiedBy = json['modifiedBy'] ?? '',
        modifiedOn = DateTime.tryParse(json['modifiedOn'] ?? '') ?? DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0),
        deviceName = json['deviceName'] ?? '',
        deviceIpAddress = json['deviceIpAddress'] ?? '',
        deviceUserName = json['deviceUserName'] ?? '',
        latitude = json['latitude'] ?? 0,
        longitude = json['longitude'] ?? 0;

//<editor-fold desc="Data Methods">
  const InputAssetCategory({
    required this.oid,
    required this.name,
    required this.acronym,
    required this.readInputAssetTypes,
    required this.createdBy,
    required this.createdOn,
    required this.modifiedBy,
    required this.modifiedOn,
    required this.deviceName,
    required this.deviceIpAddress,
    required this.deviceUserName,
    required this.latitude,
    required this.longitude,
  });

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      (other is InputAssetCategory &&
          runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
          oid == other.oid &&
          name == other.name &&
          acronym == other.acronym &&
          readInputAssetTypes == other.readInputAssetTypes &&
          createdBy == other.createdBy &&
          createdOn == other.createdOn &&
          modifiedBy == other.modifiedBy &&
          modifiedOn == other.modifiedOn &&
          deviceName == other.deviceName &&
          deviceIpAddress == other.deviceIpAddress &&
          deviceUserName == other.deviceUserName &&
          latitude == other.latitude &&
          longitude == other.longitude);

  @override
  int get hashCode =>
      oid.hashCode ^
      name.hashCode ^
      acronym.hashCode ^
      readInputAssetTypes.hashCode ^
      createdBy.hashCode ^
      createdOn.hashCode ^
      modifiedBy.hashCode ^
      modifiedOn.hashCode ^
      deviceName.hashCode ^
      deviceIpAddress.hashCode ^
      deviceUserName.hashCode ^
      latitude.hashCode ^
      longitude.hashCode;

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'InputAssetCategory{' +
        ' oid: $oid,' +
        ' name: $name,' +
        ' acronym: $acronym,' +
        ' readInputAssetTypes: $readInputAssetTypes,' +
        ' createdBy: $createdBy,' +
        ' createdOn: $createdOn,' +
        ' modifiedBy: $modifiedBy,' +
        ' modifiedOn: $modifiedOn,' +
        ' deviceName: $deviceName,' +
        ' deviceIpAddress: $deviceIpAddress,' +
        ' deviceUserName: $deviceUserName,' +
        ' latitude: $latitude,' +
        ' longitude: $longitude,' +
        '}';
  }

  InputAssetCategory copyWith({
    String? oid,
    String? name,
    String? acronym,
    dynamic? readInputAssetTypes,
    String? createdBy,
    DateTime? createdOn,
    String? modifiedBy,
    DateTime? modifiedOn,
    String? deviceName,
    String? deviceIpAddress,
    String? deviceUserName,
    num? latitude,
    num? longitude,
  }) {
    return InputAssetCategory(
      oid: oid ?? this.oid,
      name: name ?? this.name,
      acronym: acronym ?? this.acronym,
      readInputAssetTypes: readInputAssetTypes ?? this.readInputAssetTypes,
      createdBy: createdBy ?? this.createdBy,
      createdOn: createdOn ?? this.createdOn,
      modifiedBy: modifiedBy ?? this.modifiedBy,
      modifiedOn: modifiedOn ?? this.modifiedOn,
      deviceName: deviceName ?? this.deviceName,

      deviceUserName: deviceUserName ?? this.deviceUserName,
      latitude: latitude ?? this.latitude,
      longitude: longitude ?? this.longitude,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    return {
      'oid': oid,

import 'dart:convert';

LoginResponse loginModelFromJson(String str) => LoginResponse.fromJson(json.decode(str));
String loginModelToJson(LoginResponse data) => json.encode(data.toJson());

String loginModelDataToString(dynamic data) => json.encode(data);
dynamic loginModelDataToJson(String data) => json.decode(data);

class LoginResponse {
  bool? status;
  LoginRes? data;
  String? message;

  bool get success => status == true;

  LoginResponse({this.status, this.data, this.message});

  LoginResponse.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    status = json['status'];
    message = json['data']['message'];
    data = json['data'] != null ? LoginRes.fromJson(json['data']) : null;
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    data['status'] = status;
    if (this.data != null) {
      data['data'] = this.data!.toJson();
    }
    return data;
  }
}

class LoginRes {
  String? accessToken;
  String? tokenType;
  String? usertoken;
  ACUser? user;

  LoginRes({this.accessToken, this.tokenType, this.user, this.usertoken});

  LoginRes.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    accessToken = json['access_token'];
    tokenType = json['token_type'];
    usertoken = json['usertoken'];
    user = json['user'] != null ? ACUser.fromJson(json['user']) : null;
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    data['access_token'] = accessToken;
    data['token_type'] = tokenType;
    data['usertoken'] = usertoken;
    if (user != null) {
      data['user'] = user!.toJson();
    }
    return data;
  }
}

class ACUser {
  num? id;
  String? name;
  String? email;
  String? avatar;
  String? picture;
  num? balance;
  num? commission;
  String? phone;
  num? emailStatus;
  num? appStatus;
  String? affliateCode;
  String? refer;
  num? status;
  num? type;
  String? emailVerifiedAt;
  String? createdAt;
  String? updatedAt;
  String? tag;
  Usertag? usertag;

  ACUser(
      {this.id,
      this.name,
      this.email,
      this.avatar,
      this.picture,
      this.balance,
      this.commission,
      this.phone,
      this.emailStatus,
      this.appStatus,
      this.affliateCode,
      this.refer,
      this.status,
      this.type,
      this.emailVerifiedAt,
      this.createdAt,
      this.updatedAt,
      this.tag,
      this.usertag});

  ACUser.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    id = json['id'];
    name = json['name'];
    email = json['email'];
    avatar = json['avatar'];
    picture = json['picture'];
    balance = json['balance'];
    commission = json['commission'];
    phone = json['phone'];
    emailStatus = json['email_status'];
    appStatus = json['app_status'];
    affliateCode = json['affliate_code'];
    refer = json['refer'];
    status = json['status'];
    type = json['type'];
    emailVerifiedAt = json['email_verified_at'];
    createdAt = json['created_at'];
    updatedAt = json['updated_at'];
    tag = json['tag'];
    if (json['usertag'] != null) {
      usertag = Usertag.fromJson(json['usertag']);
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    data['id'] = id;
    data['name'] = name;
    data['email'] = email;
    data['avatar'] = avatar;
    data['picture'] = picture;
    data['balance'] = balance;
    data['commission'] = commission;
    data['phone'] = phone;
    data['email_status'] = emailStatus;
    data['app_status'] = appStatus;
    data['affliate_code'] = affliateCode;
    data['refer'] = refer;
    data['status'] = status;
    data['type'] = type;
    data['email_verified_at'] = emailVerifiedAt;
    data['created_at'] = createdAt;
    data['updated_at'] = updatedAt;
    data['tag'] = tag;
    data['usertag'] = usertag?.toJson();
    return data;
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/model/notification-response.dart ===== */
class NotificationModel {
  NotificationRes? data;
  int? statusCode;
  String? status;

  NotificationModel({this.data, this.statusCode, this.status});

  NotificationModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    data = json['data'] != null ? NotificationRes.fromJson(json['data']) : null;
    statusCode = json['statusCode'];
    status = json['status'];
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    if (this.data != null) {
      data['data'] = this.data!.toJson();
    }
    data['statusCode'] = statusCode;
    data['status'] = status;
    return data;
  }
}

class NotificationRes {
  int? totalCount;
  List<NotificationData>? data;

  NotificationRes({this.totalCount, this.data});

  NotificationRes.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    totalCount = json['totalCount'];
    if (json['data'] != null) {
      data = <NotificationData>[];
      json['data'].forEach((v) {
        data!.add(NotificationData.fromJson(v));
      });
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    data['totalCount'] = totalCount;
    if (this.data != null) {
      data['data'] = this.data!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    return data;
  }
}

class NotificationData {
  String? sId;
  String? tag;
  String? title;
  String? customer;
  String? content;
  String? status;
  String? createdAt;
  String? updatedAt;
  int? iV;

  NotificationData(
      {this.sId,
      this.tag,
      this.title,
      this.customer,
      this.content,
      this.status,
      this.createdAt,
      this.updatedAt,
      this.iV});

  NotificationData.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    sId = json['_id'];
    tag = json['tag'];
    title = json['title'];
    customer = json['customer'];
    content = json['content'];
    status = json['status'];
    createdAt = json['createdAt'];
    updatedAt = json['updatedAt'];
    iV = json['__v'];
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    data['_id'] = sId;
    data['tag'] = tag;
    data['title'] = title;
    data['customer'] = customer;
    data['content'] = content;
    data['status'] = status;
    data['createdAt'] = createdAt;
    data['updatedAt'] = updatedAt;
    data['__v'] = iV;
    return data;
  }
}

class PDOResponse {

    this.count,
    this.message,
    this.data,
  });

  factory PDOResponse.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => PDOResponse(
        count: json['count'] as num?,
        message: json['message'] as String?,
        data: (json['data'] as List<dynamic>?)?.map((e) => PDOIndicatorModel.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList(),
      );
}

class PDOIndicatorModel {
  final num? baseline;
  final String? description;
  final String? frequency;
  final bool? isParent;
  final String? name;
  final String? parentId;
  final String? pbc;
  final String? sequence;
  final String? valueType;
  final String? unitOfMeasure;
  final List<dynamic>? subComponents;
  final List<dynamic>? targets;
  final String? oid;
  final String? createdBy;
  final DateTime? createdOn;
  final String? modifiedBy;
  final DateTime? modifiedOn;
  final String? deviceName;
  final String? deviceIpAddress;
  final String? deviceUserName;
  final num? latitude;
  final num? longitude;

  PDOIndicatorModel({
    this.baseline,
    this.description,
    this.frequency,
    this.isParent,
    this.name,
    this.parentId,
    this.pbc,
    this.sequence,
    this.valueType,
    this.unitOfMeasure,
    this.subComponents,
    this.targets,
    this.oid,
    this.createdBy,
    this.createdOn,
    this.modifiedBy,
    this.modifiedOn,
    this.deviceName,
    this.deviceIpAddress,
    this.deviceUserName,
    this.latitude,
    this.longitude,
  });

  factory PDOIndicatorModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => PDOIndicatorModel(
        baseline: (json['baseline'] as num?)?.toDouble(),
        description: json['description'] as String?,
        frequency: json['frequency'] as String?,
        isParent: json['isParent'] as bool?,
        name: json['name'] as String?,
        parentId: json['parentId'] as String?,
        pbc: json['pbc'] as String?,
        sequence: json['sequence'] as String?,
        valueType: json['valueType'] as String?,
        unitOfMeasure: json['unitOfMeasure'] as String?,
        subComponents: json['subComponents'] as List<dynamic>?,
        targets: json['targets'] as List<dynamic>?,
        oid: json['oid'] as String?,
        createdBy: json['createdBy'] as String?,
        createdOn: json['createdOn'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['createdOn'] as String) : null,
        modifiedBy: json['modifiedBy'] as String?,
        modifiedOn: json['modifiedOn'] != null ? DateTime.tryParse(json['modifiedOn'] as String) : null,
        deviceName: json['deviceName'] as String?,
        deviceIpAddress: json['deviceIpAddress'] as String?,
        deviceUserName: json['deviceUserName'] as String?,
        latitude: (json['latitude'] as num?)?.toDouble(),
        longitude: (json['longitude'] as num?)?.toDouble(),
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'baseline': this.baseline,
      'description': this.description,
      'frequency': this.frequency,
      'isParent': this.isParent,
      'name': this.name,
      'parentId': this.parentId,
      'pbc': this.pbc,
      'sequence': this.sequence,
      'valueType': this.valueType,
      'unitOfMeasure': this.unitOfMeasure,
      'subComponents': this.subComponents,
      'targets': this.targets,
      'oid': this.oid,
      'createdBy': this.createdBy,
      'createdOn': this.createdOn,
      'modifiedBy': this.modifiedBy,
      'modifiedOn': this.modifiedOn,
      'deviceName': this.deviceName,
      'deviceIpAddress': this.deviceIpAddress,
      'deviceUserName': this.deviceUserName,
      'latitude': this.latitude,
      'longitude': this.longitude,
    };
  }

  factory PDOIndicatorModel.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return PDOIndicatorModel(
      baseline: map['baseline'] as num,
      description: map['description'] as String,
      frequency: map['frequency'] as String,
      isParent: map['isParent'] as bool,
      name: map['name'] as String,
      parentId: map['parentId'] as String,
      pbc: map['pbc'] as String,
      sequence: map['sequence'] as String,
      valueType: map['valueType'] as String,
      unitOfMeasure: map['unitOfMeasure'] as String,
      subComponents: map['subComponents'] as List<dynamic>,
      targets: map['targets'] as List<dynamic>,
      oid: map['oid'] as String,
      createdBy: map['createdBy'] as String,
      createdOn: map['createdOn'] as DateTime,
      modifiedBy: map['modifiedBy'] as String,
      modifiedOn: map['modifiedOn'] as DateTime,
      deviceName: map['deviceName'] as String,
      deviceIpAddress: map['deviceIpAddress'] as String,
      deviceUserName: map['deviceUserName'] as String,
      latitude: map['latitude'] as num,
      longitude: map['longitude'] as num,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toPDOMap() {
    return {
      "indicatorType": "PDO",
      'baseline': this.baseline,
      'description': this.description,
      'frequency': this.frequency,
      'isParent': this.isParent,

      'longitude': this.longitude,
    };
  }
}

class ProfessionResponse {
  int? count;
  String? message;
  List<Profession>? data;

  ProfessionResponse({this.count, this.message, this.data});

  ProfessionResponse.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    count = json['count'];
    message = json['message'];
    if (json['data'] != null) {
      data = <Profession>[];
      json['data'].forEach((v) {
        data!.add(Profession.fromJson(v));
      });
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> result = <String, dynamic>{};
    result['count'] = count;
    result['message'] = message;
    if (data != null) {
      result['data'] = data!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    return result;
  }
}

class Address {
  String? address;
  String? city;
  String? country;
  String? postalCode;

//<editor-fold desc="Data Methods">
  Address({
    this.address,
    this.city,
    this.country,
    this.postalCode,
  });

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      (other is Address &&
          runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
          address == other.address &&
          city == other.city &&
          country == other.country &&
          postalCode == other.postalCode);

  @override
  int get hashCode =>
      address.hashCode ^ city.hashCode ^ country.hashCode ^ postalCode.hashCode;

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'Address{ address: $address, city: $city, country: $country, postalCode: $postalCode,}';
  }

  Address copyWith({
    String? address,
    String? city,
    String? country,
    String? postalCode,
  }) {
    return Address(
      address: address ?? this.address,
      city: city ?? this.city,
      country: country ?? this.country,
      postalCode: postalCode ?? this.postalCode,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'address_': address,
      'city': city,
      'country': country,
      'postalCode': postalCode,
    };
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toPartyRequestMap() {
    return {
      'address_': address,
      'city': city,
      'country': country,
      'postcode': postalCode,
    };
  }

  factory Address.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return Address(
      address: map['address'] as String,
      city: map['city'] as String,
      country: map['country'] as String,
      postalCode: map['postalCode'] as String,
    );
  }
  factory Address.fromPartyMealsMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return Address(
      address: map['address_'] as String,
      city: map['city'] as String,
      country: map['country'] as String,
      postalCode: map['postcode'] as String,
    );
  }

//</editor-fold>
}

/* ===== lib/src/model/request/auth.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/string-extensions.dart';

class LoginRequest {
  final String? email;
  String? password;
  String? userName;
  String? securityPin;
  LoginRequest({this.email, this.password, this.userName});

  LoginRequest.withPin({this.email, this.securityPin});

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {'email': email, if (password.isNotNullNorEmpty) 'password': password, if (securityPin.isNotNullNorEmpty) "security_pin": securityPin};
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toAcreasalLogin() {
    return {
      'userName': userName,
      'password': password,
    };
  }

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'LoginRequest{email: $email, password: $password, userName: $userName, securityPin: $securityPin}';
  }
}

class SignUpRequest {
  final String? email;
  final String? password;
  final String? name;
  final String? phone;
  final String? passwordConfirmation;
  SignUpRequest({
    this.email,
    this.password,
    this.phone,
    this.passwordConfirmation,
    this.name,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'email': email,
      'password': password,
      'name': name,
      'phone': phone,
      'password_confirmation': passwordConfirmation,
    };
  }

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'SignUpRequest{email: $email, password: $password, name: $name, phone: $phone, passwordConfirmation: $passwordConfirmation}';
  }
}

class VerifyEmailRequest {
  final String? email;
  String? verifyCode;

  VerifyEmailRequest({this.email, this.verifyCode});

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'email': email,
      'verify_code': verifyCode,
    };
  }

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'VerifyEmailRequest{email: $email, verifyCode: $verifyCode}';
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:hive/hive.dart';

part 'create-activity-model.g.dart';

@HiveType(typeId: 1) // Changed typeId for enum
enum UploadStatus {
  @HiveField(0)
  queued,

  @HiveField(1)
  uploaded,
}

extension NotificationStatusColor on UploadStatus {
  Color get color {
    switch (this) {
      case UploadStatus.queued:
        return const Color(0xFFFFA500); // Orange
      case UploadStatus.uploaded:
        return Colors.green;
    }
  }
}

@HiveType(typeId: 0) // Changed typeId for class
class IActivity {
  @HiveField(0)
  final String id;

  @HiveField(1)
  final String title;

  @HiveField(2)
  final String details;

  @HiveField(3)
  final DateTime date;

  @HiveField(4)
  UploadStatus status;

  IActivity({
    required this.id,
    required this.title,
    required this.details,
    DateTime? date,
    this.status = UploadStatus.queued,
  }) : date = date ?? DateTime.now();

  // Add this for Hive to work properly
  IActivity.empty()
      : id = '',
        title = '',
        details = '',
        date = DateTime.now(),
        status = UploadStatus.queued;

  IActivity copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? title,
    String? details,
    DateTime? date,
    UploadStatus? status,
  }) {
    return IActivity(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      title: title ?? this.title,
      details: details ?? this.details,
      date: date ?? this.date,
      status: status ?? this.status,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is IActivity && runtimeType == other.runtimeType && id == other.id && title == other.title && details == other.details && date == other.date && status == other.status;

  @override
  int get hashCode => id.hashCode ^ title.hashCode ^ details.hashCode ^ date.hashCode ^ status.hashCode;
}

      ..writeByte(2)

      ..writeByte(3)

class UploadStatusAdapter extends TypeAdapter<UploadStatus> {
  @override
  final int typeId = 1;

  @override
  UploadStatus read(BinaryReader reader) {
    switch (reader.readByte()) {
      case 0:
        return UploadStatus.queued;
      case 1:
        return UploadStatus.uploaded;
      default:
        return UploadStatus.queued;
    }
  }

  @override
  void write(BinaryWriter writer, UploadStatus obj) {
    switch (obj) {
      case UploadStatus.queued:
        writer.writeByte(0);
        break;
      case UploadStatus.uploaded:
        writer.writeByte(1);
        break;
    }
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode => typeId.hashCode;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is UploadStatusAdapter &&
          runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
          typeId == other.typeId;
}

class InputAssetTypeResponse {
  final int count;
  final String message;
  final List<InputAssetType> data;

  InputAssetTypeResponse({
    required this.count,
    required this.message,
    required this.data,
  });

  factory InputAssetTypeResponse.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    List<InputAssetType> items = [];

    if (json['data'] != null) {
      json['data'].forEach((v) {
        items.add(InputAssetType.fromJson(v));
      });
    }

    return InputAssetTypeResponse(
      count: json['count'] ?? 0,
      message: json['message'] ?? '',
      data: items,
    );
  }
}

// Function to convert a complex nested Map to AfforestActivity object
AfforestActivity mapToMISData(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
  String? photoBase64 = filePathToBase64Sync(map['catchmentImage']?.toString());
  // String? torBase64 = _filePathToBase64Sync(map['tor1']?.toString());

  try {
    return AfforestActivity(
      // Project and basic info
      projectID: map['projectId']?.toString(),
      creditID: map['creditId']?.toString(),
      description: map['description']?.toString(),
      //uniqueID: _generateUniqueId(map),

      // Financial information
      budgetAmountNGN: _safeParseNum(map['financialBudgetedAmountNgn']),
      amountDisbursedNGN: _safeParseNum(map['financialAmountDisbursedNgn']),
      budgetAmountUSD: _safeParseNum(map['financialBudgetedAmountUsd']),
      amountDisbursedUSD: _safeParseNum(map['financialAmountDisbursedUsd']),
      rateOfNGNToUSD: _safeParseNum(map['financialRateOfNgnToUsd']),

      // Date information
      expectedStartDate: safeParseDateTime(map['actualStartDate']),
      actualStartDate: safeParseDateTime(map['actualStartDate']), //_safeParseDateTime(map['actualStartDate']),
      expectedEndDate: safeParseDateTime(map['actualEndDate']),
      actualEndDate: safeParseDateTime(map['actualEndDate']), //_safeParseDateTime(map['actualEndDate']),

      // Afforestation specific data
      areaOfIntervention: _safeParseNum(map[AfEnum.totalAreaRestored.key]),
      actualSizeOfInterventionFromShapeFiles: _safeParseNum(map['actualSizeOfIntervention']),
      noOfTreesPlanted: _safeParseNum(map['noOfTreesPlanted']),
      totalAreaRestored: _safeParseNum(map['totalAreaRestored']),
      totalAreaRecovered: _safeParseNum(map['hectaresRestored']),
      species: map['species']?.toString(),
      treePlantedCoordinates: map['treesPlantedCoordinates']?.toString(),
      spacing: _safeParseNum(map['spacing']),

      // Component and organizational structure
      componentCode: _getNestedValue(map, ['subComponent', 'componentOid'])?.toString(),
      componentOid: _getNestedValue(map, ['subComponent', 'componentOid'])?.toString(),
      subComponentOid: _getNestedValue(map, ['subComponent', 'oid'])?.toString(),

      // Geographic information
      stateOid: _getNestedValue(map, ['state', 'oid'])?.toString(),
      lgaOid: _getNestedValue(map, ['localGovernmentArea', 'oid'])?.toString(),
      siteOid: _getNestedValue(map, ['site', 'oid'])?.toString(),
      natureOfInterventionOid: _getNestedValue(map, ['natureOfIntervention', 'name'])?.toString(),
      interventionCategoryOid: _getNestedValue(map, ['interventionCategory', 'name'])?.toString(),

      // Indicators
      pdoLevelIndicatorOid: _getNestedValue(map, ['pdoIndicator', 'name'])?.toString(),
      componentLevelIndicatorOid: _getNestedValue(map, ['componentLevelIndicator', 'oid'])?.toString(),

      // Photos/Documents (TOR)
      photo: photoBase64, //map['catchmentImage']?.toString(),
      torOid: map['tor1']?['oid'], // Using tor1 as primary TOR

      // Device and audit information
      deviceName: _getNestedValue(map, ['implementer', 'deviceName'])?.toString(),
      deviceIpAddress: _getNestedValue(map, ['implementer', 'deviceIpAddress'])?.toString(),
      deviceUserName: _getNestedValue(map, ['implementer', 'deviceUserName'])?.toString(),
      createdBy: _getNestedValue(map, ['implementer', 'createdBy'])?.toString(),
      createdOn: safeParseDateTime(_getNestedValue(map, ['implementer', 'createdOn'])),

      // Coordinates (if available in nested data)
      latitude: _getNestedValue(map, ['implementer', 'latitude']) != null ? _safeParseNum(_getNestedValue(map, ['implementer', 'latitude'])) : null,
      longitude: _getNestedValue(map, ['implementer', 'longitude']) != null ? _safeParseNum(_getNestedValue(map, ['implementer', 'longitude'])) : null,

      // Generate a unique ID if not present
      activityID: _generateActivityId(map),
      uniqueID: _generateUniqueId(map),

      // Default or derived values
      status: "Draft", // Default status for new activities
      comments: null,
      code: _getNestedValue(map, ['subComponent', 'code'])?.toString(),
      perCtNDV: 0,
      natureOfIntervention: _getNestedValue(map, ['natureOfIntervention', 'name'])?.toString(),
      implementer: _getNestedValue(map, ['implementer', 'name'])?.toString(),
      lga: _getNestedValue(map, ['localGovernmentArea', 'name'])?.toString(),
      state: _getNestedValue(map, ['state', 'name'])?.toString(),
      siteName: _getNestedValue(map, ['site', 'name'])?.toString(),
      strategicCatchment: _getNestedValue(map, ['strategicCatchment', 'name'])?.toString(),
    );
    //pdo indicator,state id,component (something like a2 dash),subcomponent, general cat intervention
  } catch (e) {
    print('Error converting map to AfforestActivity: $e');
    rethrow;
  }
}

// Helper function to safely parse numbers
num? _safeParseNum(dynamic value) {
  if (value == null) return null;
  if (value is num) return value;
  if (value is String) {
    return num.tryParse(value);
  }
  return null;
}

// Helper function to safely parse DateTime
DateTime? safeParseDateTime(dynamic value) {
  if (value == null) return null;
  if (value is DateTime) return value;
  if (value is String) {
    try {
      return DateTime.parse(value);
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error parsing DateTime: $value');
      return null;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

// Helper function to get nested values safely
dynamic _getNestedValue(Map<String, dynamic> map, List<String> keys) {
  dynamic current = map;
  for (String key in keys) {
    if (current is Map<String, dynamic> && current.containsKey(key)) {
      current = current[key];
    } else {
      return null;
    }
  }
  return current;
}

// Helper function to generate activity ID
String _generateActivityId(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
  final projectId = map['projectId']?.toString() ?? '';
  final componentCode = _getNestedValue(map, ['subComponent', 'code'])?.toString() ?? '';
  final timestamp = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;

  return '${projectId}_${componentCode}_$timestamp';
}

// Helper function to generate unique ID
String _generateUniqueId(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
  final siteCode = _getNestedValue(map, ['site', 'code'])?.toString() ?? '';
  final timestamp = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;

  return '${siteCode}_$timestamp';
}

// Batch conversion function for multiple maps
List<AfforestActivity> mapListToAfforestActivities(List<Map<String, dynamic>> mapList) {
  return mapList.map((map) => mapToMISData(map)).toList();
}

// Validation function to check if conversion was successful
bool validateConversion(Map<String, dynamic> originalMap, AfforestActivity activity) {
  // Basic validation checks
  return activity.projectID == originalMap['projectId']?.toString() &&
      activity.creditID == originalMap['creditId']?.toString() &&
      activity.description == originalMap['description']?.toString() &&
      activity.species == originalMap['species']?.toString();
}

// Helper function to convert file path to base64 string
Future<String?> _filePathToBase64(String? filePath) async {
  if (filePath == null || filePath.isEmpty) return null;

  try {
    final file = File(filePath);
    if (await file.exists()) {
      final bytes = await file.readAsBytes();
      return base64Encode(bytes);
    } else {
      print('File does not exist: $filePath');
      return null;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    print('Error converting file to base64: $e');
    return null;
  }
}

// Synchronous version using File.readAsBytesSync() - use with caution for large files
String? filePathToBase64Sync(String? filePath) {
  if (filePath == null || filePath.isEmpty) return null;

  try {
    final file = File(filePath);
    if (file.existsSync()) {
      final bytes = file.readAsBytesSync();
      return base64Encode(bytes);
    } else {
      print('File does not exist: $filePath');
      return null;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    print('Error converting file to base64: $e');
    return null;
  }
}

import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/save-activity-utils.dart';
import 'package:hive/hive.dart';

part 'save-activity.g.dart';

@HiveType(typeId: 0)
class SaveActivity {
  @HiveField(0)
  final String projectId;

  @HiveField(1)
  final String creditId;

  @HiveField(2)
  final String component;

  @HiveField(3)
  final ISubComponent subComponent;

  @HiveField(4)
  final String code;

  @HiveField(5)
  DateTime? expectedStartDate;

  @HiveField(6)
  DateTime? actualStartDate;

  @HiveField(7)
  DateTime? expectedEndDate;

  @HiveField(8)
  DateTime? actualEndDate;

  @HiveField(9)
  double budgetAmountUSD = 0.0;

  @HiveField(10)
  double amountDisbursedUSD = 0.0;

  @HiveField(11)
  double rateNGNtoUSD = 0.0;

  @HiveField(12)
  double budgetAmountNGN = 0.0;

  @HiveField(13)
  double amountDisbursedNGN = 0.0;

  @HiveField(14)
  String termsOfReference = '';

  @HiveField(15)
  UploadStatus uploadStatus = UploadStatus.queued;

  // Public constructor required by Hive
  SaveActivity({
    required this.projectId,
    required this.creditId,
    required this.component,
    required this.subComponent,
    required this.code,
    // Initialize other fields with default values
    this.expectedStartDate,
    this.actualStartDate,
    this.expectedEndDate,
    this.actualEndDate,
    this.budgetAmountUSD = 0.0,
    this.amountDisbursedUSD = 0.0,
    this.rateNGNtoUSD = 0.0,
    this.budgetAmountNGN = 0.0,
    this.amountDisbursedNGN = 0.0,
    this.termsOfReference = '',
    this.uploadStatus = UploadStatus.queued,
  });

  // Private constructor
  SaveActivity._({
    required this.projectId,
    required this.creditId,
    required this.component,
    required this.subComponent,
    required this.code,
  });

  // Factory method for initialization
  factory SaveActivity.fromInitialValues({
    required String component,
    required ISubComponent subComponent,
    required String code,
  }) {
    return SaveActivity._(
      projectId: SaveActivityUtils.generateProjectId(),
      creditId: SaveActivityUtils.generateCreditId(),
      component: component,
      subComponent: subComponent,
      code: code,
    );
  }

  // Add empty constructor for Hive
  SaveActivity.empty()
      : projectId = '',
        creditId = '',
        component = '',
        subComponent = SubComponent.empty(),
        code = '';

  // CopyWith method
  SaveActivity copyWith({
    DateTime? expectedStartDate,
    DateTime? actualStartDate,
    DateTime? expectedEndDate,
    DateTime? actualEndDate,
    double? budgetAmountUSD,
    double? amountDisbursedUSD,
    double? rateNGNtoUSD,
    double? budgetAmountNGN,
    double? amountDisbursedNGN,
    String? termsOfReference,
    UploadStatus? uploadStatus,
  }) {
    return SaveActivity._(
      projectId: projectId,
      creditId: creditId,
      component: component,
      subComponent: subComponent,
      code: code,
    )
      ..expectedStartDate = expectedStartDate ?? this.expectedStartDate
      ..actualStartDate = actualStartDate ?? this.actualStartDate
      ..expectedEndDate = expectedEndDate ?? this.expectedEndDate
      ..actualEndDate = actualEndDate ?? this.actualEndDate
      ..budgetAmountUSD = budgetAmountUSD ?? this.budgetAmountUSD
      ..amountDisbursedUSD = amountDisbursedUSD ?? this.amountDisbursedUSD
      ..rateNGNtoUSD = rateNGNtoUSD ?? this.rateNGNtoUSD
      ..budgetAmountNGN = budgetAmountNGN ?? this.budgetAmountNGN
      ..amountDisbursedNGN = amountDisbursedNGN ?? this.amountDisbursedNGN
      ..termsOfReference = termsOfReference ?? this.termsOfReference
      ..uploadStatus = uploadStatus ?? this.uploadStatus;
  }
}

// SubComponent Interface
abstract class ISubComponent {
  String get name;
  String get code;
}

// Hive-compatible implementation
@HiveType(typeId: 1)
class SubComponent implements ISubComponent {
  @HiveField(0)
  final String name;

  @HiveField(1)
  final String code;

  SubComponent({required this.name, required this.code});

  factory SubComponent.empty() => SubComponent(name: '', code: '');
}

@HiveType(typeId: 2)
enum UploadStatus {
  @HiveField(0)
  queued,

  @HiveField(1)
  uploaded,
}

      ..write(obj.creditId)
      ..writeByte(2)
      ..write(obj.component)
      ..writeByte(3)
      ..write(obj.subComponent)
      ..writeByte(4)
      ..write(obj.code)
      ..writeByte(5)
      ..write(obj.expectedStartDate)
      ..writeByte(6)
      ..write(obj.actualStartDate)
      ..writeByte(7)
      ..write(obj.expectedEndDate)
      ..writeByte(8)
      ..write(obj.actualEndDate)
      ..writeByte(9)
      ..write(obj.budgetAmountUSD)
      ..writeByte(10)
      ..write(obj.amountDisbursedUSD)
      ..writeByte(11)
      ..write(obj.rateNGNtoUSD)
      ..writeByte(12)
      ..write(obj.budgetAmountNGN)
      ..writeByte(13)
      ..write(obj.amountDisbursedNGN)
      ..writeByte(14)
      ..write(obj.termsOfReference)
      ..writeByte(15)
      ..write(obj.uploadStatus);
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode => typeId.hashCode;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is SaveActivityAdapter &&
          runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
          typeId == other.typeId;
}

class SubComponentAdapter extends TypeAdapter<SubComponent> {
  @override
  final int typeId = 1;

  @override
  SubComponent read(BinaryReader reader) {
    final numOfFields = reader.readByte();
    final fields = <int, dynamic>{
      for (int i = 0; i < numOfFields; i++) reader.readByte(): reader.read(),
    };
    return SubComponent(
      name: fields[0] as String,
      code: fields[1] as String,
    );
  }

  @override
  void write(BinaryWriter writer, SubComponent obj) {
    writer
      ..writeByte(2)
      ..writeByte(0)
      ..write(obj.name)
      ..writeByte(1)
      ..write(obj.code);
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode => typeId.hashCode;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is SubComponentAdapter &&
          runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
          typeId == other.typeId;
}

class UploadStatusAdapter extends TypeAdapter<UploadStatus> {
  @override
  final int typeId = 2;

  @override
  UploadStatus read(BinaryReader reader) {
    switch (reader.readByte()) {
      case 0:
        return UploadStatus.queued;
      case 1:
        return UploadStatus.uploaded;
      default:
        return UploadStatus.queued;
    }
  }

  @override
  void write(BinaryWriter writer, UploadStatus obj) {
    switch (obj) {
      case UploadStatus.queued:
        writer.writeByte(0);
        break;
      case UploadStatus.uploaded:
        writer.writeByte(1);
        break;
    }
  }

  @override
  int get hashCode => typeId.hashCode;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is UploadStatusAdapter &&
          runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
          typeId == other.typeId;
}

/* ===== lib/src/model/request/user.dart ===== */
class UpdateUserRequest {
  final String? gender;
  final String? avatar;
  final Address? address;
  final String? firstName;
  final String? lastName;
  final String? email;
  final String? phone;

  UpdateUserRequest(
      {this.avatar,
      this.gender,
      this.address,
      this.phone,
      this.firstName,
      this.lastName,
      this.email});

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'UpdateUserRequest{gender: $gender, avatar: $avatar, address: ${address.toString()}}';
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    Map<String, dynamic> map = {
      'first_name': firstName,
      'last_name': lastName,
      'phone': phone,
      'email': email,
      'gender': gender,
      'avatar': avatar,
      'address': address?.toMap(),
    };
    map.removeWhere((key, value) => value == null);
    return map;
  }

  factory UpdateUserRequest.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return UpdateUserRequest(
      gender: map['gender'] as String,
      avatar: map['avatar'] as String,
      address: map['address'] as Address,
    );
  }
}

class Address {
  String? address_;
  String? city;
  String? postcode;
  String? country;
  Address({this.country, this.address_, this.city, this.postcode});

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is Address &&
          runtimeType == other.runtimeType &&
          address_ == other.address_ &&
          city == other.city &&
          postcode == other.postcode &&
          country == other.country;

  @override
  int get hashCode =>
      address_.hashCode ^ city.hashCode ^ postcode.hashCode ^ country.hashCode;

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    Map<String, dynamic> map = {
      'address_': address_,
      'city': city,
      'postcode': postcode,
      'country': country,
    };
    map.removeWhere((key, value) => value == null);
    return map;
  }

  factory Address.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return Address(
      address_: map['address_'] as String,
      city: map['city'] as String,
      postcode: map['postcode'] as String,
      country: map['country'] as String,
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

ResModel resModelFromJson(String str) => ResModel.fromJson(json.decode(str));
String resModelToJson(ResModel data) => json.encode(data.toJson());

String resModelDataToString(dynamic data) => json.encode(data);
dynamic resModelDataToJson(String data) => json.decode(data);

class ResModel {
  dynamic data;
  int? statusCode;
  bool? status;
  String? message;
  bool? success;
  bool? down;
  String? info;

  ResModel({this.data, this.statusCode, this.status = false, this.message, this.info, this.down, this.success = false});

  ResModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    data = json['data'];
    statusCode = json['statusCode'];
    status = json['status'];
// Better message handling
    message = json['message'] ?? json['Message'] ?? (json['data'] is Map ? json['data']['message'] : null) ?? 'Unknown error';
    info = json['info'];
    down = json['down'];
    success = statusCode == 200 || statusCode == 201;
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    if (this.data != null) {
      data['data'] = this.data!.toJson();
    }
    data['statusCode'] = statusCode;
    data['status'] = status;
    data['message'] = message;
    data['down'] = down;
    data['success'] = success;
    data['info'] = info;
    return data;
  }

  @override
  String toString() {
    return 'ResModel{data: ${data.toString()}, statusCode: $statusCode, status: $status, message: $message, success: $success, info:$info, down:$down}';
  }

  ResModel copyWith({
    dynamic data,
    int? statusCode,
    bool? status,
    bool? down,
    String? message,
    bool? success,
    String? info,
  }) {
    return ResModel(
        data: data ?? this.data,
        statusCode: statusCode ?? this.statusCode,
        status: status ?? this.status,
        message: message ?? this.message,
        success: success ?? this.success,
        info: info ?? this.info,
        down: down ?? this.down);
  }
}

class Autogenerated {
  num? count;
  String? message;
  List<Data>? data;

  Autogenerated({this.count, this.message, this.data});

  Autogenerated.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    count = json['count'];
    message = json['message'];
    if (json['data'] != null) {
      data = <Data>[];
      json['data'].forEach((v) {
        data!.add(new Data.fromJson(v));
      });
    }
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = new Map<String, dynamic>();
    data['count'] = this.count;
    data['message'] = this.message;
    if (this.data != null) {
      data['data'] = this.data!.map((v) => v.toJson()).toList();
    }
    return data;
  }
}

T? findByField<T, V>(
  List<T> list,
  V Function(T item) fieldSelector,
  V value,
) {
  try {
    return list.firstWhere(
      (item) => fieldSelector(item) == value,
    );
  } catch (e) {
    return null; // return null if not found
  }
}

class WeatherRes {
  Location? location;
  Current? current;

  WeatherRes({this.location, this.current});

  WeatherRes.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    location = json['location'] != null ? Location.fromJson(json['location']) : null;
    current = json['current'] != null ? Current.fromJson(json['current']) : null;
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    if (location != null) {
      data['location'] = location!.toJson();
    }
    if (current != null) {
      data['current'] = current!.toJson();
    }
    return data;
  }
}

class Location {

  num? lat;
  num? lon;

  num? localtimeEpoch;

    name = json['name'];
    region = json['region'];
    country = json['country'];
    lat = json['lat'];
    lon = json['lon'];
    tzId = json['tz_id'];
    localtimeEpoch = json['localtime_epoch'];
    localtime = json['localtime'];
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {

    data['name'] = name;
    data['region'] = region;
    data['country'] = country;
    data['lat'] = lat;
    data['lon'] = lon;
    data['tz_id'] = tzId;
    data['localtime_epoch'] = localtimeEpoch;
    data['localtime'] = localtime;
    return data;
  }
}

      this.condition,
      this.windMph,
      this.windKph,
      this.windDegree,
      this.windDir,
      this.pressureMb,
      this.pressureIn,
      this.precipMm,
      this.precipIn,
      this.humidity,
      this.cloud,
      this.feelslikeC,
      this.feelslikeF,
      this.windchillC,
      this.windchillF,
      this.heatindexC,
      this.heatindexF,
      this.dewpointC,
      this.dewpointF,
      this.visKm,
      this.visMiles,
      this.uv,
      this.gustMph,
      this.gustKph});

  Current.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    lastUpdatedEpoch = json['last_updated_epoch'];
    lastUpdated = json['last_updated'];
    tempC = json['temp_c'];
    tempF = json['temp_f'];
    isDay = json['is_day'];
    condition = json['condition'] != null ? Condition.fromJson(json['condition']) : null;
    windMph = json['wind_mph'];
    windKph = json['wind_kph'];
    windDegree = json['wind_degree'];
    windDir = json['wind_dir'];
    pressureMb = json['pressure_mb'];
    pressureIn = json['pressure_in'];
    precipMm = json['precip_mm'];
    precipIn = json['precip_in'];
    humidity = json['humidity'];
    cloud = json['cloud'];
    feelslikeC = json['feelslike_c'];
    feelslikeF = json['feelslike_f'];
    windchillC = json['windchill_c'];
    windchillF = json['windchill_f'];
    heatindexC = json['heatindex_c'];
    heatindexF = json['heatindex_f'];
    dewpointC = json['dewpoint_c'];
    dewpointF = json['dewpoint_f'];
    visKm = json['vis_km'];
    visMiles = json['vis_miles'];
    uv = json['uv'];
    gustMph = json['gust_mph'];
    gustKph = json['gust_kph'];
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    data['last_updated_epoch'] = lastUpdatedEpoch;
    data['last_updated'] = lastUpdated;
    data['temp_c'] = tempC;
    data['temp_f'] = tempF;
    data['is_day'] = isDay;
    if (condition != null) {
      data['condition'] = condition!.toJson();
    }
    data['wind_mph'] = windMph;
    data['wind_kph'] = windKph;
    data['wind_degree'] = windDegree;
    data['wind_dir'] = windDir;
    data['pressure_mb'] = pressureMb;
    data['pressure_in'] = pressureIn;
    data['precip_mm'] = precipMm;
    data['precip_in'] = precipIn;
    data['humidity'] = humidity;
    data['cloud'] = cloud;
    data['feelslike_c'] = feelslikeC;
    data['feelslike_f'] = feelslikeF;
    data['windchill_c'] = windchillC;
    data['windchill_f'] = windchillF;
    data['heatindex_c'] = heatindexC;
    data['heatindex_f'] = heatindexF;
    data['dewpoint_c'] = dewpointC;
    data['dewpoint_f'] = dewpointF;
    data['vis_km'] = visKm;
    data['vis_miles'] = visMiles;
    data['uv'] = uv;
    data['gust_mph'] = gustMph;
    data['gust_kph'] = gustKph;
    return data;
  }
}

class Condition {
  String? text;
  String? icon;
  num? code;

  Condition({this.text, this.icon, this.code});

  Condition.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    text = json['text'];
    icon = json['icon'];
    code = json['code'];
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{};
    data['text'] = text;
    data['icon'] = icon;
    data['code'] = code;
    return data;
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

// Main wrapper to apply at the root of your app
class ConnectivityWrapper extends StatefulWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final Duration checkInterval; // Optional periodic checking

  const ConnectivityWrapper({
    Key? key,
    required this.child,
    this.checkInterval = const Duration(seconds: 10),
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _ConnectivityWrapperState createState() => _ConnectivityWrapperState();
}

class _ConnectivityWrapperState extends State<ConnectivityWrapper> {
  late ConnectivityService _service;
  Timer? _periodicCheckTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _service = ConnectivityService();
    _service.initialize();

    // Optional: Periodically check connectivity
    if (widget.checkInterval.inSeconds > 0) {
      _periodicCheckTimer = Timer.periodic(widget.checkInterval, (_) => _service.checkConnectionAndUpdate());
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _periodicCheckTimer?.cancel();
    _service.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ChangeNotifierProvider<ConnectivityService>.value(
      value: _service,
      child: _ConnectivityStatusDisplay(child: widget.child),
    );
  }
}
