// A widget that provides automatic retry functionality when offline
class ConnectivityAwareWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, ConnectionStatus status) builder;
  final VoidCallback? onRetry;

  const ConnectivityAwareWidget({
    Key? key,
    required this.builder,
    this.onRetry,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final connectivityService = Provider.of<ConnectivityService>(context);
    final status = connectivityService.status;

    return Column(
      children: [
        // Show custom widget based on connection status
        Expanded(
          child: builder(context, status),
        ),

        // Show retry button if offline and onRetry callback provided
        if (status == ConnectionStatus.offline && onRetry != null)
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
            child: ElevatedButton.icon(
              onPressed: () async {
                // Check connection first
                final newStatus = await connectivityService.checkConnectionAndUpdate();

                // If we're back online, call the retry callback
                if (newStatus == ConnectionStatus.online) {
                  onRetry!();
                }
              },
              icon: Icon(Icons.refresh),
              label: Text('Retry'),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// Service that manages connectivity state
class ConnectivityService extends ChangeNotifier {
  // Dependencies
  final Connectivity _connectivity = Connectivity();

  // Properties
  ConnectionStatus _status = ConnectionStatus.unknown;
  StreamSubscription<ConnectivityResult>? _connectivitySubscription;
  bool _isInitialized = false;
  final List<String> _testUrls = [
    'https://www.google.com',
    'https://www.apple.com',
    'https://www.microsoft.com',
  ];

  // Getters
  ConnectionStatus get status => _status;
  bool get isOnline => _status == ConnectionStatus.online;
  bool get isOffline => _status == ConnectionStatus.offline;
  bool get isLimited => _status == ConnectionStatus.limited;
  bool get isUnknown => _status == ConnectionStatus.unknown;

  // Initialize the service
  Future<void> initialize() async {
    if (_isInitialized) return;

    // Initial check
    _status = await checkConnection();
    notifyListeners();

    // Listen for connectivity changes
    _connectivitySubscription = _connectivity.onConnectivityChanged.listen((_) async {
      final newStatus = await checkConnection();
      if (newStatus != _status) {
        _status = newStatus;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    });

    _isInitialized = true;
  }

  // Force a connection check and update status
  Future<ConnectionStatus> checkConnectionAndUpdate() async {
    final status = await checkConnection();
    if (status != _status) {
      _status = status;
      notifyListeners();
    }
    return status;
  }

  // Check the device's connectivity status
  Future<ConnectionStatus> checkConnection() async {
    try {
      // First check if we have any connectivity
      final connectivityResult = await _connectivity.checkConnectivity();
      if (connectivityResult == ConnectivityResult.none) {
        return ConnectionStatus.offline;
      }

      // Then check if we can actually connect to the internet
      if (await _canConnect()) {
        return ConnectionStatus.online;
      } else {
        return ConnectionStatus.limited;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('ConnectivityService error: $e');
      return ConnectionStatus.unknown;
    }
  }

  // Test if we can actually connect to the internet
  Future<bool> _canConnect() async {
    try {
      // Try to connect to multiple reliable services
      for (final url in _testUrls) {
        try {
          final response = await http.get(Uri.parse(url)).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));

          if (response.statusCode == 200) {
            return true;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          // Continue to the next URL if this one fails
          continue;
        }
      }

      // If we can't connect to any test URL, we're probably offline
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Manually attempt a connection to a specific URL
  Future<bool> canConnectTo(String url) async {
    try {
      final response = await http.get(Uri.parse(url)).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      return response.statusCode >= 200 && response.statusCode < 400;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Dispose of resources
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _connectivitySubscription?.cancel();
    _isInitialized = false;
    super.dispose();
  }
}

// The different states of connection
enum ConnectionStatus {
  online, // Connected to the internet
  offline, // No connectivity
  limited, // Has connectivity but no internet
  unknown // Status couldn't be determined
}

// Extension methods for easily accessing connectivity service
extension ConnectivityContext on BuildContext {
  ConnectivityService get connectivity => Provider.of<ConnectivityService>(this, listen: false);
  bool get isOnline => connectivity.isOnline;
  bool get isOffline => connectivity.isOffline;
}

String generateRandomCode({String prefix = 'Acreasal-', int length = 6}) {
  const String chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
  final Random random = Random();

  String randomString = '';
  for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    randomString += chars[random.nextInt(chars.length)];
  }

  return '$prefix$randomString';
}

String mapToCSV(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
  List<String> headers = map.keys.toList();
  List<String> values = map.values.map((value) => value.toString()).toList();

  String headerRow = headers.join(',');
  String valueRow = values.join(',');

  return '$headerRow\n$valueRow';
}

// Convert a List of Maps to CSV
String listOfMapsToCSV(List<Map<String, dynamic>> data) {
  if (data.isEmpty) return '';

  // Get headers from the first map
  List<String> headers = data.first.keys.toList();
  String headerRow = headers.join(',');

  // Convert each map to a row
  List<String> rows = data.map((map) {
    return headers.map((header) => map[header]?.toString() ?? '').join(',');
  }).toList();

  return '$headerRow\n${rows.join('\n')}';
}

// Handle CSV escaping for values with commas or quotes
String escapeCSVField(String field) {
  if (field.contains(',') || field.contains('"') || field.contains('\n')) {
    // Escape quotes by doubling them and wrap in quotes
    String escaped = field.replaceAll('"', '""');
    return '"$escaped"';
  }
  return field;
}

// Advanced CSV conversion with proper escaping
String mapToCSVWithEscaping(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
  List<String> headers = map.keys.map(escapeCSVField).toList();
  List<String> values = map.values.map((value) => escapeCSVField(value.toString())).toList();

  String headerRow = headers.join(',');
  String valueRow = values.join(',');

  return '$headerRow\n$valueRow';
}

String listOfMapsToCSVWithEscaping(List<Map<String, dynamic>> data) {
  if (data.isEmpty) return '';

  List<String> headers = data.first.keys.toList();
  String headerRow = headers.map(escapeCSVField).join(',');

  List<String> rows = data.map((map) {
    return headers.map((header) {
      String value = map[header]?.toString() ?? '';
      return escapeCSVField(value);
    }).join(',');
  }).toList();

  return '$headerRow\n${rows.join('\n')}';
}

/// Extension on String to convert to Uint8List
extension StringToUint8List on String {
  Uint8List toUint8List() {
    return Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(this));
  }
}

/// Extension on Uint8List to convert back to String
extension Uint8ListToString on Uint8List {
  String toStr() {
    return utf8.decode(this);
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/date-utils.dart ===== */
bool checkDateConditions(DateTime date) {
  DateTime now = DateTime.now();

  if (date.weekday == DateTime.sunday ||
      date.weekday == DateTime.saturday ||
      date.weekday == DateTime.monday) {
    return true;
  }
  if (date.isBefore(now)
      // ||
      // (now.day == date.day &&
      //     date.month == now.month &&
      //     now.year == date.year)
      ) {
    return false;
  } else if (date.weekday == DateTime.saturday) {
    if (now.weekday == DateTime.saturday && now.hour < 12) {
      return date.isAfter(now) &&
          (date.weekday == DateTime.saturday ||
              date.weekday == DateTime.sunday ||
              date.weekday == DateTime.monday);
    } else {
      return (date.weekday == DateTime.sunday ||
              date.weekday == DateTime.monday ||
              date.weekday == DateTime.tuesday) &&
          date.isAfter(now);
    }
  } else if (date.year == now.year &&
      date.month == now.month &&
      date.day == now.day) {
    return true;
  } else {
    if (date.year != now.year ||
        date.month != now.month ||
        date.day != now.day + 1) {
      return false; // Not the next day after the current date
    }

    if (now.hour >= 12) {
      return true; // Already past 2 PM
    }
    return false;
  }
}

DateTime getFutureDate() {
  DateTime currentDate = DateTime.now();
  bool conditionMet = false;

  // Check the condition for the current date before incrementing
  if (checkDatePredicate(currentDate)) {
    conditionMet = true;
  }

  // Continue checking with incremented dates until the condition is met
  while (!conditionMet) {
    currentDate = currentDate.add(const Duration(days: 1));
    conditionMet = checkDatePredicate(
        currentDate); // Replace with your actual condition check
  }

  return currentDate;
}

bool checkDatePredicate(DateTime dateTime) {
  return !checkDateConditions(dateTime);
}

DateTime getInitialDate() {
  DateTime now = DateTime.now();
  if (now.weekday == DateTime.saturday) {
    print('d is Sat');
    return DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 3));
  }
  if (now.weekday == DateTime.sunday) {
    print('d is Sun');
    return DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 2));
  }

  if (now.hour >= 12) {
    print('d is >12');
    if (now.weekday == DateTime.thursday || now.weekday == DateTime.friday) {
      print('d is Thurs || friday');
      return now.weekday == DateTime.thursday
          ? DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 5))
          : DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 5));
    } else {
      return DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 2));
    }
  } else {
    print('d is not greater than 12');
    return DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 1));
  }
}

DateTime getNextWeekdayDate(String weekday) {
  // Map of weekdays to their respective index values (Monday is 1, Sunday is 7)
  Map<String, int> weekdays = {
    'Monday': 1,
    'Tuesday': 2,
    'Wednesday': 3,
    'Thursday': 4,
    'Friday': 5,
    'Saturday': 6,
    'Sunday': 7,
  };

  // Get the current date
  DateTime now = DateTime.now();

  // Get the index of the current day
  int todayIndex = now.weekday;

  // Get the index of the target weekday
  int targetIndex = weekdays[weekday] ?? -1;

  if (targetIndex == -1) {
    throw ArgumentError('Invalid weekday: $weekday');
  }

  // Calculate the number of days to add to get to the target weekday
  int daysToAdd = (targetIndex - todayIndex + 7) % 7;

  // If the target day is today, or within the next two days, move to the next week
  if (daysToAdd == 0 || daysToAdd <= 2) {
    daysToAdd += 7;
  }

  // Get the next occurrence of the target weekday
  DateTime nextWeekdayDate = now.add(Duration(days: daysToAdd));

  return nextWeekdayDate;
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/debounce.dart ===== */
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

class Debouncer {
  Debouncer({this.delay = const Duration(milliseconds: 300)});

  final Duration delay;
  Timer? _timer;

  void call(void Function() callback) {
    _timer?.cancel();
    _timer = Timer(delay, callback);
  }

  void dispose() {
    _timer
        ?.cancel(); // You can comment-out this line if you want. I am not sure if this call brings any value.
    _timer = null;
  }
}

class DebounceRequest {
  Timer? _timer;
  void run(VoidCallback action, {int? milliSeconds}) {
    if (_timer?.isActive ?? false) {
      _timer?.cancel();
    }
    _timer = Timer(Duration(milliseconds: milliSeconds ?? 1000), action);
  }
}

final debounce = DebounceRequest();
debounceThis(VoidCallback v, {int? milliSeconds}) {
  debounce.run(() {
    v();
  }, milliSeconds: milliSeconds);
}

extension DebounceExtension on Function {
  debounceIt({int? milliseconds}) {
    debounceThis(() => this(), milliSeconds: milliseconds);
  }
}

extension DebounceFunctionExtension on VoidCallback {
  static final _timers = <Function, Timer>{};
  static final _timers1 = <Function, Timer>{};

  void debounceFunction(
      {Duration duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 5000)}) {
    if (_timers.containsKey(this)) {
      _timers[this]!.cancel();
    }
    _timers[this] = Timer(duration, () {
      this();
      _timers.remove(this);
    });
  }

  void debounceFunction1(
      {Duration duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 5000)}) {
    if (_timers1.containsKey(this)) {
      _timers1[this]!.cancel();
    }
    _timers1[this] = Timer(duration, () {
      this();
      _timers1.remove(this);
    });
  }
}

import 'dart:io';

import 'package:device_info_plus/device_info_plus.dart';

Future<String> getUniqueDeviceId() async {
  String uniqueDeviceId = '';

  var deviceInfo = DeviceInfoPlugin();

  if (Platform.isIOS) {
    // import 'dart:io'
    var iosDeviceInfo = await deviceInfo.iosInfo;
    uniqueDeviceId =
        '${iosDeviceInfo.name}:${iosDeviceInfo.identifierForVendor}'; // unique ID on iOS
  } else if (Platform.isAndroid) {
    var androidDeviceInfo = await deviceInfo.androidInfo;
    uniqueDeviceId =
        '${androidDeviceInfo.device}:${androidDeviceInfo.id}'; // unique ID on Android
  }

  return uniqueDeviceId;
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/distribution-mapper.dart ===== */
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

/// Maps intervention form data to API request payload
///
/// Takes a complex nested map structure from the form and converts it
/// to the format expected by the API endpoint
Map<String, dynamic> mapInterventionToRequestPayload(
  Map<String, dynamic> formData, {
  String? deviceName,
  String? deviceIpAddress,
  String? deviceUserName,
  double? latitude,
  double? longitude,
  String? createdBy,
}) {
  // Helper function to safely extract nested values
  dynamic getNestedValue(Map<String, dynamic>? map, String key) {
    return map != null ? map[key] : null;
  }

  // Helper function to convert status string to enum value
  int _getStatusValue(String? status) {
    if (status == null) return 0;

    final statusMap = {
      'Commenced': 1,
      'In Progress': 2,
      'Completed': 3,
      'Pending': 0,
      'Cancelled': 4,
    };

    return statusMap[status] ?? 0;
  }

  // Helper function to format datetime
  String _formatDateTime(dynamic date) {
    if (date == null) return DateTime.now().toIso8601String();

    if (date is String) {
      try {
        return DateTime.parse(date).toIso8601String();
      } catch (e) {
        return DateTime.now().toIso8601String();
      }
    }

    if (date is DateTime) {
      return date.toIso8601String();
    }

    return DateTime.now().toIso8601String();
  }

  // Extract nested objects
  final subComponent = formData['subComponent'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
  final state = formData['state'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
  final toR1 = formData['toR1'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
  final interventionCategory = formData['interventionCategory'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
  final natureOfIntervention = formData['natureOfIntervention'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
  final inputAssetCategory = formData['inputAssetCategory'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
  final inputAssetType = formData['inputAssetType'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
  final localGovernmentArea = formData['localGovernmentArea'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
  final site = formData['site'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;

  // Map beneficiaries
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> mapBeneficiaries() {
    final selectedBeneficiaries = formData['selectedBeneficiaries'] as List<dynamic>?;

    if (selectedBeneficiaries == null || selectedBeneficiaries.isEmpty) {
      return [];
    }

    return selectedBeneficiaries.map((beneficiary) {
      final b = beneficiary as Map<String, dynamic>;

      return {
        'age': b['age'] ?? 0,
        'ageBracketOid': b['ageBracketOid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
        'beneficiaryID': b['beneficiaryID'],
        'communityOid': b['communityOid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
        'communityInterestGroupOid': b['communityInterestGroupOid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
        'description': b['description'],
        'email': b['email'],
        'firstName': b['firstName'],
        'gender': b['gender'] ?? 0,
        'householdSize': b['householdSize'] ?? 0,
        'lastName': b['lastName'],
        'localGovernmentOid': b['localGovernmentOid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
        'maritalStatus': b['maritalStatus'] ?? 0,
        'middleName': b['middleName'],
        'name': b['name'],
        'nin': b['nin']?.toString(),
        'oldMemberID': b['oldMemberID'],
        'photo': b['photo'] ?? '',
        'primaryOccupationOid': b['primaryOccupationOid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
        'primaryPhoneNo': b['primaryPhoneNo']?.toString(),
        'secondaryOccupationOid': b['secondaryOccupationOid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
        'secondaryPhoneNo': b['secondaryPhoneNo']?.toString(),
        'stateOid': b['stateOid'] ?? state?['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
        'titleOid': b['titleOid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
        'createdBy': b['createdBy'] ?? createdBy ?? 'System',
        'createdOn': _formatDateTime(b['createdOn']),
        'deviceName': b['deviceName'] ?? deviceName ?? '',
        'deviceIpAddress': b['deviceIpAddress'] ?? deviceIpAddress ?? '',
        'deviceUserName': b['deviceUserName'] ?? deviceUserName ?? '',
        'latitude': (b['latitude'] ?? latitude ?? 0.0).toDouble(),
        'longitude': (b['longitude'] ?? longitude ?? 0.0).toDouble(),
      };
    }).toList();
  }

  // Map indicators - handles both componentLevelIndicator and pdoIndicator
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> mapIndicators() {
    final componentLevelIndicator = formData['componentLevelIndicator'] as List<dynamic>?;
    final pdoIndicator = formData['pdoIndicator'] as List<dynamic>?;

    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> allIndicators = [];

    // Helper function to map a single indicator
    Map<String, dynamic> mapSingleIndicator(Map<String, dynamic> ind, String defaultType) {
      return {
        'indicatorType': ind['indicatorType'] ?? defaultType,
        'name': ind['name'],
        'parentId': ind['parentId']?.toString(),
        'sequence': ind['sequence']?.toString(),
        'oid': ind['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

        // Additional indicator fields
        'baseline': ind['baseline']?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
        'description': ind['description'],
        'frequency': ind['frequency'],
        'isParent': ind['isParent'] ?? false,
        'pbc': ind['pbc'],
        'valueType': ind['valueType'],
        'unitOfMeasure': ind['unitOfMeasure'],
        'targets': ind['targets'],
        'subComponents': ind['subComponents'],

        // Audit fields
        'createdBy': ind['createdBy'] ?? createdBy ?? 'System',
        'createdOn': _formatDateTime(ind['createdOn']),
        'modifiedBy': ind['modifiedBy'],
        'modifiedOn': ind['modifiedOn'] != null ? _formatDateTime(ind['modifiedOn']) : null,
        'deviceName': ind['deviceName'] ?? deviceName ?? '',
        'deviceIpAddress': ind['deviceIpAddress'] ?? deviceIpAddress ?? '',
        'deviceUserName': ind['deviceUserName'] ?? deviceUserName ?? '',
        'latitude': (ind['latitude'] ?? latitude ?? 0.0).toDouble(),
        'longitude': (ind['longitude'] ?? longitude ?? 0.0).toDouble(),
      };
    }

    // Map component level indicators
    if (componentLevelIndicator != null && componentLevelIndicator.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var indicator in componentLevelIndicator) {
        final ind = indicator as Map<String, dynamic>;
        allIndicators.add(mapSingleIndicator(ind, 'CLI'));
      }
    }

    // Map PDO indicators
    if (pdoIndicator != null && pdoIndicator.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var indicator in pdoIndicator) {
        final ind = indicator as Map<String, dynamic>;
        allIndicators.add(mapSingleIndicator(ind, 'PDO'));
      }
    }

    return allIndicators;
  }

  // Build the request payload
  return {
    // Location and community info
    'communityOid': site?['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    'stateOid': state?['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    'localGovernmentOid': localGovernmentArea?['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

    // Input/Asset information
    'inputAssetCategoryOid': inputAssetCategory?['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    'inputAssetTypeOid': inputAssetType?['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

    // Intervention information
    'interventionCategoryOid': interventionCategory?['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    'interventionTypeOid': natureOfIntervention?['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

    // Component information
    'componentCode': formData['componentCode'],
    'componentOid': subComponent?['componentOid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    'subComponentOid': subComponent?['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

    // Financial information
    'quantity': formData['quantity'] ?? 0,
    'unitCost': formData['unitCost'] ?? 0,
    'totalCost': formData['total'] ?? 0,
    'totalHectarage': formData['totalHectarage'] ?? 1,

    // Project information
    'projectID': formData['projectId'],
    'creditID': formData['creditId'],
    'description': subComponent?['description'],
    'status': _getStatusValue(formData['status']?.toString()),

    // ToR information
    'torOid': toR1?['oid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

    // Dates
    'startDate': _formatDateTime(formData['actualStartDate']),
    'endDate': _formatDateTime(formData['actualEndDate']),

    // Additional fields
    'uniqueID': formData['uniqueID'] ?? const Uuid().v4(),
    'photo': formData['photo'] ?? '',
    'implementerOid': formData['implementerOid'] ?? '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',

    // Collections
    'beneficiaries': mapBeneficiaries(),
    'indicators': mapIndicators(),

    // Audit fields
    'createdBy': createdBy ?? 'System',
    'createdOn': _formatDateTime(DateTime.now()),
    'deviceName': deviceName ?? '',
    'deviceIpAddress': deviceIpAddress ?? '',
    'deviceUserName': deviceUserName ?? '',
    'latitude': (latitude ?? 0.0).toDouble(),
    'longitude': (longitude ?? 0.0).toDouble(),
  };
}

/// Extension method for easy usage
extension InterventionMapperExtension on Map<String, dynamic> {
  /// Converts this map to an intervention request payload
  Map<String, dynamic> toInterventionPayload({
    String? deviceName,
    String? deviceIpAddress,
    String? deviceUserName,
    double? latitude,
    double? longitude,
    String? createdBy,
  }) {
    return mapInterventionToRequestPayload(
      this,
      deviceName: deviceName,
      deviceIpAddress: deviceIpAddress,
      deviceUserName: deviceUserName,
      latitude: latitude,
      longitude: longitude,
      createdBy: createdBy,
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/initializer.dart ===== */
import 'package:async/async.dart';
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/constants.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/app-settings.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/storage-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/user.service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/web-services/user-api-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/network_exception.dart';

class Initializer {
  UserService userService = getIt<UserService>();
  StorageService storageService = getIt<StorageService>();
  UserApiService userApi = getIt<UserApiService>();

  Future initialCalls() async {
    try {
      String? value = await storageService.readItem(key: bearerToken);
      if (value != null && value.isNotEmpty) {
        await Future.wait(<Future>[
          await userService.getLocalUser(),
          userApi.getUser(),
          getUserCalls(),
        ]);
      }
    } on DioError catch (e) {
      return e.response.toString();
    } catch (e) {
      return e.toString();
    }
  }

  getUserCalls() async {
    await userService.getLocalUser();
  }

  init() async {
    try {
      getIt<AppSettingsService>().readAppSettings();
      await checkForCachedUserData();
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  checkForCachedUserData() async {
    String? value = await storageService.readItem(key: bearerToken);
    if (value != null && value.isNotEmpty) {
      await getIt<UserService>().getLocalUser();
    }
  }

  Future getRemoteUserData() async {
    try {
      Future getUser = userApi.getUser();
      FutureGroup futureGroup = FutureGroup();

      futureGroup.add(getUser);
      futureGroup.close();
      futureGroup.future;
    } on DioError catch (e) {
      return getErrorFromDio(e);
    } catch (e) {
      return e.toString();
    }
  }
}

handleClick({Map<String, dynamic>? data, String? csv}) async {
  String? pkg = await getPackageNameFromAssetApk('coba.apk');
  bool isInstalled = await isAppInstalled(packageName);
  bool isInstalled1 = await isODKCollectInstalled();

  } else {

Future<bool> requestInstallPermission() async {
  if (Platform.isAndroid && Platform.version.startsWith('8') || int.tryParse(Platform.version.split(".")[0])! >= 8) {
    try {
      final bool granted = await platform.invokeMethod('checkInstallPermission');
      if (!granted) {
        await platform.invokeMethod('requestInstallPermission');
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    } on PlatformException catch (e) {
      print("Permission check failed: ${e.message}");
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true; // < Android 8 doesn't need it
}

Future<String> copyApkFromAssets(String assetPath, String fileName) async {
  final byteData = await rootBundle.load(assetPath);
  final dir = await getExternalStorageDirectory(); // or getApplicationDocumentsDirectory()
  final file = File('${dir!.path}/$fileName');
  await file.writeAsBytes(byteData.buffer.asUint8List());
  return file.path;
}

Future<void> installApk(String apkPath) async {
  try {
    await platform.invokeMethod('installApk', {'apkPath': apkPath});
  } on PlatformException catch (e) {
    print("Failed to install APK: ${e.message}");
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/isolate.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

/// Signature for a fromJson function
typedef FromJson<T> = T Function(Map<String, dynamic> json);

class IsolateDeserializer {
  /// Generic list deserialization using an isolate
  static Future<List<T>> parseList<T>({
    required List<dynamic> rawList,
    required FromJson<T> fromJson,
  }) async {
    return compute(_parseList<T>, {
      'list': rawList,
      'fromJson': fromJson,
    });
  }
}

/// Top-level function (required for isolates)
List<T> _parseList<T>(Map<String, dynamic> args) {
  final List<dynamic> list = args['list'];
  final FromJson<T> fromJson = args['fromJson'];

  return list.map((e) => fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(e))).toList();
}

import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';

killKeyboard(BuildContext context) {
  if (FocusScope.of(context).isFirstFocus) {
    FocusScope.of(context).requestFocus(FocusNode());
  }
}

dropKeyboard() {
  FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.unfocus();
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/kobo-utils.dart ===== */
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/installation-utils.dart';

class ODKLauncher {
  // Launch ODK with JSON data
  static Future<bool> launchODKWithJson({
    required Map<String, dynamic> jsonData,
    String? formName,
  }) async {
    try {
      final result = await platform.invokeMethod('openOdkWithData', {
        'packageName': 'org.odk.collect.android',
        'className': 'org.odk.collect.android.mainmenu.MainMenuActivity',
        'dataType': 'json',
        'data': jsonEncode(jsonData),
        'formName': formName,
      });
      return result == true;
    } catch (e) {
      print("Failed to launch ODK with JSON: $e");
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Launch ODK with CSV data
  static Future<bool> launchODKWithCSV({
    required String csvData,
    String? formName,
  }) async {
    try {
      final result = await platform.invokeMethod('openOdkWithData', {
        'packageName': 'org.odk.collect.android',
        'className': 'org.odk.collect.android.mainmenu.MainMenuActivity',
        'dataType': 'csv',
        'data': csvData,
        'formName': formName,
      });
      return result == true;
    } catch (e) {
      print("Failed to launch ODK with CSV: $e");
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Launch ODK with CSV file
  static Future<bool> launchODKWithCSVFile({
    required String filePath,
    String? formName,
  }) async {
    try {
      final result = await platform.invokeMethod('openOdkWithData', {
        'packageName': 'org.odk.collect.android',
        'className': 'org.odk.collect.android.mainmenu.MainMenuActivity',
        'dataType': 'file',
        'filePath': filePath,
        'formName': formName,
      });
      return result == true;
    } catch (e) {
      print("Failed to launch ODK with file: $e");
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Launch ODK with key-value pairs
  static Future<bool> launchODKWithKeyValues({
    required Map<String, String> keyValues,
    String? formName,
  }) async {
    try {
      final result = await platform.invokeMethod('openOdkWithData', {
        'packageName': 'org.odk.collect.android',
        'className': 'org.odk.collect.android.mainmenu.MainMenuActivity',
        'dataType': 'key_value',
        'data': jsonEncode(keyValues),
        'formName': formName,
      });
      return result == true;
    } catch (e) {
      print("Failed to launch ODK with key-values: $e");
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Convert List<Map> to CSV and launch ODK
  static Future<bool> launchODKWithMapData({
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> mapData,
    String? formName,
  }) async {
    String csvData = _convertMapListToCSV(mapData);
    return await launchODKWithCSV(csvData: csvData, formName: formName);
  }

  // Helper method to convert List<Map> to CSV
  static String _convertMapListToCSV(List<Map<String, dynamic>> data) {
    if (data.isEmpty) return '';

    List<String> headers = data.first.keys.toList();
    String headerRow = headers.join(',');

    List<String> rows = data.map((map) {
      return headers.map((header) => _escapeCSVField(map[header]?.toString() ?? '')).join(',');
    }).toList();

    return '$headerRow\n${rows.join('\n')}';
  }

  // Helper method to escape CSV fields
  static String _escapeCSVField(String field) {
    if (field.contains(',') || field.contains('"') || field.contains('\n')) {
      String escaped = field.replaceAll('"', '""');
      return '"$escaped"';
    }
    return field;
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/list-utils.dart ===== */
// Generic function to sort a list by any comparable field
List<T> sortListByField<T>(
  List<T> list,
  Comparable Function(T) fieldSelector, {
  bool ascending = true,
}) {
  list.sort((a, b) {
    final aValue = fieldSelector(a);
    final bValue = fieldSelector(b);

    // Handle null values by putting them at the end
    if (aValue == null && bValue == null) return 0;
    if (aValue == null) return ascending ? 1 : -1;
    if (bValue == null) return ascending ? -1 : 1;

    // Compare non-null values
    return ascending ? aValue.compareTo(bValue) : bValue.compareTo(aValue);
  });

  return list;
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/location-utils.dart ===== */
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:geolocator/geolocator.dart';

class UserLocation {
  final double latitude;
  final double longitude;
  UserLocation({required this.latitude, required this.longitude});
}

Future<Position> determinePosition() async {
  bool serviceEnabled;
  LocationPermission permission;

  // Test if location services are enabled.
  serviceEnabled = await Geolocator.isLocationServiceEnabled();
  if (!serviceEnabled) {
    // Location services are not enabled don't continue
    // accessing the position and request users of the
    // App to enable the location services.
    return Future.error('Location services are disabled.');
  }

  permission = await Geolocator.checkPermission();
  if (permission == LocationPermission.denied) {
    permission = await Geolocator.requestPermission();
    if (permission == LocationPermission.denied) {
      // Permissions are denied, next time you could try
      // requesting permissions again (this is also where
      // Android's shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale
      // returned true. According to Android guidelines
      // your App should show an explanatory UI now.
      return Future.error('Location permissions are denied');
    }
  }

  if (permission == LocationPermission.deniedForever) {
    // Permissions are denied forever, handle appropriately.
    return Future.error('Location permissions are permanently denied, we cannot request permissions.');
  }

  // When we reach here, permissions are granted and we can
  // continue accessing the position of the device.
  return await Geolocator.getCurrentPosition();
}

num calculateDistance({required double lat1, required double lon1, required double lat2, required double lon2}) {
  print('$lat1 $lon1 $lat2 $lon2');
  const earthRadius = 6371; // Earth's radius in kilometers

  // Convert degrees to radians
  final phi1 = lat1 * pi / 180;
  final lambda1 = lon1 * pi / 180;
  final phi2 = lat2 * pi / 180;
  final lambda2 = lon2 * pi / 180;

  // Calculate differences
  final deltaPhi = phi2 - phi1;
  final deltaLambda = lambda2 - lambda1;

  // Haversine formula components
  final a = sin(deltaPhi / 2) * sin(deltaPhi / 2) + cos(phi1) * cos(phi2) * sin(deltaLambda / 2) * sin(deltaLambda / 2);

  final c = 2 * atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1 - a));

  // Calculate distance
  return (earthRadius * c).round();
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/mask-email.dart ===== */
String maskEmail(String email) {
  if (!email.contains('@')) {
    throw ArgumentError('Invalid email address');
  }

  final parts = email.split('@');
  final username = parts[0];
  final domain = parts[1];

  if (username.length <= 2) {
    return '${username[0]}***@${domain}';
  }

  final start = username.substring(0, 2); // First two characters of the username
  final end = username[username.length - 1]; // Last character of the username

  return '$start***$end@$domain';
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/meal-check-utils.dart ===== */
void performAction(
    {required bool a, // A is boolean
    required String? b, // B is a nullable string
    required bool c, // C is boolean
    required String? d, // D is a nullable string
    required Function() action}) {
  bool canPerformAction =
      false; // Flag to determine if the action can be performed

  // Check if both A and C are true
  if (a && c) {
    // Both A and C are true, check if B and D are not null or empty
    if (b != null && b.isNotEmpty && d != null && d.isNotEmpty) {
      canPerformAction = true; // Action can be performed
    } else {
      print('Both B and D must be valid when A and C are true.');
    }
  } else if (a) {
    // Only A is true, check if B is not null or empty
    if (b != null && b.isNotEmpty) {
      canPerformAction = true; // Action can be performed
    } else {
      print('B is null or empty when A is true.');
    }
  } else if (c) {
    // Only C is true, check if D is not null or empty
    if (d != null && d.isNotEmpty) {
      canPerformAction = true; // Action can be performed
    } else {
      print('D is null or empty when C is true.');
    }
  } else {
    // Both A and C are false
    print('No action is performed since both A and C are false.');
  }

  // Perform action if criteria are met
  if (canPerformAction) {
    print('Action is carried out with B = $b, D = $d');
    action();
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/network_exception.dart ===== */
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

part 'network_exception.freezed.dart';

@freezed
abstract class NetworkExceptions with _$NetworkExceptions {
  const factory NetworkExceptions.requestCancelled() = RequestCancelled;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.unauthorisedRequest() = UnauthorisedRequest;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.badRequest() = BadRequest;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.notFound(String reason) = NotFound;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.methodNotAllowed() = MethodNotAllowed;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.notAcceptable() = NotAcceptable;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.requestTimeout() = RequestTimeout;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.sendTimeout() = SendTimeout;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.conflict() = Conflict;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.internalServerError() = InternalServerError;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.notImplemented() = NotImplemented;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.serviceUnavailable() = ServiceUnavailable;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.noInternetConnection() = NoInternetConnection;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.formatException() = FormatException;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.unableToProcess() = UnableToProcess;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.defaultError(String error) = DefaultError;

  const factory NetworkExceptions.unexpectedError() = UnexpectedError;

  static NetworkExceptions getDioException(error) {
    if (error is Exception) {
      try {
        NetworkExceptions networkExceptions;
        if (error is DioException) {
          switch (error.type) {
            case DioExceptionType.cancel:
              networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.requestCancelled();
              break;
            case DioExceptionType.connectionTimeout:
              networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.requestTimeout();
              break;
            case DioExceptionType.unknown:
              networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.noInternetConnection();
              break;
            case DioExceptionType.receiveTimeout:
              networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.sendTimeout();
              break;
            case DioExceptionType.badResponse:
              switch (error.response?.statusCode) {
                case 400:
                  networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.unauthorisedRequest();
                  break;
                case 401:
                  networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.unauthorisedRequest();
                  break;
                case 403:
                  networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.unauthorisedRequest();
                  break;
                case 404:
                  networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.notFound("Not found");
                  break;
                case 409:
                  networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.conflict();
                  break;
                case 408:
                  networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.requestTimeout();
                  break;
                case 500:
                  networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.internalServerError();
                  break;
                case 503:
                  networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.serviceUnavailable();
                  break;
                default:
                  var responseCode = error.response?.statusCode;
                  networkExceptions = NetworkExceptions.defaultError(
                    "Received invalid status code: $responseCode",
                  );
              }
              break;
            case DioExceptionType.sendTimeout:
              networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.sendTimeout();
              break;
            case DioExceptionType.badCertificate:
              networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.unexpectedError();
            case DioExceptionType.connectionError:
              networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.unexpectedError();
          }
        } else if (error is SocketException) {
          networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.noInternetConnection();
        } else {
          networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.unexpectedError();
        }
        return networkExceptions = const NetworkExceptions.unexpectedError();
      } on FormatException catch (e) {
        // Helper.printError(e.toString());
        return const NetworkExceptions.formatException();
      } catch (_) {
        return const NetworkExceptions.unexpectedError();
      }
    } else {
      if (error.toString().contains("is not a subtype of")) {
        return const NetworkExceptions.unableToProcess();
      } else {
        return const NetworkExceptions.unexpectedError();
      }
    }
  }

  static String getErrorMessage(NetworkExceptions networkExceptions) {
    var errorMessage = "";
    networkExceptions.when(notImplemented: () {
      errorMessage = "Not Implemented";
    }, requestCancelled: () {
      errorMessage = "Request Cancelled";
    }, internalServerError: () {
      errorMessage = "Internal Server Error";
    }, notFound: (String reason) {
      errorMessage = reason;
    }, serviceUnavailable: () {
      errorMessage = "Service unavailable";
    }, methodNotAllowed: () {
      errorMessage = "Method Allowed";
    }, badRequest: () {
      errorMessage = "Bad request";
    }, unauthorisedRequest: () {
      errorMessage = "Unauthorised request";
    }, unexpectedError: () {
      errorMessage = "Unexpected error occurred";
    }, requestTimeout: () {
      errorMessage = "Connection request timeout";
    }, noInternetConnection: () {
      errorMessage = "No Internet Connection";
    }, conflict: () {
      errorMessage = "Error due to a conflict";
    }, sendTimeout: () {
      errorMessage = "Send timeout in connection with API server";
    }, unableToProcess: () {
      errorMessage = "Unable to process the data";
    }, defaultError: (String error) {
      errorMessage = error;
    }, formatException: () {
      errorMessage = "Unexpected error occurred";
    }, notAcceptable: () {
      errorMessage = "Not acceptable";
    });
    return errorMessage;
  }
}

class NetworkException implements Exception {}

String getErrorFromDio(DioException error) {
  return jsonEncode({"message": NetworkExceptions.getErrorMessage(NetworkExceptions.getDioException(error))});
}

        (other.runtimeType == runtimeType && other is _$RequestCancelled);

  @override
  @optionalTypeArgs
  TResult maybeWhen<TResult extends Object?>({

    TResult Function()? badRequest,
    TResult Function(String reason)? notFound,

    TResult Function()? unableToProcess,
    TResult Function(String error)? defaultError,
    TResult Function()? unexpectedError,
    required TResult orElse(),
  }) {
    if (requestCancelled != null) {
      return requestCancelled();
    }
    return orElse();

  TResult map<TResult extends Object?>({

    TResult? Function(FormatException value)? formatException,
    TResult? Function(UnableToProcess value)? unableToProcess,
    TResult? Function(DefaultError value)? defaultError,
    TResult? Function(UnexpectedError value)? unexpectedError,
  }) {
    return defaultError?.call(this);
  }

  @override
  @optionalTypeArgs
  TResult maybeMap<TResult extends Object?>({
    TResult Function(RequestCancelled value)? requestCancelled,
    TResult Function(UnauthorisedRequest value)? unauthorisedRequest,
    TResult Function(BadRequest value)? badRequest,
    TResult Function(NotFound value)? notFound,
    TResult Function(MethodNotAllowed value)? methodNotAllowed,
    TResult Function(NotAcceptable value)? notAcceptable,
    TResult Function(RequestTimeout value)? requestTimeout,
    TResult Function(SendTimeout value)? sendTimeout,
    TResult Function(Conflict value)? conflict,
    TResult Function(InternalServerError value)? internalServerError,
    TResult Function(NotImplemented value)? notImplemented,
    TResult Function(ServiceUnavailable value)? serviceUnavailable,
    TResult Function(NoInternetConnection value)? noInternetConnection,
    TResult Function(FormatException value)? formatException,
    TResult Function(UnableToProcess value)? unableToProcess,
    TResult Function(DefaultError value)? defaultError,
    TResult Function(UnexpectedError value)? unexpectedError,
    required TResult orElse(),
  }) {
    if (defaultError != null) {
      return defaultError(this);
    }
    return orElse();
  }
}

      throw _privateConstructorUsedError;

/* ===== lib/src/utils/otp_timer_utils.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class CountDownTimer extends StatefulWidget {
  const CountDownTimer({
    Key? key,
    required this.secondsRemaining,
    required this.whenTimeExpires,
    this.countDownFormatter,
    this.countDownTimerStyle,
  }) : super(key: key);

  final int secondsRemaining;
  final VoidCallback whenTimeExpires;
  final TextStyle? countDownTimerStyle;
  final Function(int seconds)? countDownFormatter;

  @override
  State createState() => _CountDownTimerState();
}

class _CountDownTimerState extends State<CountDownTimer>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller;
  late final Duration duration;

  String get timerDisplayString {
    final duration = _controller.duration! * _controller.value;
    if (widget.countDownFormatter != null) {
      return widget.countDownFormatter!(duration.inSeconds) as String;
    } else {
      return formatHHMMSS(duration.inSeconds);
    }
  }

  String formatHHMMSS(int seconds) {
    final hours = (seconds / 3600).truncate();
    seconds = (seconds % 3600).truncate();
    final minutes = (seconds / 60).truncate();

    final hoursStr = (hours).toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final minutesStr = (minutes).toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final secondsStr = (seconds % 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');

    if (hours == 0) {
      return '$minutesStr:$secondsStr';
    }

    return '$hoursStr:$minutesStr:$secondsStr';
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    duration = Duration(seconds: widget.secondsRemaining);
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: duration,
    );
    _controller
      ..reverse(from: widget.secondsRemaining.toDouble())
      ..addStatusListener((status) {
        if (status == AnimationStatus.completed ||
            status == AnimationStatus.dismissed) {
          widget.whenTimeExpires();
        }
      });
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(CountDownTimer oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.secondsRemaining != oldWidget.secondsRemaining) {
      setState(() {
        duration = Duration(seconds: widget.secondsRemaining);
        _controller.dispose();
        _controller = AnimationController(
          vsync: this,
          duration: duration,
        );
        _controller
          ..reverse(from: widget.secondsRemaining.toDouble())
          ..addStatusListener((status) {
            if (status == AnimationStatus.completed) {
              widget.whenTimeExpires();
            }
          });
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Center(
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: _controller,
        builder: (_, Widget? child) {
          return Text(
            timerDisplayString,
            style: widget.countDownTimerStyle,
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/utils/sort-utils.dart ===== */
extension AlphabeticalSortExtension<T> on List<T> {
  List<T> sortByString(
    String Function(T item) selector, {
    bool ascending = true,
  }) {
    final list = List<T>.from(this);

    list.sort((a, b) {
      final valueA = selector(a).toLowerCase();
      final valueB = selector(b).toLowerCase();
      return ascending ? valueA.compareTo(valueB) : valueB.compareTo(valueA);
    });

    return list;
  }
}

copyToClipBoard(String data) {
  Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: data));
  showToast("Copied to Clipboard");
}

void printWrapped(String text) {
  final pattern = RegExp('.{1,800}'); // 800 is the size of each chunk
  pattern.allMatches(text).forEach((match) => debugPrint(match.group(0)));
}

String camelToSentence(String text) {
  return text.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'^([a-z])|[A-Z]'),
      (Match m) => m[1] == null ? " ${m[0]}" : m[1]!.toUpperCase());
}

String splitCamelCase(String input) {
  // Use regular expression to find uppercase letters that are preceded by a lowercase letter or another uppercase letter
  final RegExp exp = RegExp(r'(?<=[a-z])(?=[A-Z])');

  // Split the input string based on the regular expression
  final List<String> parts = input.split(exp);

  // Join the parts with a space and return the result
  return parts.join(' ');
}

extension StringFormatExtens on String? {
  String formatDate() => DateFormat('dd/MM/yyyy').format(DateTime.parse(this!
      // "2024-10-17T14:23:22.956Z"
      ));

extension StringCasingExtension on String {
  bool isWithinLast24Hours() {
    // Initialize timezone package
    tz.initializeTimeZones();

    try {
      // Parse the string to DateTime object (assuming it's in UTC)
      DateTime parsedDate = DateTime.parse(this);

      // Get current date in UTC
      DateTime now = DateTime.now().toUtc();

      // Calculate the difference in days
      Duration difference = now.difference(parsedDate);

      // Check if it's not more than 24 hours ago
      return difference.inHours <= 24;
    } catch (e) {
      // If there's an error in parsing the date, return false
      return false;
    }
  }

  int daysLeftTo30() {
    // Initialize timezone package
    tz.initializeTimeZones();

    try {
      // Parse the string to a DateTime object (assuming the date is in UTC)
      DateTime parsedDate = DateTime.parse(this);

      // Get current date in UTC
      DateTime now = DateTime.now().toUtc();

      // Calculate the difference in days between the current date and the given date
      Duration difference = now.difference(parsedDate);

      // Total days in the window (30 days)
      int daysTo30 = 30;

      // Calculate how many days are left to complete 30 days
      int daysLeft = daysTo30 - difference.inDays;

      // If daysLeft is negative, it means the 30 days have already passed, so return 0
      return daysLeft > 0 ? daysLeft : 0;
    } catch (e) {
      // If there's an error in parsing the date, return -1 to indicate failure
      return -1;
    }
  }

  String? validationMessage() => "Please enter a valid $this";

  String? camelCase() => toBeginningOfSentenceCase(this);
  String toCapitalized() => length > 0 ? '${this[0].toUpperCase()}${substring(1).toLowerCase()}' : '';
  String toTitleCase() => replaceAll(RegExp(' +'), ' ').split(' ').map((str) => str.toCapitalized()).join(' ');
  String? trimToken() => contains(":") ? split(":")[1].trim() : this;
  String? trimSpaces() => replaceAll(" ", "");
  String? stripInternationalNumbers() => isNotEmpty
      ? contains("+234")
          ? replaceAll("+234", "0")
          : this
      : "";

  String getInitials() => isNotEmpty ? trim().split(RegExp(' +')).map((s) => s[0].toUpperCase()).take(2).join() : '';
  String getNumbers() => isNotEmpty ? replaceAll(RegExp('[^0-9]'), '').replaceAll("-", "") : "";
  String getAlphabets() => isNotEmpty ? replaceAll(RegExp('[^A-Za-z]'), '').replaceAll("-", "") : "";
  String getAlphaNumeric() => isNotEmpty ? replaceAll(RegExp('[^A-Za-z0-9]'), '').replaceAll("-", "") : "";
  String? trimLength(int startRange) => replaceRange(startRange, length, ".");
  String get inCaps => length > 0 ? '${this[0].toUpperCase()}${this.substring(1)}' : '';
  String get capitalizeFirstOfEach => replaceAll(RegExp(' +'), ' ').split(" ").map((str) => str.inCaps).join(" ");
}

extension DateUtils on DateTime {
  bool isExpired() => isBefore(DateTime.now());
  String? formatDate({String? format = 'MM-dd-yyyy, hh:mm a'}) => DateFormat(format).format(this);
  String get formattedCustom {
    final dateFormat = DateFormat('EEE MMM d h:mma');
    return dateFormat.format(this).replaceAll(' AM', 'AM').replaceAll(' PM', 'PM');
  }

  String? formatDateOnly({String? format = 'MM-dd-yyyy'}) => DateFormat(format).format(this);
  String get formattedCustomDateOnly {
    final dateFormat = DateFormat('EEE MMM d');
    return dateFormat.format(this).replaceAll(' AM', 'AM').replaceAll(' PM', 'PM');
  }

}

extension DateUtilsNullable on DateTime? {
  String? formatDate({String format = 'MM/dd/yyyy, hh:mm a'}) {
    final DateTime? date = this;
    return date != null ? DateFormat(format).format(date) : null;
  }

  String get formattedCustom {
    final DateTime? date = this;
    if (date == null) return '';
    final dateFormat = DateFormat('MM/dd/yyyy, hh:mm a');
    return dateFormat.format(date);
  }

  String? formatDateOnly({String format = 'MM/dd/yyyy'}) {
    final DateTime? date = this;
    return date != null ? DateFormat(format).format(date) : null;
  }

  String get formattedCustomDateOnly {
    final DateTime? date = this;
    if (date == null) return '';
    final dateFormat = DateFormat('MM/dd/yyyy');
    return dateFormat.format(date);
  }
}

String replaceFirstAndLast(String input, String i, String v) {
  if (input.isEmpty || i.isEmpty || v.isEmpty) {
    throw ArgumentError('Input string and replacements must not be empty.');
  }

  String result = input.substring(1, input.length - 1); // Get substring excluding first and last character

  // Replace first character with first character of firstReplacement
  result = i[0] + result;

  // Replace last character with first character of lastReplacement
  result = result + v[0];

  return result;
}

/* ===== lib/src/views/auth/forgot-password/forgot-password.vm.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/base.vm.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/enum/viewState.enum.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/web-services/auth.api.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/routes/routes.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/login-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/request/auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/string-extensions.dart';

class ForgotPasswordViewModel extends BaseViewModel {
  final authApi = getIt<AuthenticationApiService>();
  String? email;
  String? password;
  String? confirmPassword;

  void updateEmail(String v) => update(v, (v) => email = v);
  void updatePassword(String v) => update(v, (v) => password = v);
  void updateCPassword(String v) => update(v, (v) => confirmPassword = v);

  bool get hasEmail => email.isNotNullNorEmpty;

  bool obscureText = true;
  bool obscureCText = true;

  bool get validateField => email.isNotNullNorEmpty;

  toggleObscurePassword() {
    obscureText = !obscureText;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  toggleObscureConfirmPassword() {
    obscureCText = !obscureCText;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  login() async {
    dropKeyboard();
    viewState = ViewState.busy;
    try {
      //create the  api req for signup
      LoginResponse res = await authApi.login(LoginRequest(
        email: email!.trim(),
        password: password!.trim(),
      ));
      if (res.success) {
        final user = res.data?.user;
        // userService.getLocalUser(user: user);
        navigationService.navigateToReplace(Routes.homeRoute, argument: false);
        viewState = ViewState.idle;
        return;
      } else {
        viewState = ViewState.idle;
        //show error message if any
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      viewState = ViewState.idle;
      //show error message if any
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

  resetPassword() {
    navigationService.navigateTo(Routes.verifyOtp);
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/views/auth/login/login.vm.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/base.vm.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/activity-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/web-services/auth.api.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/routes/routes.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/request/auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/res_model.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/string-extensions.dart';

class LoginViewModel extends BaseViewModel {
  final authApi = getIt<AuthenticationApiService>();
  String? userName;
  String? password;

  void updateUserName(String v) => update(v, (v) => userName = v);
  void updatePassword(String v) => update(v, (v) => password = v);

  bool get hasUserName => userName.isNotNullNorEmpty;
  bool get hasPassword => password.isNotNullNorEmpty;

  bool get validateField => hasUserName && hasPassword;

  bool obscureText = true;

  LoginViewModel() {
    init();
  }

  TextEditingController passwordController = TextEditingController();
  TextEditingController emailController = TextEditingController();

  init() async {
    print('login in 1');
    String? email = activityService.getEmail();
    String? password = activityService.getPassword();
    print("$email $password");
    if (email.isNotNullNorEmpty && password.isNotNullNorEmpty) {
      print('login in');
      emailController.text = email ?? "";
      passwordController.text = password ?? "";
      await login(email: email, pwd: password);
    }
  }

  toggleObscurePassword() {
    obscureText = !obscureText;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  login({String? email, String? pwd}) async {
    dropKeyboard();
    startLoader();
    try {

      ResModel res = await authApi.login(LoginRequest(
        userName: email ?? userName!.trim(),
        password: pwd ?? password!.trim(),
      ));
      if (res.success ?? false) {
        navigationService.navigateToReplace(Routes.homeRoute, argument: false);
        stopLoader();
        return;
      } else {
        print(res.toString());
        stopLoader();
        //show error message if any
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      stopLoader();
      //show error message if any
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/views/auth/signup/signup.vm.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter_template/base.vm.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/string-extensions.dart';

class SignUpViewModel extends BaseViewModel {
  String? email;
  String? fName;
  String? lName;
  String? phoneNumber;
  String? password;
  String? otp;

  void updateEmail(String v) => update(v, (v) => email = v);
  void updatePhone(String v) => update(v, (v) => phoneNumber = v);
  void updateFName(String v) => update(v, (v) => fName = v);
  void updateLName(String v) => update(v, (v) => lName = v);
  void updatePassword(String v) => update(v, (v) => password = v);
  void updateOtp(String v) => update(v, (v) => otp = v);

  bool get hasEmail => email.isNotNullNorEmpty;
  bool get hasPassword => email.isNotNullNorEmpty;
  bool get hasFName => email.isNotNullNorEmpty;
  bool get hasLName => email.isNotNullNorEmpty;
  bool get hasPhone => phoneNumber.isNotNullNorEmpty && phoneNumber!.length > 9;
  bool get validateField => hasEmail && hasFName && hasLName && hasPhone && hasPassword;

  registerUser() async {}
  verifyOtpUser() async {}
}

                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  34.sbH,
                  OtpEntryField(
                    length: 5,
                    onComplete: (otp) {
                      print('OTP entered: $otp');
                      model.updateOtp(otp);
                      model.verifyOtpUser();
                    },
                  ),
                  16.sbH,
                  12.sbH,
                  ACButton(
                    color: primaryColor,
                    onPressed: () => model.navigationService.navigateToReplace(Routes.resetPassword),
                    text: "Verify",
                    loadingState: model.viewState,
                  ),
                  24.sbH,
                  ResendOtpWidget(
                    isShowingTimer: isShowingTimer,
                    resendOtpCallback: () => {},
                    customWidget: Align(
                      alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                      child: RichText(
                        textAlign: TextAlign.left,
                        text: TextSpan(
                          style: AppStyles.bStyle.copyWith(
                            fontSize: 14.0,
                            color: nTextLight,
                          ),
                          children: [
                            TextSpan(
                              text: "Didn't get an otp? ",
                              style: TextStyle(color: nTextLight, fontSize: 14),

                            TextSpan(

                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  Expanded(
                    flex: 3,
                    child: Container(),
                  ),
                  50.sbH
                ],
              ),
            )));
  }

          height: 30,
          placeholderBuilder: (BuildContext context) => Icon(Icons.error, size: 40, color: Colors.red),
        ),
        SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            color: Colors.black,
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  expandOrCollapseHeader(int index) {
    List<ValueNotifier<bool>> list = [
      activityInfo,

    list.map((e) => e.value = false).toList();
    list[index].value = !initialValue;

                          }),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ));
  }

  Widget _buildIconWithText(String svgPath, String label) {
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        SvgPicture.asset(
          svgPath,
          width: 30,
          height: 30,
          placeholderBuilder: (BuildContext context) => const Icon(Icons.error, size: 40, color: Colors.red),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(
          label,
          style: const TextStyle(
            color: Colors.black,
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

Map<String, dynamic> convertMap(Map<String, dynamic> original) {
  final Map<String, dynamic> newMap = {};

  original.forEach((key, value) {
    if (value is DateTime) {
      newMap[key] = value.toIso8601String();
    } else {
      newMap[key] = value;
    }
  });
  return newMap;
}

List<String> getDateTimeKeys(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
  final List<String> dateTimeKeys = [];

  map.forEach((key, value) {
    if (value is DateTime) {
      dateTimeKeys.add(key);
    }
  });

  return dateTimeKeys;
}

class AICA2_CivilWorksPage extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {

}

class _AICA2_CivilWorksPageState extends ConsumerState<AICA2_CivilWorksPage> {

    bool initialValue = list[index].value;
    list.map((e) => e.value = false).toList();
    list[index].value = !initialValue;

      final vm = ref.read(iActivityService);

                          SuCompHeader(subComponents: widget.subComponents),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 32),
                      if (model.isLoadingItems) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
                      10.sbH,
                      ValueListenableBuilder(
                        valueListenable: activityInfo,
                        builder: (context, basic, _) => CustomExpansionWidget(
                          title: 'Activity Information ',
                          expand: basic,
                          onTap: () => expandOrCollapseHeader(0),
                          children: [
                            const CustomText(text: "Project Id"),
                            InputController(initialValue: "", hintText: vm.activity[CWEnum.projectId.key], onChanged: (v) {}, enabled: false, keyboardType: TextInputType.text),

        {'id': 2, 'name': 'Married'},
        {'id': 3, 'name': 'Separated'},
        {'id': 4, 'name': 'Divorced'},
        {'id': 5, 'name': 'Widow'},
        {'id': 6, 'name': 'Widower'},

  // Update methods with validation

  }

  }

  }

  void updateStateOid(String v) {
    clearFieldError('stateOid');
    update(v, (v) => stateOid = v);
  }

  void updateTitleOid(String v) {
    titleOid = v;
    notifyListeners(); // Important: This triggers UI rebuild
  }

  void updateAgeBracketOid(String v) {
    ageBracketOid = v;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void updateCreatedBy(String v) => update(v, (v) => createdBy = v);
  void updateCreatedOn(String v) => update(v, (v) => createdOn = v);
  void updateDeviceName(String v) => update(v, (v) => deviceName = v);
  void updateDeviceIpAddress(String v) => update(v, (v) => deviceIpAddress = v);
  void updateDeviceUserName(String v) => update(v, (v) => deviceUserName = v);
  void updateLatitude(num v) => update(v, (v) => latitude = v);
  void updateLongitude(num v) => update(v, (v) => longitude = v);

  // Validation methods
  String? validateField(String fieldKey, dynamic value) {
    if (requiredFields.contains(fieldKey)) {
      if (value == null || value.toString().trim().isEmpty) {
        return 'This field is required';
      }
    }

    switch (fieldKey) {
      case 'primaryPhoneNo':
      case 'secondaryPhoneNo':
        if (value != null && value.toString().isNotEmpty) {
          if (!RegExp(r'^\+?[\d\s\-\(\)]{10,}$').hasMatch(value.toString())) {
            return 'Please enter a valid phone number';
          }
        }
        break;
      case 'email':
        if (value != null && value.toString().isNotEmpty) {
          if (!RegExp(r'^[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+\.\w+$').hasMatch(value.toString())) {
            return 'Please enter a valid email address';
          }
        }
        break;
      case 'nin':
        if (value != null && value.toString().isNotEmpty) {
          if (value.toString().length != 11) {
            return 'NIN must be 11 digits';
          }
        }
        break;
      case 'age':
      case 'householdSize':
        if (value != null && value.toString().isNotEmpty) {
          final numValue = int.tryParse(value.toString());
          if (numValue == null || numValue < 0) {
            return 'Please enter a valid number';
          }
        }
        break;
    }
    return null;
  }

  void setFieldError(String fieldKey, String? error) {
    if (error != null) {
      _validationErrors[fieldKey] = error;
    } else {
      _validationErrors.remove(fieldKey);
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFieldError(String fieldKey) {
    if (_validationErrors.containsKey(fieldKey)) {
      _validationErrors.remove(fieldKey);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void clearAllErrors() {
    _validationErrors.clear();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  bool validateCurrentPage() {
    bool isValid = true;
    Map<String, dynamic> fieldsToValidate = {};

    switch (_currentPage) {
      case 0: // Personal Info
        fieldsToValidate = {
          'titleOid': titleOid,
          'firstName': firstName,
          'lastName': lastName,
          'gender': gender,
          'age': age,
          'maritalStatus': maritalStatus,
        };
        break;
      case 1: // Contact Info
        fieldsToValidate = {
          'primaryPhoneNo': primaryPhoneNo,
          'secondaryPhoneNo': secondaryPhoneNo,
          'email': email,
          'nin': nin,
          'beneficiaryID': beneficiaryID,
        };
        break;
      case 2: // Additional Info
        fieldsToValidate = {
          'communityInterestGroupOid': communityInterestGroupOid,
          'householdSize': householdSize,
          'stateOid': stateOid,
          'localGovernmentOid': localGovernmentOid,
          'communityOid': communityOid,
          'primaryOccupationOid': primaryOccupationOid,
          'description': description,
        };
        break;
    }

    fieldsToValidate.forEach((fieldKey, value) {
      String? error = validateField(fieldKey, value);
      if (error != null) {
        setFieldError(fieldKey, error);
        isValid = false;
      }
    });

    return isValid;
  }

  bool validateAllFields() {
    bool isValid = true;
    Map<String, dynamic> allFields = {
      'titleOid': titleOid,
      'firstName': firstName,
      'lastName': lastName,
      'gender': gender,
      'age': age,
      'maritalStatus': maritalStatus,
      'primaryPhoneNo': primaryPhoneNo,
      'secondaryPhoneNo': secondaryPhoneNo,
      'email': email,
      'nin': nin,
      'beneficiaryID': beneficiaryID,
      'communityInterestGroupOid': communityInterestGroupOid,
      'householdSize': householdSize,
      'stateOid': stateOid,
      'localGovernmentOid': localGovernmentOid,
      'communityOid': communityOid,
      'primaryOccupationOid': primaryOccupationOid,
      'description': description,
    };

    allFields.forEach((fieldKey, value) {
      String? error = validateField(fieldKey, value);
      if (error != null) {
        setFieldError(fieldKey, error);
        isValid = false;
      }
    });

    return isValid;
  }

  // Navigation helpers
  bool get canGoNext => _currentPage < 2;
  bool get canGoPrevious => _currentPage > 0;
  bool get isLastPage => _currentPage == 2;

  void nextPage() {
    if (validateCurrentPage() && canGoNext) {
      _currentPage++;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void previousPage() {
    if (canGoPrevious) {
      _currentPage--;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  // Step information
  String getStepTitle(int step) {
    switch (step) {
      case 0:
        return "Personal Information";
      case 1:
        return "Contact Information";
      case 2:
        return "Additional Information";
      default:
        return "";
    }
  }

  String getStepSubtitle(int step) {
    switch (step) {
      case 0:
        return "Enter your basic personal details";
      case 1:
        return "Enter your contact details";
      case 2:
        return "Enter additional information";
      default:
        return "";
    }
  }

  // Helper methods for dropdown labels
  String getDropdownLabel(String fieldKey, List<Map<String, dynamic>> items, dynamic currentValue) {
    if (currentValue != null) {
      final item = items.firstWhere((item) => item['id'] == currentValue, orElse: () => {'name': _getDefaultLabel(fieldKey)});
      return item['name'];
    }
    return _getDefaultLabel(fieldKey);
  }

  String _getDefaultLabel(String fieldKey) {
    switch (fieldKey) {
      case 'titleOid':
        return "Select Title";
      case 'gender':
        return "Select Gender";
      case 'maritalStatus':
        return "Select Marital Status";
      case 'stateOid':
        return "Select State";
      case 'localGovernmentOid':
        return "Select LGA";
      case 'communityOid':
        return "Select Community";
      case 'communityInterestGroupOid':
        return "Select CIG";
      case 'primaryOccupationOid':
        return "Select Primary Occupation";
      case 'secondaryOccupationOid':
        return "Select Secondary Occupation";
      default:
        return "Select Option";
    }
  }

  // Validation helpers
  bool get hasEmail => email.isNotNullNorEmpty;
  bool get hasFirstName => firstName.isNotNullNorEmpty;
  bool get hasLastName => lastName.isNotNullNorEmpty;
  bool get hasPhone => primaryPhoneNo.isNotNullNorEmpty && primaryPhoneNo!.length > 9;
  bool get hasNin => nin.isNotNullNorEmpty;

  bool get isValid => validateAllFields();

  getAgeBracket({bool checkCache = true}) async {
    if (checkCache && appCache.ageBrackets.length != 0) {
      print(appCache.ageBrackets.length);
      return;
    }
    isLoadingItems = true;
    dropKeyboard();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<ActivityApiService>().getAgeBrackets();
      if (res.success!) {
        appCache.ageBrackets = [];
        res.data['data'].forEach((e) {
          appCache.ageBrackets.add(AgeBracket.fromJson(e));
        });
        isLoadingItems = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        isLoadingItems = false;
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      isLoadingItems = false;
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

  createCrfMembers(Map<String, dynamic> data, {Function(BeneficiaryResponse)? onDone}) async {
    print('createCrfMembers');

    isLoadingItems = true;
    startLoader();
    dropKeyboard();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<ActivityApiService>().createBeneficiaries(map: data);
      if (res.success!) {
        if (onDone != null) {
          await getIt<ActivityApiService>().getBeneficiaries();
          onDone(BeneficiaryResponse.fromJson(res.data['data']));
        }
        // navigationService.goBack();
        isLoadingItems = false;
        stopLoader();
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        stopLoader();
        isLoadingItems = false;
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      isLoadingItems = false;
      stopLoader();
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

    return Row(
      children: [
        if (model.canGoPrevious)
          Expanded(
            child: OutlinedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                model.previousPage();
                _pageController.previousPage(
                  duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
                );
              },
              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                side: BorderSide(color: primaryColor),
                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12.h),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8.r),
                ),
              ),
              child: Text(
                "Previous",
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: primaryColor,
                  fontSize: 14.sp,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        if (model.canGoPrevious) 16.sbW,
        Expanded(
          child: ACButton(
            color: primaryColor,
            onPressed: () {
              if (model.isLastPage) {
                print('\n==============');
                printWrapped("beneficiary data:::${vm.beneficiary.toString()}\n\n+++++++++++++++++++++");
                if (vm.hasCompleteValidation) {
                  model.createCrfMembers(vm.payload, onDone: (BeneficiaryResponse v) {
                    Navigator.pop(context, v);
                  });
                } else {
                  showCupertinoModalPopup(context: context, builder: (context) => Text("Please complete all cumpolsory fields"));
                }
              } else {
                model.nextPage();
                _pageController.nextPage(
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
                );
              }
            },
            text: model.isLastPage ? "Register Beneficiary" : "Next",
            loadingState: model.viewState,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

/* ===== lib/src/views/components/component-b/cb2-community-investment/cigs/beneficiaries/models.dart ===== */
class BGenericModel {
  final String? name;
  final num? id;
  BGenericModel({this.id, this.name});

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) => identical(this, other) || other is BGenericModel && runtimeType == other.runtimeType && name == other.name && id == other.id;

  @override
  int get hashCode => name.hashCode ^ id.hashCode;

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'name': name,
      'id': id,
    };
  }

  factory BGenericModel.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return BGenericModel(
      name: map['name'] as String,
      id: map['id'] as num,
    );
  }
}

List<Map<String, dynamic>> get genderOptions => [
      {'id': 0, 'name': 'Unknown'},
      {'id': 1, 'name': 'Male'},
      {'id': 2, 'name': 'Female'},
    ];

List<Map<String, dynamic>> get maritalStatusOptions => [
      {'id': 0, 'name': 'Unknown'},
      {'id': 1, 'name': 'Single'},
      {'id': 2, 'name': 'Married'},
      {'id': 3, 'name': 'Separated'},
      {'id': 4, 'name': 'Divorced'},
      {'id': 5, 'name': 'Widow'},
      {'id': 6, 'name': 'Widower'},
    ];

extension BGenericModelListMapper on List<Map<String, dynamic>> {
  List<BGenericModel> toBGenericModelList() {
    return map((map) => BGenericModel.fromMap(map)).toList();
  }
}

List<BGenericModel> get genderList => genderOptions.toBGenericModelList();
List<BGenericModel> get maritalStatusList => maritalStatusOptions.toBGenericModelList();

class _CommunityBasedOrganizationPageState extends ConsumerState<CB2_CIGPage> {
  ValueNotifier<bool> primaryInfo = ValueNotifier(false);
  ValueNotifier<bool> locationInfo = ValueNotifier(false);
  ValueNotifier<bool> accountInfo = ValueNotifier(false);

  void expandOrCollapseHeader(int index) {
    List<ValueNotifier<bool>> sections = [primaryInfo, locationInfo, accountInfo];
    bool wasOpen = sections[index].value;
    for (var section in sections) {
      section.value = false;
    }
    sections[index].value = !wasOpen;
  }

  void init(vm) {
    vm.init(component: widget.component?.displayName, subComponent: widget.subComponents, map: widget.data);
  }

    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      final vm = ref.read(iActivityService);
      init(vm);
    });
  }
