class _CreateInputsAssetsDistributionPageState extends ConsumerState<CreateInputsAssetsDistributionPage> {
  ///Expansion Controllers
  ValueNotifier<bool> activityInfo = ValueNotifier(false);
  ValueNotifier<bool> interventionInfo = ValueNotifier(false);
  ValueNotifier<bool> activityPeriod = ValueNotifier(false);
  ValueNotifier<bool> distributionInformation = ValueNotifier(false);
  ValueNotifier<bool> beneficiaryInfo = ValueNotifier(false);
  ValueNotifier<bool> resultFrameworkInfo = ValueNotifier(false);

  ///handle collapsing other widgets when a particular widget is tapped on
  expandOrCollapseHeader(int index) {
    List<ValueNotifier<bool>> list = [activityInfo, interventionInfo, activityPeriod, distributionInformation, beneficiaryInfo, resultFrameworkInfo];
    bool initialValue = list[index].value;
    list.map((e) => e.value = false).toList();
    list[index].value = !initialValue;
  }

  init(DistributionActivityController form) {
    form.init(map: widget.data);
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    // TODO: implement initState
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      final form = ref.read(iDistributionActivityService);
      form.init(map: widget.data, component: widget.component?.name, subComponent: widget.subComponents);
    });
  }

  BeneficiaryResponse? selectedBeneficiary;
  List<BeneficiaryResponse> selectedBeneficiaries = [];

  // Updated _getInitials method using firstName and lastName
  String _getInitials(BeneficiaryResponse beneficiary) {
    String initials = "";

    if (beneficiary.firstName != null && beneficiary.firstName!.isNotEmpty) {
      initials += beneficiary.firstName![0];
    }
    if (beneficiary.lastName != null && beneficiary.lastName!.isNotEmpty) {
      initials += beneficiary.lastName![0];
    }

    return initials.isNotEmpty ? initials.toUpperCase() : "?";
  }

// New method to convert gender integer to text
  String _getGenderText(dynamic gender) {
    if (gender == 0) return "Female";
    if (gender == 1) return "Male";
    return "N/A";
  }

// Your existing _buildInfoItem method
  Widget _buildInfoItem(String label, String? value) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 12.sp,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
            color: Colors.grey[600],
          ),
        ),
        SizedBox(height: 4.h),
        Text(
          value ?? "N/A",
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 14.sp,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

                                        (beneficiary.beneficiaryID?.toLowerCase().contains(searchQuery) ?? false) ||

                                        (beneficiary.nin?.contains(searchQuery) ?? false);

                                        Icon(
                                          Icons.people_alt_outlined,

                                              ).then((newBeneficiary) {
                                                if (newBeneficiary != null) {
                                                  setState(() {

                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  SizedBox(height: 20.h),
                                ],
                              ],
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),

                      ///Result Framework Information
                      12.sbH,

                      ValueListenableBuilder(
                        valueListenable: resultFrameworkInfo,
                        builder: (context, basic, _) => CustomExpansionWidget(title: 'Result Framework Information', expand: basic, onTap: () => expandOrCollapseHeader(5), children: [
                          const CustomText(text: "Result Framework \n(PDO Level Indicators)"),

                                onListSelected: (v) => vm.addValue(AfEnum.pdo.key, v.map((e) => e.toPDOMap()).toList())),

                          if (model.isCLI) const CustomText(text: "Select Component Indicator"),
                          if (model.isCLI)

                                isList: true,
                                labelText: vm.activity[AfEnum.cli.key]?[0]['name'] ?? "Select Component Indicator",
                                title: "Component Indicator",
                                items: (model.appCache.componentIndicators).sortByString((v) => v.name ?? ""),

Map<String, dynamic> convertMap(Map<String, dynamic> original) {
  final Map<String, dynamic> newMap = {};

  original.forEach((key, value) {
    if (value is DateTime) {
      newMap[key] = value.toIso8601String();
    } else {
      newMap[key] = value;
    }
  });
  return newMap;
}

List<String> getDateTimeKeys(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
  final List<String> dateTimeKeys = [];

  map.forEach((key, value) {
    if (value is DateTime) {
      dateTimeKeys.add(key);
    }
  });

  return dateTimeKeys;
}

/* ===== lib/src/views/components/component.vm.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/base.vm.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/api-routes.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/controllers/afforestation_form_controller.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/enum/activity-fields.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/web-services/activity-api.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/routes/routes.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/activity-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/banks-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/beneficiary-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/community-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/component-model.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/components-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/implementer-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/input-category-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/intervention-categories.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/intervention-types.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/lga-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/micro-catchment-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/request/input-asset-type-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/res_model.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/sites-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/states-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/strategic-catchement-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/isolate.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/string-extensions.dart';
import 'package:oktoast/oktoast.dart';

import '../../../constant/palette.dart';
import '../../model/cigs-response.dart';
import '../../model/request/save-activity/create-afforestation-activity-model.dart';

class ComponentViewModel extends BaseViewModel {
  bool isExpanded = false;

  // bool selectedSubComponent = false;
  final ActivityApiService _apiService = getIt<ActivityApiService>();

  ValueNotifier<SubComponentEnum?> selectedSubComponent = ValueNotifier(null);
  ValueNotifier<SemiSubComponentEnum?> selectedSemiSubComponent = ValueNotifier(null);
  ValueNotifier<ComponentsRes?> selectedComp = ValueNotifier(null);
  ValueNotifier<num?> selectedSubCompIndex = ValueNotifier(null);
  List<String> subComponents = [
    "Sub Component Child 1",
    "Sub Component Child 2",
    "Sub Component Child 3",
  ];

  validate() {
    if (selectedSemiSubComponent.value != null) {
      if (selectedSubComponent.value?.semiSubComponents != null) {
        if (selectedSemiSubComponent.value != null) {
          //navigate with semi sub component
          navigationService.navigateTo(Routes.subComponentDashboardRoute,
              argument:
                  ComponentModel(componentEnum: selectedSubComponent.value!.getParentComponent, subComponentEnum: selectedSubComponent.value, semiSubComponentEnum: selectedSemiSubComponent.value));
        } else {
          showToast("Please select the necessary sub component");
        }
      } else {
        // navigate w/o semi sub components
        navigationService.navigateTo(Routes.subComponentDashboardRoute,
            argument: ComponentModel(componentEnum: selectedSubComponent.value!.getParentComponent, subComponentEnum: selectedSubComponent.value));
      }
    } else {
      showToast("Please select the necessary sub component");
    }
  }

  validate_() {
    print(selectedComp.value?.subComponents?.length);
    if (selectedComp.value != null) {
      if (selectedComp.value?.subComponents?.length != 0) {
        if (selectedSubCompIndex.value != null) {
          //navigate with semi sub component
          navigationService.navigateTo(Routes.subComponentDashboardRoute, argument: {"b": IComponentModel(componentsRes: selectedComp.value!, indexOfSubComp: selectedSubCompIndex.value)});
        } else {
          showToast("Please select the necessary sub component");
        }
      } else {
        // navigate w/o semi sub components
        navigationService.navigateTo(Routes.subComponentDashboardRoute, argument: {'b': IComponentModel(componentsRes: selectedComp.value!, indexOfSubComp: selectedSubCompIndex.value)});
      }
    } else {
      showToast("Please select the necessary sub component");
    }
  }

  bool _isFetchingActivities = false;
  bool _isLoadingItems = false;
  bool _isSubmittingItems = false;

  bool get isSubmittingItems => _isSubmittingItems;

  set isSubmittingItems(bool value) {
    _isSubmittingItems = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  bool get isFetchingActivities => _isFetchingActivities;

  bool get isLoadingItems => _isLoadingItems;
  set isLoadingItems(bool value) {
    _isLoadingItems = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  set isFetchingActivities(bool value) {
    _isFetchingActivities = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> loadData(String? code) async {
    await getActivitiesList(code: code);
    await getCigs(checkCache: true);
    await getCommunities(checkCache: true);
    await getBeneficiaries(checkCache: true);
  }

  getCommunities({bool checkCache = true}) async {
    if (checkCache && appCache.communities.length != 0) {
      print(appCache.communities.length);
      return;
    }
    isLoadingItems = true;
    dropKeyboard();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<ActivityApiService>().getCommunities();
      if (res.success!) {
        appCache.communities = [];
        res.data['data'].forEach((e) {
          appCache.communities.add(Community.fromJson(e));
        });
        isLoadingItems = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        isLoadingItems = false;
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      isLoadingItems = false;
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

  getActivitiesList({bool checkCache = true, String? code}) async {
    if (checkCache && !getActivities(code).isNotNullNorEmpty) {
      isFetchingActivities = false;
      appCache.initializeActivitiesFromApi([ActivityResponse()]);
      notifyListeners();
      print('no items');
      return;
    }

    isFetchingActivities = true;
    dropKeyboard();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<ActivityApiService>().getActivities_(code!);
      if (res.success!) {
        List<ActivityResponse> list = [];
        res.data['data'].forEach((e) {
          list.add(ActivityResponse.fromJson(e));
        });
        // appCache.initializeActivitiesFromApi(list);
        appCache.activityListItems.value = list;
        isFetchingActivities = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        isFetchingActivities = false;
        print(res.toString());
        // stopLoader();
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      isFetchingActivities = false;
      print(stack.toString());
      // stopLoader();
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

  getStates({bool checkCache = true}) async {
    if (checkCache && appCache.states.length != 0) {
      return;
    }
    isLoadingItems = true;
    dropKeyboard();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<ActivityApiService>().getStates();
      if (res.success!) {
        appCache.states = [];
        res.data['data'].forEach((e) {

        isLoadingItems = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        isLoadingItems = false;
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      isLoadingItems = false;
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

  getNatOfInterventionById_(AfforestationActivityController vm, {required String id}) async {
    isLoadingItems = true;
    dropKeyboard();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<ActivityApiService>().getNatureOfInterventionById(id: id);

      if (res.success!) {
        vm.activity[AfEnum.natureOfIntervention.key] = null;
        selectedNatureOfInterventions = [];
        res.data['data'].forEach((e) {
          if (e != null) {
            selectedNatureOfInterventions.add(NatureOfInterventions.fromJson(e));
          }
        });
        isLoadingItems = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        if ((res.message ?? "").contains("No records found")) {
          vm.activity[AfEnum.natureOfIntervention.key] = null;
          selectedNatureOfInterventions = [];
        }
        isLoadingItems = false;
        // showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      isLoadingItems = false;
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      // showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

      getInputAssetCategory(checkCache: false),
      getInputAssetType(checkCache: false),
      getLGAs(checkCache: true),
      getInterventionCategories(checkCache: false),
      getNatureOfIntervention(),
      getImplementers(checkCache: true),
      getSites(checkCache: false),
      getTOR(checkCache: true),
      getCigs(checkCache: true),
    ] as Iterable<Future>);

  submitActivity() async {
    dropKeyboard();
    startLoader();
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2));
    showToast(position: ToastPosition.bottom, backgroundColor: colorGreen, "Activity Created Successfully!");
    navigationService.navigateToReplace(Routes.homeRoute);
    stopLoader();
  }

  setIndicator(IndicatorType v) {
    indicatorType = v;
    notifyListeners();

  IndicatorType? indicatorType;
  bool get isPDO => indicatorType == IndicatorType.pdoIndicator;
  bool get isCLI => indicatorType == IndicatorType.cliIndicator;

  getInputAssetType({bool checkCache = true}) async {
    if (checkCache && appCache.inputAssetTypes.isNotEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    isLoadingItems = true;
    dropKeyboard();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<ActivityApiService>().inputAssetTypes();
      if (res.success!) {
        appCache.inputAssetTypes = [];
        res.data['data'].forEach((e) {
          appCache.inputAssetTypes.add(InputAssetType.fromJson(e));
        });
        isLoadingItems = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        isLoadingItems = false;
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      isLoadingItems = false;
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_screenutil/flutter_screenutil.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/base.ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/palette.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/component-model.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/components-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/widget_extensions.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/views/components/component.vm.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/animated-list.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/custom_btn.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/header.dart';

class SelectSubComponentPage extends StatefulWidget {
  final ComponentEnum component;
  final ComponentsRes? comp;
  const SelectSubComponentPage({Key? key, required this.component, this.comp}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _SelectSubComponentPageState createState() => _SelectSubComponentPageState();
}

class _SelectSubComponentPageState extends State<SelectSubComponentPage> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BaseView<ComponentViewModel>(
      builder: (context, model, child) => Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: white,
        body: Container(
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20.w),
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              children: [
                HeaderWidget(),
                10.sbH,
                ValueListenableBuilder(
                    valueListenable: model.selectedSubComponent,
                    builder: (context, sc, _) => ValueListenableBuilder(
                          valueListenable: model.selectedComp,
                          builder: (context, semiSC, _) => Column(
                            children: [
                              AnimatedSelectionList<ISubComponents>(
                                title: "${widget.comp?.name}: ${widget.comp?.description}",
                                items: widget.comp?.subComponents ?? [],
                                titleBuilder: (item) => item.displayName ?? "", // Extract string from your model
                                onItemSelected: (selectedItem) {
                                  model.selectedComp.value = widget.comp;
                                  model.selectedSubCompIndex.value = widget.comp?.subComponents?.indexOf(selectedItem);
                                },
                              )
                            ],
                          ),
                        )),
                16.sbH,
                ACButton(
                  color: primaryColor,
                  onPressed: () => model.validate_(),
                  text: "Continue",
                  loadingState: model.viewState,
                ),
                16.sbH,
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _SubComponentDashboardPageState extends State<SubComponentDashboardPage> {
  final List<Color> cardColors = [
    primaryColor,
    greenDark,
    secondaryColor,
    Colors.orange[800]!,
  ];

  ComponentsRes? get component => widget.comp?.componentsRes;
  ISubComponents? get subComponent {
    // Use temp variables to avoid multiple null checks and index conversions
    final components = widget.comp?.componentsRes.subComponents;
    final rawIndex = widget.comp?.indexOfSubComp;



    // Validate all values in sequence
    return components != null && rawIndex != null && rawIndex >= 0 && rawIndex < components.length ? components[rawIndex.toInt()] : null;
  }

  List<ISubComponents> get subComponents => component?.subComponents ?? [];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    print(subComponent?.toJson());

                    child: ConstrainedBox(
                      constraints: BoxConstraints(
                        minHeight: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height, // Ensures it fills the screen

                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                            style: TextStyle(
                              color: Colors.black,

                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            ),
                            textAlign: TextAlign.left,

                          6.sbH,

                            style: TextStyle(
                              color: Colors.black,

                                      print("component name ${subComponent?.code ?? subComponent?.oid}");

                                      model.navigationService.navigateTo("/${subComponent?.code ?? subComponent?.oid}", argument: {'subComponent': subComponent, 'component': component});

                                    textColor: primaryColor, // Custom text color
                                    iconColor: Colors.white, // Custom icon color
                                    borderRadius: 12.0, // Custom border radius
                                  ),
                              ],
                            ),

                          // CRF scenario - Shows CIG selection
                          if ((subComponent?.isCrFComponent ?? true) &&
                              (subComponent?.code == isCRFCode) &&
                              (cache.userCurrentRole.value.canCreateActivities!))
                            ValueListenableBuilder<List<Cig>>(
                              valueListenable: model.appCache.cigs,
                              builder: (context, cigResponses, child) {
                                return PAnimatedSelectionList<Cig>(
                                  title: "Select CIG Option",
                                  items: sortListByField(cigResponses, (p) => p.name ?? ""),
                                  titleBuilder: (item) => item.name ?? "",
                                  onItemSelected: (selectedItem) {
                                    model.navigationService.navigateTo(Routes.crfCigsRoute, argument: {
                                      'subComponent': subComponent,
                                      'component': component,
                                      'cig': selectedItem,
                                    });
                                  },
                                  enableSearch: true,
                                  searchHint: "Search CIG...",
                                  enablePagination: true,
                                  itemsPerPage: 10,
                                  selectedColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                  paginationButtonColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                  showPageNumbers: true,
                                  showPageInfo: true,
                                  previousButtonText: 'Prev',
                                  nextButtonText: 'Next',
                                );
                              },
                            ),

                          24.sbH,

                          // Afforestation scenario - Shows Activity Table
                          if (!(subComponent?.isCrFComponent ?? false) &&
                              (subComponent?.code == isAfforestationCode) &&
                              (cache.userCurrentRole.value.canCreateActivities!))
                            StreamedSimpleActivityTable1(
                              valueListenable: model.appCache.activityListItems,
                              isLoading: model.isFetchingActivities,
                              maxItems: 10,
                              onEdit: (activity) {},
                              onViewMore: () {
                                // Navigate to the full table view
                                Navigator.push(
                                  context,
                                  MaterialPageRoute(
                                    builder: (context) => FullActivityTableScreen(
                                      activityStream: model.appCache.activityListItems.value,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                );
                              },
                            ),

                          // Input Distribution scenario - Shows custom empty state
                          if ((subComponent?.isCrFComponent ?? false) &&
                              (subComponent?.code == isInputDistributionCode) &&
                              (cache.userCurrentRole.value.canCreateActivities!))
                            Column(
                              children: [
                                EmptyState(
                                  title: "Inputs/Assets Activities",
                                  subTitle: "You have no Input Distribution activity.\nCreate a new inputs/assets activity,",
                                  showButton: true,
                                  action: (){
                                    print("component name ${subComponent?.code ?? subComponent?.oid}");
                                    print(component?.toJson());
                                    model.navigationService.navigateTo("/${subComponent?.code ?? subComponent?.oid}", argument: {'subComponent': subComponent, 'component': component});

                                  },
                                  btnTitle: "Create Activity",
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),

                          // Catch-all scenario - Shows dynamic empty state for everything else
                          if ((cache.userCurrentRole.value.canCreateActivities!) &&
                              (subComponent?.code != isAfforestationCode) &&
                              (subComponent?.code != isCRFCode) &&
                              (subComponent?.code != isInputDistributionCode))
                            Column(
                              children: [
                                EmptyState(
                                  title: "No Recent Activities",
                                  subTitle: "You have no activity on ${widget.comp?.componentsRes.displayName ?? 'activity'}.",
                                  showButton: true,
                                  action: (){
                                    // Add your generic navigation logic here
                                    model.navigationService.goBack();
                                  },
                                  btnTitle: "Go Back",
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),

                          200.sbH,
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class BottomNavPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const BottomNavPage({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _BottomNavPageState createState() => _BottomNavPageState();
}

class _BottomNavPageState extends State<BottomNavPage> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BaseView<OnBoardingViewModel>(
        builder: (context, model, child) => Scaffold(
              resizeToAvoidBottomInset: false,
              backgroundColor: lightBlueBg,
              bottomNavigationBar: BottomAppBar(
                elevation: 0,
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 10),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white, // Ensure a visible background color
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30), // Small border radius
                    // boxShadow: [
                    //   // Optional: Add shadow for better visibility
                    //   BoxShadow(
                    //     color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.5),
                    //     blurRadius: 4,
                    //     offset: Offset(0, 2),
                    //   ),
                    // ],
                  ),
                  // clipBehavior: Cli
                  // p.hardEdge,
                  // Clip overflowing children
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.max,
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: navigationModel
                        .map(
                          (e) => InkWell(
                            highlightColor: Colors.transparent,
                            splashFactory: NoSplash.splashFactory,
                            child: AnimatedContainer(
                              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                              padding: e.index == model.selectedIndex ? const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4) : EdgeInsets.zero,
                              child: Column(
                                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                                children: [
                                  SvgPicture.asset(
                                    e.icon,
                                    color: e.index == model.selectedIndex ? greenDark : textLight,
                                  ),
                                  SizedBox(height: 3), // Replace 3.0.sbH
                                  Text(
                                    e.title,
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      color: e.index == model.selectedIndex ? greenDark : textLight,
                                      fontSize: 12,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                            onTap: () {
                                if (e.index == 2) {
                                  showMenuBottomSheet(context); // Open BottomSheet when 3rd icon clicked
                                } else {
                                  model.onItemTapped(e
                                      .index); // Normal page switching
                                }
                            },
                          ),
                        )
                        .toList(),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            // ResultFrameWorkPage()
              body: Container(
                child: <Widget>[const HomePage(), const HomePage(), const HomePage(), const ProfilePage()].elementAt(model.selectedIndex),
              ),
            ));
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/base.vm.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/acitivities-response-service.dart';

import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/acresal-user-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/component-indicator-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/components-response.dart' hide ComponentIndicator;
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/pdo-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/res_model.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/weather-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/location-utils.dart';

import '../../../constant/palette.dart';
import '../../../core/services/activity-service.dart';
import '../../../core/services/user.service.dart';
import '../../../routes/routes.dart';

class HomeViewModel extends BaseViewModel {
  final userApi = getIt<UserApiService>();
  final activityService = getIt<ActivityService>();

  Map<String, double> dataMap = {
    "Component A": 5,
    "Component B": 3,
    "Component C": 2,
    "Component D": 2,
  };

  final List<Color> colorList = [primaryColor, greenDark, secondaryColor, colorGreen];

  HomeViewModel() {
    refresh();
  }

  bool _isLoadingWeather = false;

  bool get isLoadingWeather => _isLoadingWeather;

  set isLoadingWeather(bool value) {
    _isLoadingWeather = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  bool _isLoadingComponents = false;

  bool get isLoadingComponents => _isLoadingComponents;

  set isLoadingComponents(bool value) {
    _isLoadingComponents = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  bool _isLoadingUserDetails = false;
  bool get isLoadingUserDetails => _isLoadingUserDetails;

  set isLoadingUserDetails(bool value) {
    _isLoadingUserDetails = value;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  WeatherRes? get weatherRes => appCache.weatherInfo;
  getWeatherInfo({bool checkCache = true}) async {
    if (checkCache && appCache.weatherInfo != null) {
      return;
    }
    isLoadingWeather = true;

    dropKeyboard();
    // startLoader();
    try {
      cache.position = await determinePosition();
      ResModel res = await getIt<ComponentsApiService>().getWeather(lat: cache.position?.latitude.toString(), long: cache.position?.longitude.toString());
      if (res.success!) {
        // stopLoader();
        appCache.weatherInfo = WeatherRes.fromJson(res.data);
        isLoadingWeather = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        isLoadingWeather = false;
        print(res.toString());
        // stopLoader();
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      isLoadingWeather = false;
      print(stack.toString());
      // stopLoader();
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

  getUserDetails({bool checkCache = true}) async {
    if (checkCache && appCache.acresalUser != null) {
      return;
    }
    dropKeyboard();
    isLoadingUserDetails = true;
    // startLoader();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<UserService>().getUser();
      if (res.success!) {
        userService.userCredentialsNotifier.value = (AcresalUser.fromJson(res.data['data']));
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        isLoadingUserDetails = false;
        stopLoader();
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      isLoadingUserDetails = false;
      print(stack.toString());
      stopLoader();
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

  getComponents({bool checkCache = true}) async {
    if (checkCache && appCache.components?.length != 0) {
      return;
    }
    dropKeyboard();
    isLoadingComponents = true;
    // startLoader();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<ComponentsApiService>().getComponents();
      if (res.success!) {
        isLoadingComponents = false;
        // stopLoader();
        appCache.components = [];
        if (res.data != null) {
          // Check if data is a List
          if (res.data['data'] is List) {
            (res.data['data'] as List).forEach((e) {
              if (e != null) {
                appCache.components?.add(ComponentsRes.fromJson(e));
              }
            });
          }
          // If data is a Map, extract the actual list (adjust key as needed)
          else if (res.data is Map && res.data.containsKey('results')) {
            (res.data['results'] as List).forEach((e) {
              if (e != null) {
                appCache.components?.add(ComponentsRes.fromJson(e));
              }
            });
          }
        }

        // Sort by name in ascending order (A-Z)
        appCache.components?.sort((a, b) => (a.name ?? "").compareTo((b.name ?? "")));

        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        isLoadingComponents = false;
        print(res.toString());
        stopLoader();
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      isLoadingComponents = false;
      print(stack.toString());
      stopLoader();
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

  getComponentsIndicator({bool checkCache = true}) async {
    if (checkCache && appCache.componentIndicators?.length != 0) {
      return;
    }

    dropKeyboard();
    startLoader();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<ComponentsApiService>().getComponentsIndicators();
      if (res.success!) {
        stopLoader();
        if (res.data['data'] != null) {
          // Check if data is a List
          if (res.data['data'] is List) {
            (res.data['data'] as List).forEach((e) {
              if (e != null) {
                appCache.componentIndicators?.add(ComponentIndicator.fromJson(e));
              }
            });
          }
          // If data is a Map, extract the actual list (adjust key as needed)
          // else if (res.data is Map && res.data.containsKey('results')) {
          //   (res.data['results'] as List).forEach((e) {
          //     if (e != null) {
          //       appCache.componentIndicators?.add(ComponentIndicator.fromJson(e));
          //     }
          //   });
          // }
        }

        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        print(res.toString());
        stopLoader();
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      print(stack.toString());
      stopLoader();
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

  getPDOIndicator({bool checkCache = true}) async {
    if (checkCache && appCache.pdoIndicatorModel.length != 0) {
      return;
    }

    dropKeyboard();
    startLoader();
    try {
      ResModel res = await getIt<ComponentsApiService>().getPDOIndicators();
      if (res.success!) {
        stopLoader();

        // res.data.forEach((e) {
        //   if (e != null) {
        //     appCache.pdoIndicatorModel.add(PDOIndicatorModel.fromJson(e));
        //   }
        // });
        if (res.data != null) {
          // Check if data is a List
          if (res.data['data'] is List) {
            (res.data['data'] as List).forEach((e) {
              if (e != null) {
                appCache.pdoIndicatorModel.add(PDOIndicatorModel.fromJson(e));
              }
            });
          }
          // If data is a Map, extract the actual list (adjust key as needed)
          // else if (res.data is Map && res.data.containsKey('results')) {
          //   (res.data['results'] as List).forEach((e) {
          //     if (e != null) {
          //       appCache.pdoIndicatorModel.add(PDOIndicatorModel.fromJson(e));
          //     }
          //   });
          // }
        }

        notifyListeners();
        return;
      } else {
        print(res.toString());
        stopLoader();
        showError(() {}, msg: res.message!);
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      print(stack.toString());
      stopLoader();
      debugPrint(e.toString());
      showError(() {}, msg: errorMessage);
    }
  }

  void refresh() async {
    await getComponentsIndicator(checkCache: true);
    await getPDOIndicator();
    await getWeatherInfo();
    await getComponents();
    await getUserDetails();
  }

  Future<void> logout() async {
    try {
      await activityService.clearAuthData();
      await activityService.closeAuthBox();
      navigationService.navigateToAndRemoveUntil(Routes.loginRoute);
      print('User logged out successfully');
    } catch (e) {
      print('Error during logout: $e');
    }
  }
}

class ServiceGrid extends StatefulWidget {
  final HomeViewModel model;
  const ServiceGrid({Key? key, required this.model}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<ServiceGrid> createState() => _ServiceGridState();
}

class _ServiceGridState extends State<ServiceGrid> {
  int? selectedIndex;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
      child: GridView.builder(
        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        shrinkWrap: true,
        physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
        gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
          crossAxisCount: 2,
          mainAxisSpacing: 16,
          crossAxisSpacing: 16,
          childAspectRatio: 1,
        ),
        itemCount: widget.model.appCache.components?.length, // services.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final isLarge = index % 2 == 0;
          final height = isLarge ? 150.0 : 100.0;
          final width = isLarge ? 140.0 : 99.0;
          return IServiceCard(
            componentEnum: ComponentEnum.values[index],
            service: widget.model.appCache.components?[index], //services[index],
            isSelected: selectedIndex == index,
            height: height,
            width: width,
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

class IServiceCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final ComponentsRes? service;
  ComponentEnum componentEnum;
  final bool isSelected;
  final double height;
  final double width;

  IServiceCard({Key? key, required this.service, required this.isSelected, required this.height, required this.width, this.componentEnum = ComponentEnum.componentA}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => service?.subComponents?.length != 0
          ? Navigator.pushNamed(context, Routes.selectSubComponentRoute, arguments: {'a': componentEnum, 'b': service})
          : Navigator.pushNamed(context, Routes.subComponentDashboardRoute, arguments: {"b": IComponentModel(componentsRes: service!, indexOfSubComp: 0)}
              // {'a': ComponentModel(componentEnum: componentEnum), 'b': service}
              ),
      child: Container(
        height: isSelected ? height * 1.2 : height, // Bigger height for selected card
        width: isSelected ? width * 1.2 : width, // Adjust width proportionally
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: cardBg,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected ? const Color(0xff2B7C44) : const Color(0xffE0F6FF),
            width: isSelected ? 2 : 1, // Thicker border for selected card
          ),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.05),
              blurRadius: 8,
              offset: const Offset(0, 2),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // Top icons
            // Row(
            //   mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
            //   children: [
            //     SvgPicture.asset(
            //       'refresh'.svg,
            //       height: 20,
            //       width: 20,
            //     ),
            //     const SizedBox(width: 8),
            //     SvgPicture.asset(
            //       'details'.svg,
            //       height: 20,
            //       width: 20,
            //     ),
            //   ],
            // ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),

            // Component icon
            SvgPicture.asset(
              'assets/images/ca.svg',
              height: 32,
              width: 32,
              color: isSelected ? const Color(0xff2B7C44) : Colors.grey,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Title
            Text(
              service?.name ?? "",
              // service.title ?? "",
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: isSelected ? 16 : 14,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: isSelected ? const Color(0xff2B7C44) : Colors.black,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),

            // Description
            Text(
              service?.description ?? "",
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                color: Colors.black,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

void showMenuBottomSheet(BuildContext context) {
  showModalBottomSheet(
    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
    ),
    backgroundColor: Colors.white,
    context: context,
    builder: (context) {
      return Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20.0),
        child: Wrap(
          children: [
            Center(
              child: Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 4,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.grey[400],
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(height: 20),
           //build upload
            _buildMenuItem(
              icon: Icons.bar_chart_outlined,
              title: 'Generate Report',
              onTap: () {
                Navigator.pop(context);
                // Navigate or perform action
              },
            ),


            Divider(),
            _buildMenuItem(
              icon: Icons.close,
              title: 'Cancel',
              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context),
              color: Colors.red,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    },
  );
}

Widget _buildMenuItem({required IconData icon, required String title, required VoidCallback onTap, Color? color}) {
  return ListTile(
    leading: Icon(icon, color: color ?? Colors.black),
    title: Text(
      title,
      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: color ?? Colors.black),
    ),
    onTap: onTap,
  );
}

/* ===== lib/src/views/onboarding/splash.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_screenutil/flutter_screenutil.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/base.ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/palette.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/notification-handler.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/routes/routes.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/string-extensions.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/views/onboarding/onboarding.vm.dart';

class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _SplashScreenState createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen> with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _animationController;
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _animation;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
      vsync: this,
    );
    _animation = Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: 1).animate(_controller);

    // Start the animation when the widget is inserted into the tree
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _controller.forward();
    });

    // Add a listener to the controller to detect when the animation is complete
    _controller.addStatusListener((status) {
      if (status == AnimationStatus.completed) {
        continueAfterSplash();
        ;
      }
    });
  }

  void continueAfterSplash() {
    Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, isFirstLaunch.isNotNullNorEmpty ? Routes.loginRoute : Routes.onboardingPageRoute);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return BaseView<OnBoardingViewModel>(
        builder: (context, model, child) => Scaffold(
            backgroundColor: white,
            body: Container(
              decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                  begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                  end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                  colors: [
                    Color(0xFF3E7A46), // Lightest green
                    Color(0xFF264229),
                    Colors.black // Darkest green
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20.w),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  Center(
                    child: ClipRect(
                      child: AnimatedBuilder(
                        animation: _animation,
                        builder: (context, child) {
                          return Align(
                            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                            widthFactor: _animation.value,
                            child: Row(
                              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                              children: [
                                Image.asset(
                                  'splash_logo'.png,
                                  scale: 2.0,
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                ],
              ),
            )));
  }
}

        // Shimmer for email/phone

        const SizedBox(height: 24),

        // Shimmer for Account section
        Align(
          alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
          child: _shimmerBox(width: 80, height: 14),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        _shimmerCard(itemCount: 1),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),

        // Shimmer for Security section
        Align(
          alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
          child: _shimmerBox(width: 140, height: 14),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        _shimmerCard(itemCount: 6),
        const SizedBox(height: 20),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _shimmerCircle(double size) {
    return Container(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        shape: BoxShape.circle,
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.centerLeft,
          end: Alignment.centerRight,
          colors: [
            Colors.grey[300]!,
            Colors.grey[100]!,
            Colors.grey[300]!,
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _shimmerBox({required double width, required double height}) {
    return Container(
      width: width,
      height: height,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.centerLeft,
          end: Alignment.centerRight,
          colors: [
            Colors.grey[300]!,
            Colors.grey[100]!,
            Colors.grey[300]!,
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _shimmerCard({required int itemCount}) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
      child: Column(
        children: List.generate(
          itemCount,
          (index) => Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                _shimmerCircle(24),
                const SizedBox(width: 16),
                Expanded(
                    child: _shimmerBox(width: double.infinity, height: 14)),
                const SizedBox(width: 16),
                _shimmerBox(width: 16, height: 16),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBulletPoint(String text) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 16, bottom: 8),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          const Text('• ', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, height: 1.2)),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              text,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15, height: 1.5),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // Helper to build Section Title
  Widget sectionTitle(String title) {
    return Align(
      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
      child: Text(
        title,
        style: const TextStyle(
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          fontSize: 14,
          color: Colors.black54,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Helper to build a card box
  Widget cardBox({required List<Widget> children}) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
      child: Column(
        children: children,
      ),
    );
  }

  // Helper to build a list tile item
  Widget listTileItem(String title, IconData icon, {VoidCallback? onTap}) {
    return ListTile(
      leading: Icon(icon, color: Colors.black87),
      title: Text(title, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
      trailing: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded, size: 16),
      onTap: onTap,
    );
  }

  // Helper to build a switch tile item
  Widget switchTileItem(String title, IconData icon) {
    bool switchValue =
        title == 'Notifications'; // Notifications ON, others OFF by default
    return StatefulBuilder(
      builder: (context, setState) {
        return SwitchListTile(
          secondary: Icon(icon, color: Colors.black87),
          title:
              Text(title, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
          value: switchValue,
          onChanged: (bool value) {
            setState(() {
              switchValue = value;
            });
          },
          activeColor: Colors.green,
          inactiveThumbColor: Colors.grey,
          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/palette.dart';

class Fancy404Page extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback onHomePressed;

  const Fancy404Page({Key? key, required this.onHomePressed}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _Fancy404PageState createState() => _Fancy404PageState();
}

class _Fancy404PageState extends State<Fancy404Page> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _rotationAnimation;
  late Animation<double> _bounceAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(seconds: 10),
      vsync: this,
    )..repeat();

    _rotationAnimation = Tween<double>(
      begin: 0,
      end: 2 * math.pi,
    ).animate(CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _controller,
      curve: Curves.linear,
    ));

    _bounceAnimation = Tween<double>(
      begin: 0,
      end: 1,
    ).animate(CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _controller,
      curve: Curves.elasticInOut,
    ));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [
              primaryColor,
              // Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
              // Colors.blue.shade900,
              // Theme.of(context).,
              greenDark
            ],
          ),
        ),
        child: Center(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              // Animated 404 text
              TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: 1),
                duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
                curve: Curves.elasticOut,
                builder: (context, value, child) {
                  return Transform.scale(
                    scale: value,
                    child: child,
                  );
                },
                child: Text(
                  '404',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 120,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    shadows: [
                      Shadow(
                        blurRadius: 10.0,
                        color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.3),
                        offset: const Offset(5.0, 5.0),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 20),

              // Animated spinning planets
              Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  AnimatedBuilder(
                    animation: _rotationAnimation,
                    builder: (context, child) {
                      return Transform.rotate(
                        angle: _rotationAnimation.value,
                        child: Container(
                          height: 30,
                          width: 30,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            gradient: RadialGradient(
                              colors: [Colors.amber, Colors.orange.shade700],
                            ),
                            boxShadow: [
                              BoxShadow(
                                color: Colors.amber.withOpacity(0.6),
                                blurRadius: 10,
                                spreadRadius: 2,
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 20),
                  AnimatedBuilder(
                    animation: _bounceAnimation,
                    builder: (context, child) {
                      return Transform.translate(
                        offset: Offset(0, math.sin(_controller.value * 5) * 10),
                        child: Text(
                          'Page Not Found',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 28,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                            color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.9),
                            letterSpacing: 1.2,
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 20),
                  AnimatedBuilder(
                    animation: _rotationAnimation,
                    builder: (context, child) {
                      return Transform.rotate(
                        angle: -_rotationAnimation.value,
                        child: Container(
                          height: 20,
                          width: 20,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            gradient: RadialGradient(
                              colors: [Colors.lightBlue, Colors.blue.shade700],
                            ),
                            boxShadow: [
                              BoxShadow(
                                color: Colors.blue.withOpacity(0.6),
                                blurRadius: 10,
                                spreadRadius: 2,
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 40),

              // Floating astronaut
              AnimatedBuilder(
                animation: _controller,
                builder: (context, child) {
                  return Transform.translate(
                    offset: Offset(
                      math.sin(_controller.value * 2) * 30,
                      math.cos(_controller.value * 3) * 20,
                    ),
                    child: Transform.rotate(
                      angle: math.sin(_controller.value) * 0.2,
                      child: const Icon(
                        Icons.person,
                        size: 60,
                        color: Colors.white,
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 40),

              // Message
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24.0),
                child: Text(
                  "Looks like you've wandered into the void of space. The page you're looking for has either been moved or doesn't exist.",
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.7),
                    height: 1.5,
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 50),

              // Button to return home
