/* ===== lib/src/widgets/acitivity-table.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/activity-response.dart';

class GroupedPaginatedActivityTable extends StatefulWidget {
  final double? maxHeight;
  final List<ActivityResponse> data;
  final int itemsPerPage;
  final Function(ActivityResponse)? onEdit;
  final String groupByField; // Default 'state' for grouping

  const GroupedPaginatedActivityTable({
    Key? key,
    required this.data,
    this.itemsPerPage = 10,
    this.onEdit,
    this.maxHeight,
    this.groupByField = 'state',
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<GroupedPaginatedActivityTable> createState() => _GroupedPaginatedActivityTableState();
}

class _GroupedPaginatedActivityTableState extends State<GroupedPaginatedActivityTable> {
  int _currentPage = 0;
  late int _pageSize;
  Map<String, List<ActivityResponse>> _groupedData = {};
  List<String> _groupKeys = [];
  List<dynamic> _paginatedItems = []; // Can be a header, data item, or count
  late ScrollController _horizontalScrollController;

  // Define columns to display
  final List<ColumnDefinition> columns = [
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'UNIQUE ID', field: 'uniqueID', width: 130),
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'ACTIVITY ID', field: 'activityID', width: 100),
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'STRATEGIC...', field: 'strategicCatchment', width: 120),
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'MICRO CAT...', field: 'microCatchment', width: 120),
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'NATURE OF...', field: 'natureOfIntervention', width: 120),
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'TOTAL AREA', field: 'areaOfIntervention', width: 100, numeric: true),
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'ACTUAL END', field: 'actualEndDate', width: 100),
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'ACTUAL START', field: 'actualStartDate', width: 100),
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'BUDGET (USD)', field: 'budgetAmountUSD', width: 110, numeric: true),
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'BUDGET (NGN)', field: 'budgetAmountNGN', width: 110, numeric: true),
    ColumnDefinition(title: 'STATUS', field: 'status', width: 120),
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _pageSize = widget.itemsPerPage;
    _horizontalScrollController = ScrollController();
    _groupData();
    _updatePaginatedItems();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _horizontalScrollController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(GroupedPaginatedActivityTable oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.data != widget.data || oldWidget.groupByField != widget.groupByField) {
      _groupData();
      _updatePaginatedItems();
    }
  }

  void _groupData() {
    _groupedData.clear();
    _groupKeys.clear();

    // Group data by the specified field
    for (var item in widget.data) {
      final groupValue = _getFieldValue(item, widget.groupByField) ?? 'Unknown';
      if (!_groupedData.containsKey(groupValue)) {
        _groupedData[groupValue] = [];
        _groupKeys.add(groupValue);
      }
      _groupedData[groupValue]!.add(item);
    }
  }

  dynamic _getFieldValue(ActivityResponse item, String fieldName) {
    switch (fieldName) {
      case 'state':
        return item.state;
      case 'component':
        return item.component;
      case 'natureOfIntervention':
        return item.natureOfIntervention;
      case 'status':
        return item.status;
      default:
        return item.state; // Default to state
    }
  }

  void _updatePaginatedItems() {
    _paginatedItems.clear();

    // Create a flat list with group headers and items
    int totalItemCount = 0;
    for (var groupKey in _groupKeys) {
      final groupItems = _groupedData[groupKey]!;
      totalItemCount += groupItems.length + 2; // +2 for header and count
    }

    final int startIndex = _currentPage * _pageSize;
    int currentIndex = 0;

    // Find the items for the current page
    for (var groupKey in _groupKeys) {
      final groupItems = _groupedData[groupKey]!;

      // Check if this group's header is in the current page
      if (currentIndex >= startIndex && currentIndex < startIndex + _pageSize) {
        _paginatedItems.add({'type': 'header', 'value': groupKey});
      }
      currentIndex++;

      // Add the group items that fall in the current page
      for (var item in groupItems) {
        if (currentIndex >= startIndex && currentIndex < startIndex + _pageSize) {
          _paginatedItems.add({'type': 'item', 'value': item});
        }
        currentIndex++;
      }

      // Check if this group's count is in the current page
      if (currentIndex >= startIndex && currentIndex < startIndex + _pageSize) {
        _paginatedItems.add({'type': 'count', 'value': groupKey, 'count': groupItems.length});
      }
      currentIndex++;
    }
  }

  int get _totalPages => ((_getTotalItems()) / _pageSize).ceil();

  int _getTotalItems() {
    int count = 0;
    _groupedData.forEach((key, items) {
      // Count each group header, all items, and the count row
      count += items.length + 2;
    });
    return count;
  }

  // Calculate the total area for a specific state
  String _calculateTotalArea(String state) {
    double total = 0;
    for (var item in _groupedData[state] ?? []) {
      if (item.areaOfIntervention != null) {
        total += item.areaOfIntervention!;
      }
    }
    return total.toStringAsFixed(2);
  }

  String _getFieldDisplay(ActivityResponse item, String field) {
    switch (field) {
      case 'uniqueID':
        return item.uniqueID ?? '';
      case 'activityID':
        return item.activityID ?? '';
      case 'strategicCatchment':
        return item.strategicCatchment ?? '';
      case 'microCatchment':
        return item.microCatchment ?? '';
      case 'natureOfIntervention':
        return item.natureOfIntervention ?? '';
      case 'areaOfIntervention':
        return item.areaOfIntervention?.toStringAsFixed(2) ?? '0.00';
      case 'actualEndDate':
        return item.actualEndDate ?? '';
      case 'actualStartDate':
        return item.actualStartDate ?? '';
      case 'budgetAmountUSD':
        return item.budgetAmountUSD?.toStringAsFixed(2) ?? '0.00';
      case 'budgetAmountNGN':
        return item.budgetAmountNGN?.toStringAsFixed(2) ?? '0.00';
      case 'status':
        return item.status ?? '';
      default:
        return '';
    }
  }

  double _getTotalWidth() {
    double width = 0;
    for (var column in columns) {
      width += column.width;
    }
    width += 80; // For action column
    return width;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final screenWidth = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width;
    final isSmallScreen = screenWidth < 600;
    final isMediumScreen = screenWidth >= 600 && screenWidth < 900;

    Widget tableContent = ListView.builder(
      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      shrinkWrap: true,
      physics: widget.maxHeight != null ? AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics() : NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
      itemCount: _paginatedItems.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final itemData = _paginatedItems[index];
        final type = itemData['type'];
        if (type == 'header') {
          // State header
          return Container(
            color: const Color(0xFF1A365D), // Dark blue header
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10.0, horizontal: 8.0),
            child: Text(
              'STATE: ${itemData['value']}',
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: Colors.white,
              ),
            ),
          );
        } else if (type == 'count') {
          // State count row - full width
          return Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey[300]!)),
              color: Colors.grey[200],
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Text(
                  'Total Count=${itemData['count']}',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                Text(
                  'Total Area: ${_calculateTotalArea(itemData['value'])}',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        } else {
          // Regular data row - horizontally scrollable
          final ActivityResponse item = itemData['value'];
          final bool isEvenRow = index % 2 == 0;

          return Container(
            color: isEvenRow ? Colors.grey[100] : Colors.white,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              controller: _horizontalScrollController,
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              child: GestureDetector(
                child: Container(
                  width: _getTotalWidth(),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8.0),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      for (var column in columns)
                        Container(
                          width: column.width,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8.0),
                          child: Text(
                            _getFieldDisplay(item, column.field),
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: column.numeric ? FontWeight.w500 : FontWeight.normal,
                            ),
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            textAlign: column.numeric ? TextAlign.right : TextAlign.left,
                          ),
                        ),
                      // Actions column
                      Container(
                        width: 80,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4.0),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.edit, size: 16),
                              onPressed: () {
                                if (widget.onEdit != null) {
                                  widget.onEdit!(item);
                                }
                              },
                              constraints: const BoxConstraints(
                                minWidth: 32,
                                minHeight: 32,
                              ),
                              padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                              iconSize: 16,
                            ),
                            IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.more_vert, size: 16),
                              onPressed: () {},
                              constraints: const BoxConstraints(
                                minWidth: 32,
                                minHeight: 32,
                              ),
                              padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                              iconSize: 16,
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }
      },
    );

    // Wrap in a Container with constraints if maxHeight is provided
    if (widget.maxHeight != null) {
      tableContent = Container(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: widget.maxHeight!),
        child: tableContent,
      );
    }

    return SingleChildScrollView(
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          // Horizontally scrollable header
          SizedBox(
            height: 50,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              controller: _horizontalScrollController,
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              child: Container(
                width: _getTotalWidth(),
                color: const Color(0xFF28B873), // Green header
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    for (var column in columns)
                      Container(
                        width: column.width,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8.0, vertical: 12.0),
                        child: Text(
                          column.title,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: Colors.white,
                          ),
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ),
                    // Actions column
                    Container(
                      width: 80,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8.0, vertical: 12.0),
                      child: const Text(
                        '#',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: Colors.white,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),

          tableContent,

          Container(
            height: 110,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8.0, horizontal: 12.0),
            child: _buildResponsiveFooter(isSmallScreen, isMediumScreen),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildResponsiveFooter(bool isSmallScreen, bool isMediumScreen) {
    if (isSmallScreen) {
      // Extra small layout - minimal controls
      return Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          // Count info
          Text(
            'Count: ${widget.data.length}',
            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),

          // Pagination row
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.first_page, size: 18),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage > 0
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage = 0;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_left, size: 18),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage > 0
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage--;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),

              // Page indicator
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                child: Text(
                  '${_currentPage + 1}/$_totalPages',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                ),
              ),

              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 18),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage < _totalPages - 1
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage++;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.last_page, size: 18),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage < _totalPages - 1
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage = _totalPages - 1;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
            ],
          ),

          const SizedBox(height: 8),

          // Page size row
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Text('Page Size:', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 0),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                ),
                child: DropdownButtonHideUnderline(
                  child: DropdownButton<int>(
                    value: _pageSize,
                    isDense: true,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black),
                    items: [5, 10, 20, 50, 100].map((size) {
                      return DropdownMenuItem<int>(
                        value: size,
                        child: Text('$size'),
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setState(() {
                        _pageSize = value!;
                        _currentPage = 0;
                        _updatePaginatedItems();
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      );
    } else if (isMediumScreen) {
      // Medium layout - compact row
      return Row(
        children: [
          // Count info
          Text(
            'Count: ${widget.data.length}',
            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12),
          ),
          const Spacer(),

          // Navigation controls
          Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.first_page, size: 18),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage > 0
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage = 0;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_left, size: 18),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage > 0
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage--;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),

              // Page indicator
              Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  '${_currentPage + 1}/$_totalPages',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                ),
              ),

              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 18),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage < _totalPages - 1
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage++;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.last_page, size: 18),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage < _totalPages - 1
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage = _totalPages - 1;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
            ],
          ),

          const Spacer(),

          // Page size dropdown
          Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Text('Size:', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 0),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                ),
                child: DropdownButtonHideUnderline(
                  child: DropdownButton<int>(
                    value: _pageSize,
                    isDense: true,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black),
                    items: [5, 10, 20, 50, 100].map((size) {
                      return DropdownMenuItem<int>(
                        value: size,
                        child: Text('$size'),
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setState(() {
                        _pageSize = value!;
                        _currentPage = 0;
                        _updatePaginatedItems();
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      );
    } else {
      // Large layout - full controls
      return Row(
        children: [
          // Count info
          Text(
            'Count: ${widget.data.length}',
            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12),
          ),
          const Spacer(),

          // Navigation controls
          Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.first_page, size: 20),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage > 0
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage = 0;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_left, size: 20),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage > 0
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage--;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),

              // Page number input
              Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 24,
                alignment: Alignment.center,

                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                ),

                  controller: TextEditingController(text: '${_currentPage + 1}'),

                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    isDense: true,
                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    border: InputBorder.none,
                  ),
                  onSubmitted: (value) {
                    final page = int.tryParse(value);
                    if (page != null && page > 0 && page <= _totalPages) {
                      setState(() {

                        _updatePaginatedItems();
                      });
                    }
                  },
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              Text(
                'of $_totalPages',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 20),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage < _totalPages - 1
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage++;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.last_page, size: 20),
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 30, minHeight: 30),
                onPressed: _currentPage < _totalPages - 1
                    ? () {
                        setState(() {
                          _currentPage = _totalPages - 1;
                          _updatePaginatedItems();
                        });
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
            ],
          ),

          const SizedBox(width: 16),

          // Page size dropdown
          Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Text('Page Size:', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 0),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                ),
                child: DropdownButtonHideUnderline(
                  child: DropdownButton<int>(
                    value: _pageSize,
                    isDense: true,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.black),
                    items: [5, 10, 20, 50, 100].map((size) {
                      return DropdownMenuItem<int>(
                        value: size,
                        child: Text('$size'),
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setState(() {
                        _pageSize = value!;
                        _currentPage = 0;
                        _updatePaginatedItems();
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      );
    }
  }
}

// Helper class to define columns with width
class ColumnDefinition {
  final String title;
  final String field;
  final double width;
  final bool numeric;

  ColumnDefinition({
    required this.title,
    required this.field,
    required this.width,
    this.numeric = false,
  });
}

class StreamedActivityTable extends StatelessWidget {
  final double? maxHeight;
  final List<ActivityResponse> activityStream;
  final String groupByField;
  final int itemsPerPage;
  final Function(ActivityResponse)? onEdit;

  const StreamedActivityTable({Key? key, required this.activityStream, this.groupByField = 'state', this.itemsPerPage = 10, this.onEdit, this.maxHeight}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Calculate a finite height for the table based on available items
    final tableHeight = (activityStream.length * 50.0) + 150.0; // 50 per row + headers and pagination
    final constrainedHeight = tableHeight.clamp(300.0, 500.0); // Min height of 300, max of 500

    return SizedBox(
      height: constrainedHeight,
      child: GroupedPaginatedActivityTable(
        data: activityStream,
        itemsPerPage: itemsPerPage,
        groupByField: groupByField,
        onEdit: onEdit,
        maxHeight: maxHeight,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/activity-stream.dart ===== */
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/activity-service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';

class ActivityStreamProvider extends StatefulWidget {
  final Widget Function(BuildContext, List<Map<String, dynamic>>) builder;

  const ActivityStreamProvider({
    Key? key,
    required this.builder,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<ActivityStreamProvider> createState() => _ActivityStreamProviderState();
}

class _ActivityStreamProviderState extends State<ActivityStreamProvider> {
  // Get the activity service from your locator
  final _activityService = getIt<ActivityService>();

  // Stream controller for the activity list
  late StreamController<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _activityStreamController;
  late Stream<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _activityStream;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    // Create a stream controller that will emit the activity list
    _activityStreamController = StreamController<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>.broadcast();
    _activityStream = _activityStreamController.stream;

    // Initial load of activities
    _updateActivityList();

    // Listen to valueListenable on the _authBox for the _activityListKey
    // Since your service doesn't expose a stream for the Map activities specifically,
    // we'll set up a timer to periodically check for updates
    Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (_) {
      _updateActivityList();
    });
  }

  void _updateActivityList() {
    final activities = _activityService.getAllActivities();
    _activityStreamController.add(activities);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _activityStreamController.close();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return StreamBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _activityStream,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting && !snapshot.hasData) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }

        final activities = snapshot.data ?? [];
        return widget.builder(context, activities);
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/activity-response.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/widget_extensions.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/acitivity-table.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/header.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/streamed-activity-shimmer.dart';

class SimpleActivityTable extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<ActivityResponse> data;
  final Function(ActivityResponse)? onEdit;
  final VoidCallback onViewMore;
  final int maxItems;

  const SimpleActivityTable({
    Key? key,
    required this.data,
    this.onEdit,
    required this.onViewMore,
    this.maxItems = 10,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Determine if we need to show "View More"
    final bool hasMoreItems = data.length > maxItems;

    // Take only the first maxItems items
    final displayItems = data.length > maxItems ? data.sublist(0, maxItems) : data;

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        // Table header
        Container(
          height: 100,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12.0),
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            color: Color(0xFF28B873),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
              topLeft: Radius.circular(8),
              topRight: Radius.circular(8),
            ),
          ),
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
            child: Row(
              children: [
                _buildHeaderCell('UNIQUE ID', flex: 3),
                _buildHeaderCell('ACTIVITY ID', flex: 2),
                _buildHeaderCell('NATURE OF...', flex: 2),
                _buildHeaderCell('TOTAL AREA', flex: 2),
                _buildHeaderCell('STATUS', flex: 2),
                _buildHeaderCell('ACTIONS', flex: 1),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),

        // Table content
        Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.only(
              bottomLeft: Radius.circular(8),
              bottomRight: Radius.circular(8),
            ),
          ),
          child: ListView.separated(
            padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            shrinkWrap: true,
            physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            itemCount: displayItems.length,
            separatorBuilder: (context, index) => Divider(
              height: 1,
              color: Colors.grey[300],
            ),
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final item = displayItems[index];
              return _buildTableRow(context, item, index % 2 == 0);
            },
          ),
        ),

        // "View More" button if needed
        if (hasMoreItems)
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16.0),
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: onViewMore,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF28B873)),
                ),
                child: const Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'View All Activities',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Color(0xFF28B873),
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                    SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Icon(
                      Icons.arrow_forward,
                      size: 16,
                      color: Color(0xFF28B873),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeaderCell(String title, {required int flex}) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8.0),
      child: Text(
        title,
        style: const TextStyle(
          fontSize: 13,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
          color: Colors.white,
        ),
        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTableRow(BuildContext context, ActivityResponse item, bool isEvenRow) {
    return Container(
      color: isEvenRow ? Colors.grey[100] : Colors.white,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12.0, horizontal: 8.0),
      child: Row(
        children: [

            flex: 3,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8.0),
              child: Text(
                item.uniqueID ?? '',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            flex: 2,

              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8.0),
              child: Text(
                item.activityID ?? '',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            flex: 2,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8.0),
              child: Text(
                item.natureOfIntervention ?? '',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            flex: 2,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8.0),
              child: Text(
                item.areaOfIntervention?.toStringAsFixed(2) ?? '0.00',
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                ),
                textAlign: TextAlign.right,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            flex: 2,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8.0),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _getStatusColor(item.status),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  item.status ?? 'Unknown',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            flex: 1,
            child: IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.edit, size: 16),
              onPressed: () {
                if (onEdit != null) {
                  onEdit!(item);
                }
              },
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(
                minWidth: 30,
                minHeight: 30,
              ),
              padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Color _getStatusColor(String? status) {
    if (status == null) return Colors.grey;

    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'commenced':
        return const Color(0xFF28B873); // Green
      case 'notcommenced':
        return Colors.orange;
      case 'completed':
        return Colors.blue;
      case 'delayed':
        return Colors.red;
      default:
        return Colors.grey;
    }
  }
}

                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              ),
              child: const Center(
                child: Text(
                  'No activities available',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }

          return SimpleActivityTable(
            data: activities,
            onEdit: onEdit,
            onViewMore: onViewMore,
            maxItems: maxItems,
          );
        }

        // Then handle errors
        if (snapshot.hasError) {
          return SizedBox(
            height: 100,
            child: Center(child: Text('Error: ${snapshot.error}')),
          );
        }

        // Finally, handle waiting state
        return const StreamedSimpleActivityTableShimmer();
      },

class StreamedSimpleActivityTable1 extends StatelessWidget {

  final Function(ActivityResponse)? onEdit;
  final VoidCallback onViewMore;

  StreamedSimpleActivityTable1({super.key, required this.valueListenable, this.onEdit, required this.onViewMore, this.maxItems = 10, this.isLoading = false});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ValueListenableBuilder(
      key: UniqueKey(),
      valueListenable: valueListenable,
      builder: (context, list, _) {
        if (!isLoading) {
          if (list.isEmpty) {
            return Container(
              height: 100,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              ),
              child: const Center(
                child: Text(
                  'No activities available',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }

          return SimpleActivityTable(
            data: list,
            onEdit: onEdit,
            onViewMore: onViewMore,
            maxItems: maxItems,
          );
        } else {
          // Finally, handle waiting state
          return const StreamedSimpleActivityTableShimmer();
        }
      },
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/animated-list.dart ===== */
import 'package:animate_do/animate_do.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/widget_extensions.dart';

class AnimatedSelectionList<T> extends StatefulWidget {
  final String title;
  final List<T> items;
  final String Function(T item) titleBuilder;
  final Function(T item) onItemSelected;
  final Widget Function(T item, bool isSelected)? customItemBuilder;
  final Color selectedColor;
  final Color unselectedColor;
  final Duration animationDuration;
  final Curve animationCurve;
  final double itemHeight;
  final double borderRadius;
  final TextStyle? titleStyle;
  final TextStyle? itemTextStyle;
  final TextStyle? selectedItemTextStyle;
  final EdgeInsets contentPadding;

  const AnimatedSelectionList({
    Key? key,
    required this.title,
    required this.items,
    required this.titleBuilder,
    required this.onItemSelected,
    this.customItemBuilder,
    this.selectedColor = const Color(0xFF4CAF50), // Default green
    this.unselectedColor = const Color(0xFFF5F5F5), // Default light grey
    this.animationDuration = const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
    this.animationCurve = Curves.easeInOut,
    this.itemHeight = 60,
    this.borderRadius = 12,
    this.titleStyle,
    this.itemTextStyle,
    this.selectedItemTextStyle,
    this.contentPadding = const EdgeInsets.all(16),
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<AnimatedSelectionList<T>> createState() => _AnimatedSelectionListState<T>();
}

class _AnimatedSelectionListState<T> extends State<AnimatedSelectionList<T>> {
  T? _selectedItem;
  int? _selectedIndex;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      padding: widget.contentPadding,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(widget.borderRadius),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.05),
            blurRadius: 10,
            spreadRadius: 0,
            offset: const Offset(0, 4),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            widget.title,
            style: widget.titleStyle ??
                Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: Colors.black87,
                    ),
          ),
          32.sbH,
          ListView.builder(
            padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            shrinkWrap: true,
            physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            itemCount: widget.items.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final item = widget.items[index];
              final isSelected = _selectedIndex == index;

              if (widget.customItemBuilder != null) {
                return GestureDetector(
                  onTap: () => _selectItem(item, index),
                  child: widget.customItemBuilder!(item, isSelected),
                );
              }

              return SlideInUp(
                key: Key(index.toString()),
                child: AnimatedContainer(
                  duration: widget.animationDuration,
                  curve: widget.animationCurve,
                  margin: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                  // Remove fixed height to allow content to determine height
                  constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: widget.itemHeight),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isSelected ? widget.selectedColor : widget.unselectedColor,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(widget.borderRadius),
                    boxShadow: isSelected
                        ? [
                            BoxShadow(
                              color: widget.selectedColor.withOpacity(0.3),
                              blurRadius: 8,
                              spreadRadius: 0,
                              offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                            ),
                          ]
                        : null,
                  ),
                  child: Material(
                    color: Colors.transparent,
                    child: InkWell(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(widget.borderRadius),
                      onTap: () => _selectItem(item, index),
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                          children: [
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text(
                                widget.titleBuilder(item),
                                style: isSelected
                                    ? (widget.selectedItemTextStyle ??
                                        const TextStyle(
                                          color: Colors.white,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                        ))
                                    : (widget.itemTextStyle ??
                                        const TextStyle(
                                          color: Colors.black87,
                                        )),
                                softWrap: true,
                                maxLines: null, // Allow multiple lines
                              ),
                            ),
                            AnimatedOpacity(
                              opacity: isSelected ? 1.0 : 0.0,
                              duration: widget.animationDuration,
                              child: const Icon(
                                Icons.check_circle,
                                color: Colors.white,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _selectItem(T item, int index) {
    setState(() {
      _selectedItem = item;
      _selectedIndex = index;
    });
    widget.onItemSelected(item);
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/appbar.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_screenutil/flutter_screenutil.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/palette.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/navigation_service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/locator.dart';

AppBar acAppBar(String title,
    {bool isLeftAligned = false, List<Widget>? actions, bool showBackButton = true, bool overrideBackButtonAction = false, bool showXIcon = false, Function? backFunction, Color? bgColor}) {
  final navigate = getIt<NavigationService>();
  return AppBar(
    backgroundColor: bgColor ?? white,
    leading: isLeftAligned
        ? null
        : showBackButton
            ? overrideBackButtonAction
                ? showXIcon
                    ? IconButton(
                        onPressed: () => backFunction!(), //navigate.goBack(),
                        icon: Icon(
                          Icons.close,
                          color: textDark,
                        ))
                    : BackButton(
                        color: primaryColor,
                        onPressed: () => backFunction!(),
                      )
                : showXIcon
                    ? IconButton(
                        onPressed: () => navigate.goBack(),
                        icon: Icon(
                          Icons.close,
                          color: primaryColor,
                        ))
                    : BackButton(color: primaryColor)
            : null,
    elevation: 0,
    centerTitle: !isLeftAligned,
    leadingWidth: isLeftAligned ? 10.w : null,
    title: Text(
      title,
      style: TextStyle(
        color: textDark,
        fontSize: 18.sp,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
      ),
    ),
    actions: actions ?? const [SizedBox.shrink()],
  );
}

class CableWidgetGrid extends StatelessWidget {
  final Function(CableOp) onTapCallback;

  CableWidgetGrid({
    Key? key,
    required this.onTapCallback,
  }) : super(key: key);
  final ValueNotifier<CableOp?> network = ValueNotifier(null);
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 90,
      child: GridView.builder(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
          crossAxisCount: 4,
          mainAxisSpacing: 16.0,
          crossAxisSpacing: 16.0,
        ),
        itemCount: CableOp.values.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          return ValueListenableBuilder(
              valueListenable: network,
              builder: (context, service, _) {
                bool isSelected = service == CableOp.values[index];
                return CableWidgetItem(
                    mobileOp: CableOp.values[index],
                    isChecked: isSelected,
                    onTap: (v) {
                      network.value = v;
                      onTapCallback(v);
                    });
              });
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/carousel-media-widget.dart ===== */
import 'package:cached_network_image/cached_network_image.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shimmer/shimmer.dart';

class MediaWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  final String mediaUrl;
  final String defaultImageAsset;

  MediaWidget({
    required this.mediaUrl,
    this.defaultImageAsset = 'assets/images/g1.png',
  });

  @override
  _MediaWidgetState createState() => _MediaWidgetState();
}

class _MediaWidgetState extends State<MediaWidget> {
  ValueNotifier<bool> isLoading = ValueNotifier(false);

  bool _isYoutubeUrl(String url) {
    return url.contains('youtube.com') || url.contains('youtu.be');
  }

  bool _isYoutubeShortUrl(String url) {
    return url.contains('youtube.com/shorts/');
  }

  bool _isImageUrl(String url) {
    return url.endsWith('.png') || url.endsWith('.jpg') || url.endsWith('.jpeg') || url.endsWith('.gif');
  }

  String? _getYoutubeEmbedUrl(String url) {
    if (url.contains('youtube.com/watch')) {
      final uri = Uri.parse(url);
      final videoId = uri.queryParameters['v'];
      return videoId != null ? 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/$videoId' : null;
    } else if (url.contains('youtu.be')) {
      final videoId = url.split('/').last;
      return 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/$videoId';
    } else if (url.contains('youtube.com/shorts')) {
      final videoId = url.split('/').last;
      return 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/$videoId'; // Shorts can be embedded like this
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isImageUrl(widget.mediaUrl)) {
      // Display image
      return ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: CachedNetworkImage(
          width: double.infinity,
          height: double.infinity,
          imageUrl: widget.mediaUrl,
          fit: BoxFit.fill,
          placeholder: (context, url) => Shimmer.fromColors(
            baseColor: Colors.grey[300]!,
            highlightColor: Colors.grey[100]!,
            child: Container(
              color: Colors.grey[300],
            ),
          ),
          errorWidget: (context, url, error) => Image.asset(
            widget.defaultImageAsset,
            fit: BoxFit.fill,
          ),
        ),
      );
    } else if (_isYoutubeUrl(widget.mediaUrl) || _isYoutubeShortUrl(widget.mediaUrl)) {
      // Display YouTube video or Shorts using WebView
      String? embedUrl = _getYoutubeEmbedUrl(widget.mediaUrl);

      return embedUrl != null
          ? ValueListenableBuilder(
              valueListenable: isLoading,
              builder: (context, loading, _) => ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                child: Stack(
                  children: [
                    // ClipRRect(
                    //   borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    //   child: WebView(
                    //     initialUrl: embedUrl,
                    //     javascriptMode: JavascriptMode.unrestricted,
                    //     onPageStarted: (v) {
                    //       isLoading.value = true;
                    //     },
                    //     onPageFinished: (v) {
                    //       isLoading.value = false;
                    //     },
                    //   ),
                    // ),
                    if (loading)
                      Positioned.fill(
                          child: ClipRRect(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        child: Shimmer.fromColors(
                          baseColor: Colors.grey[300]!,
                          highlightColor: Colors.grey[100]!,
                          child: Container(
                            color: Colors.grey[300],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ))
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            )
          : const Center(child: Text('Invalid YouTube or Shorts link'));
    } else {
      // If the URL is neither an image nor a YouTube link, return a default widget
      return const Center(
        child: Text('Unsupported media format'),
      );
    }
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/carousel.dart ===== */
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:carousel_slider/carousel_slider.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/carousel-media-widget.dart';

class ImageCarousel2 extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<dynamic> imageUrls;
  final Duration slideDuration;
  final String defaultImageAsset;

  ImageCarousel2({
    required this.imageUrls,
    this.slideDuration = const Duration(seconds: 5),
    this.defaultImageAsset = 'assets/images/g1.png',
  });

  @override
  _ImageCarousel2State createState() => _ImageCarousel2State();
}

class _ImageCarousel2State extends State<ImageCarousel2> {
  PageController? _pageController;
  int _currentPage = 0;
  Timer? _timer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    if (widget.imageUrls.isNotEmpty) {
      _pageController = PageController(initialPage: 0, viewportFraction: 0.85);
      _startTimer();
    }
  }

  _startTimer() {
    _timer = Timer.periodic(widget.slideDuration, (Timer timer) {
      if (_currentPage < widget.imageUrls.length - 1) {
        _currentPage++;
      } else {
        _currentPage = 0;
      }

      _pageController?.animateToPage(
        _currentPage,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 350),
        curve: Curves.easeIn,
      );
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    super.dispose();
    _timer?.cancel();
    _pageController?.dispose();
  }

  List<String> links = ['https://youtu.be/mv_4mxUSpWI?si=WTXBRj3sqDXdLNLk', "https://youtube.com/shorts/4r-goobwB7g?si=TFcCzF_HqdzVMC_I"];

  int initialPage = 0;
  final CarouselSliderController _controller = CarouselSliderController();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Visibility(
      visible: widget.imageUrls.isNotEmpty,
      child: SizedBox(
        height: 120,
        child: CarouselSlider(
            carouselController: _controller,
            items: widget.imageUrls.map((image) {
              return Builder(builder: (BuildContext context) {
                return GestureDetector(
                  behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                  onTap: () {},
                  child: MediaWidget(mediaUrl: image.photo ?? "", defaultImageAsset: widget.defaultImageAsset),
                );
              });
            }).toList(),
            options: CarouselOptions(
              height: 200.0,
              viewportFraction: 0.6,
              autoPlay: true,
              autoPlayInterval: const Duration(seconds: 6),
              enlargeCenterPage: true,
              onPageChanged: (index, reason) {
                setState(() {
                  initialPage = index;
                });
              },
            )),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:animate_do/animate_do.dart';

import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/component-model.dart';

class ComponentsGrid extends StatefulWidget {
  final HomeViewModel model;
  const ComponentsGrid({Key? key, required this.model}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<ComponentsGrid> createState() => _ComponentsGridState();
}

class _ComponentsGridState extends State<ComponentsGrid> {
  int? selectedIndex;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
      child: GridView.builder(
        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        shrinkWrap: true,
        physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
        gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
          crossAxisCount: 2,
          mainAxisSpacing: 16,
          crossAxisSpacing: 16,
          childAspectRatio: 0.95, // Adjusted to prevent overflow
        ),
        itemCount: widget.model.appCache.components?.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          return SlideInUp(
            key: Key(index.toString()),
            child: ModernServiceCard(
              componentEnum: ComponentEnum.values[index],
              service: widget.model.appCache.components?[index],
              isSelected: selectedIndex == index,
              onTap: () {
                setState(() {
                  selectedIndex = index;
                });
              },
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

class ModernServiceCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final ComponentsRes? service;
  final ComponentEnum componentEnum;
  final bool isSelected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  // Define component colors for visual variety
  static const List<Color> componentColors = [
    Color(0xFF28B873), // Green
    Color(0xFF4E8AF4), // Blue
    Color(0xFFF5A623), // Orange
    Color(0xFFE94057), // Red
  ];

  const ModernServiceCard({
    Key? key,
    required this.service,
    required this.isSelected,
    required this.onTap,
    this.componentEnum = ComponentEnum.componentA,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final colorIndex = componentEnum.index % componentColors.length;
    final color = componentColors[colorIndex];

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        onTap();
        if (service?.subComponents?.length != 0) {
          Navigator.pushNamed(context, Routes.selectSubComponentRoute, arguments: {'a': componentEnum, 'b': service});
        } else {
          Navigator.pushNamed(context, Routes.subComponentDashboardRoute, arguments: {"b": IComponentModel(componentsRes: service!, indexOfSubComp: 0)});
        }
      },
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? color.withOpacity(0.05) : Colors.grey[100], // More distinct background
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.08),
              blurRadius: 8,
              offset: const Offset(0, 3),
            ),
          ],
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey[300]!,
            width: isSelected ? 2 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              // Action icons row
              Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
                children: [
                  _buildActionButton(
                    icon: Icons.refresh,
                    color: Colors.red[300]!,
                    onTap: () {},
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  _buildActionButton(
                    icon: Icons.info_outline,
                    color: Colors.grey[500]!,
                    onTap: () {},
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 8),

              // Component icon
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white, // White background for icon
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: Colors.grey[200]!,
                    width: 1,
                  ),
                ),
                child: Icon(Icons.apps, color: componentColors[colorIndex], size: 20),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 10),

              // Component name
              Text(
                service?.name ?? "Component ${componentEnum.toString().split('.').last}",
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 16,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: isSelected ? color : Colors.black87,
                ),
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 4),

              // Component description - limited height
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  service?.description ?? "Manage resources and activities",
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.normal,
                    color: Colors.black54,
                    height: 1.2,
                  ),
                  maxLines: 3,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildActionButton({
    required IconData icon,
    required Color color,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Container(
        height: 24,
        width: 24,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: color.withOpacity(0.1),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Icon(
          icon,
          color: color,
          size: 14,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _getIconForComponent(int index) {
    switch (index) {
      case 0:
        return Icon(Icons.grid_4x4, color: componentColors[0], size: 20);
      case 1:
        return Icon(Icons.people_outline, color: componentColors[1], size: 20);
      case 2:
        return Icon(Icons.account_balance_outlined, color: componentColors[2], size: 20);
      case 3:
        return Icon(Icons.shield_outlined, color: componentColors[3], size: 20);
      default:
        return Icon(Icons.apps, color: componentColors[0], size: 20);
    }
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/countdown-widget.dart ===== */
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class CountdownWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  final DateTime targetTime;
  final Widget Function(BuildContext context, Duration timeRemaining) builder;

  const CountdownWidget({
    Key? key,
    required this.targetTime,
    required this.builder,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<CountdownWidget> createState() => _CountdownWidgetState();
}

class _CountdownWidgetState extends State<CountdownWidget> {
  late Timer _timer;
  late Duration _timeRemaining;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _updateTime();
    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
      if (!mounted) return; // Prevents calling setState if widget is disposed
      _updateTime();
    });
  }

  void _updateTime() {
    final newTime = widget.targetTime.difference(DateTime.now());
    if (newTime.isNegative) {
      _timer.cancel();
      setState(() {
        _timeRemaining = Duration.zero;
      });
    } else {
      setState(() {
        _timeRemaining = newTime;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return widget.builder(context, _timeRemaining);
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/custom-webview.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/palette.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/widget_extensions.dart';
import 'package:webview_flutter/webview_flutter.dart';

String callback = "";

class WebViewSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final Function() onDone;
  final String url;
  const WebViewSheet({super.key, required this.onDone, required this.url});

  @override
  State<WebViewSheet> createState() => _WebViewSheetState();
}

class _WebViewSheetState extends State<WebViewSheet> {
  late WebViewController _controller = WebViewController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = WebViewController()
      ..setJavaScriptMode(JavaScriptMode.unrestricted)
      ..setNavigationDelegate(
        NavigationDelegate(
          onProgress: (int progress) {
            // Update loading bar.
          },
          onPageStarted: (String url) {},
          onPageFinished: (String url) {},
          onHttpError: (HttpResponseError error) {},
          onWebResourceError: (WebResourceError error) {},
          onNavigationRequest: (NavigationRequest request) {
            if (request.url.startsWith('https://www.youtube.com/')) {
              return NavigationDecision.prevent;
            }
            return NavigationDecision.navigate;
          },
        ),
      )
      ..loadRequest(Uri.parse(url));
  }

  String get url => widget.url;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: white,
        automaticallyImplyLeading: true,
        toolbarHeight: 30,
        leading: GestureDetector(
          onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
          child: const Icon(
            Icons.close,
            color: AppColors.main,
          ),
        ),
      ),
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Container(
          height: height(context),
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(
              // right: 20,
              // left: 20,
              bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom),
          color: Colors.white,
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 18.0),
            child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
              12.0.sbH,
              Expanded(
                  child: WebViewWidget(
                controller: _controller,
              ))
            ]),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

                  widget.text,
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14.sp, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500, color: widget.textColor ?? primaryDarkColor),
                )
              : SpinKitPulse(
                  color: primaryColor,
                  size: 16.0,
                ),
        ));
  }
}

import 'package:animation_wrappers/animation_wrappers.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class CustomFadeIn extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget child;
  const CustomFadeIn({Key? key, required this.child}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FadedSlideAnimation(
      child: child,
      beginOffset: Offset(0, 0.5),
      endOffset: Offset(0, 0),
      slideCurve: Curves.linearToEaseOut,
    );
  }
}

class CustomExpansionWidget extends StatelessWidget {

  final bool expand;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        if (!expand)
          ExpansionHeader(
            title: title,
            onTap: onTap,
          ),
        if (expand)
          ExpansionHeader.active(
            onTap: onTap,
            title: title,
            children: children,
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

class ExpansionHeader extends StatelessWidget {
