/* ===== lib/src/widgets/date-input.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class DateInput extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool? readOnly;
  final bool? enabled;
  final TextEditingController? controller;
  final String? labelText;
  final String? hintText;
  final double borderRadius;
  Function(DateTime?)? onSelected;
  String? dateLimit;

  DateInput({Key? key, this.labelText, this.hintText, this.controller, this.readOnly = false, this.enabled = true, this.borderRadius = 8, this.onSelected, this.dateLimit}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<DateInput> createState() => _DateInputState();
}

class _DateInputState extends State<DateInput> {
  late FocusNode _focus;
  bool _isFocus = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _focus = FocusNode();
    _focus.addListener(_onFocusChange);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _focus.removeListener(_onFocusChange);
    _focus.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onFocusChange() {
    setState(() {
      _isFocus = _focus.hasFocus;
    });
  }

  // String? get disableBeforeDate=> wis
  bool disableBefore(DateTime day, String? minDateStr) {
    if (minDateStr != null) {
      final minDate = DateTime.parse(minDateStr);
      return day.isAfter(minDate);
    } else {
      return true;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _selectDate(BuildContext context) async {
    DateTime initial;

    if (widget.dateLimit != null) {
      final minDate = DateTime.parse(widget.dateLimit!);
      initial = minDate.add(const Duration(days: 1));
    } else {
      initial = DateTime.now();
    }

    DateTime? pickedDate = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: initial,
      firstDate: DateTime(2000),
      lastDate: DateTime(2101),
      selectableDayPredicate: (day) => disableBefore(day, widget.dateLimit),
    );

    if (pickedDate != null) {
      widget.controller?.text = "${pickedDate.toLocal()}".split(' ')[0];
      widget.onSelected?.call(pickedDate);
    }
  }

  // Future<void> _selectDate(BuildContext context) async {
  //   DateTime? pickedDate = await showDatePicker(
  //     context: context,
  //     selectableDayPredicate: (v) => disableBefore(v, widget.dateLimit),
  //     initialDate: DateTime.now(),
  //     firstDate: DateTime(2000),
  //     lastDate: DateTime(2101),
  //   );
  //   if (pickedDate != null) {
  //     widget.controller?.text = "${pickedDate.toLocal()}".split(' ')[0];
  //     widget.onSelected!(pickedDate);
  //   }
  // }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12.0, vertical: 0.0),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _isFocus ? Colors.grey[200] : Colors.white,
        border: Border.all(
          width: 1,
          color: _isFocus ? Colors.blue : Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.5),
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(widget.borderRadius),
      ),
      child: TextFormField(
        controller: widget.controller,
        readOnly: true, // Make the field read-only
        focusNode: _focus,
        onTap: () => _selectDate(context), // Trigger the date picker
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          isDense: true, // Ensures a compact layout
          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            vertical: 4.0, // Reduced padding inside the text field
            horizontal: 0.0, // Minimal horizontal padding
          ),
          border: InputBorder.none,
          labelText: widget.labelText,
          hintText: widget.hintText,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/dialog-utils.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// A reusable confirmation dialog that can be customized for different actions
class ConfirmationDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final String confirmText;
  final String cancelText;
  final VoidCallback onConfirm;
  final VoidCallback? onCancel;
  final Color? confirmButtonColor;
  final Color? cancelButtonColor;
  final IconData? icon;
  final Color? iconColor;
  final bool isDestructive;

  const ConfirmationDialog({
    super.key,
    this.title = 'Confirm Action',
    required this.subtitle,
    this.confirmText = 'Confirm',
    this.cancelText = 'Cancel',
    required this.onConfirm,
    this.onCancel,
    this.confirmButtonColor,
    this.cancelButtonColor,
    this.icon,
    this.iconColor,
    this.isDestructive = false,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final defaultConfirmColor = isDestructive ? Colors.red : theme.primaryColor;

    return AlertDialog(
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      ),
      title: Row(
        children: [
          if (icon != null) ...[
            Icon(
              icon,
              color: iconColor ?? (isDestructive ? Colors.red : theme.primaryColor),
              size: 24,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
          ],
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              title,
              style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      content: Text(
        subtitle,
        style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
          color: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.color?.withOpacity(0.8),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () {
            Navigator.of(context).pop();
            onCancel?.call();
          },
          style: TextButton.styleFrom(
            foregroundColor: cancelButtonColor ?? theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.color,
          ),
          child: Text(cancelText),
        ),
        ElevatedButton(
          onPressed: () {
            Navigator.of(context).pop();
            onConfirm();
          },
          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: confirmButtonColor ?? defaultConfirmColor,
            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            ),
          ),
          child: Text(confirmText),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Utility class to show confirmation dialogs easily
class DialogUtils {
  /// Show a basic confirmation dialog
  static Future<bool?> showConfirmation({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String subtitle,
    required VoidCallback onConfirm,
    String title = 'Confirm Action',
    String confirmText = 'Confirm',
    String cancelText = 'Cancel',
    VoidCallback? onCancel,
    Color? confirmButtonColor,
    IconData? icon,
    Color? iconColor,
    bool isDestructive = false,
  }) {
    return showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (context) => ConfirmationDialog(
        title: title,
        subtitle: subtitle,
        confirmText: confirmText,
        cancelText: cancelText,
        onConfirm: onConfirm,
        onCancel: onCancel,
        confirmButtonColor: confirmButtonColor,
        icon: icon,
        iconColor: iconColor,
        isDestructive: isDestructive,
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Show a delete confirmation dialog
  static Future<bool?> showDeleteConfirmation({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String itemName,
    required VoidCallback onDelete,
    VoidCallback? onCancel,
  }) {
    return showConfirmation(
      context: context,
      title: 'Delete $itemName',
      subtitle: 'Are you sure you want to delete this $itemName? This action cannot be undone.',
      confirmText: 'Delete',
      cancelText: 'Cancel',
      onConfirm: onDelete,
      onCancel: onCancel,
      icon: Icons.delete_outline,
      isDestructive: true,
    );
  }

  /// Show a logout confirmation dialog
  static Future<bool?> showLogoutConfirmation({
    required BuildContext context,
    required VoidCallback onLogout,
    VoidCallback? onCancel,
  }) {
    return showConfirmation(
      context: context,
      title: 'Logout',
      subtitle: 'Are you sure you want to logout? You will need to sign in again.',
      confirmText: 'Logout',
      cancelText: 'Stay',
      onConfirm: onLogout,
      onCancel: onCancel,
      icon: Icons.logout,
      confirmButtonColor: Colors.orange,
    );
  }

  /// Show a save changes confirmation dialog
  static Future<bool?> showSaveConfirmation({
    required BuildContext context,
    required VoidCallback onSave,
    VoidCallback? onDiscard,
  }) {
    return showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
        title: const Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.save_outlined, color: Colors.blue),
            SizedBox(width: 12),
            Text('Unsaved Changes'),
          ],
        ),
        content: const Text('You have unsaved changes. What would you like to do?'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.of(context).pop();
              onDiscard?.call();
            },
            child: const Text('Discard'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.of(context).pop();
              onSave();
            },
            child: const Text('Save'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Show a custom action confirmation dialog
  static Future<bool?> showActionConfirmation({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String actionName,
    required String subtitle,
    required VoidCallback onAction,
    VoidCallback? onCancel,
    IconData? icon,
    Color? actionColor,
    bool isDestructive = false,
  }) {
    return showConfirmation(
      context: context,
      title: actionName,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      confirmText: actionName,
      onConfirm: onAction,
      onCancel: onCancel,
      icon: icon,
      confirmButtonColor: actionColor,
      isDestructive: isDestructive,
    );
  }

  /// Show a network action confirmation (for actions that require internet)
  static Future<bool?> showNetworkActionConfirmation({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String actionName,
    required VoidCallback onAction,
    VoidCallback? onCancel,
  }) {
    return showConfirmation(
      context: context,
      title: actionName,
      subtitle: 'This action requires an internet connection and may take a few moments to complete.',
      confirmText: 'Continue',
      onConfirm: onAction,
      onCancel: onCancel,
      icon: Icons.cloud_upload_outlined,
      confirmButtonColor: Colors.green,
    );
  }
}

/// Extension method to make it even easier to use
extension ConfirmationDialogExtension on BuildContext {
  /// Quick access to confirmation dialog
  Future<bool?> showConfirmDialog({
    required String subtitle,
    required VoidCallback onConfirm,
    String title = 'Confirm Action',
    String confirmText = 'Confirm',
    String cancelText = 'Cancel',
    VoidCallback? onCancel,
    IconData? icon,
    bool isDestructive = false,
  }) {
    return DialogUtils.showConfirmation(
      context: this,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      onConfirm: onConfirm,
      title: title,
      confirmText: confirmText,
      cancelText: cancelText,
      onCancel: onCancel,
      icon: icon,
      isDestructive: isDestructive,
    );
  }

  /// Quick delete confirmation
  Future<bool?> showDeleteDialog({
    required String itemName,
    required VoidCallback onDelete,
  }) {
    return DialogUtils.showDeleteConfirmation(
      context: this,
      itemName: itemName,
      onDelete: onDelete,
    );
  }
}

// Usage Examples:
class ExampleUsage extends StatelessWidget {
  const ExampleUsage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Confirmation Dialog Examples')),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // Example 1: Basic confirmation
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                DialogUtils.showConfirmation(
                  context: context,
                  subtitle: 'Are you sure you want to submit this form?',
                  onConfirm: () {
                    // Perform submit action
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(content: Text('Form submitted!')),
                    );
                  },
                );
              },
              child: const Text('Basic Confirmation'),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Example 2: Delete confirmation
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                context.showDeleteDialog(
                  itemName: 'activity',
                  onDelete: () {
                    // Perform delete action
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(content: Text('Activity deleted!')),
                    );
                  },
                );
              },
              child: const Text('Delete Item'),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Example 3: Custom action
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                DialogUtils.showActionConfirmation(
                  context: context,
                  actionName: 'Upload Data',
                  subtitle: 'This will upload your data to the server. Make sure you have a stable internet connection.',
                  onAction: () {
                    // Perform upload action
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(content: Text('Upload started!')),
                    );
                  },
                  icon: Icons.cloud_upload,
                  actionColor: Colors.blue,
                );
              },
              child: const Text('Upload Data'),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Example 4: Using extension method
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                context.showConfirmDialog(
                  subtitle: 'This will reset all your settings to default values.',
                  title: 'Reset Settings',
                  confirmText: 'Reset',
                  onConfirm: () {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(content: Text('Settings reset!')),
                    );
                  },
                  icon: Icons.settings_backup_restore,
                  isDestructive: true,
                );
              },
              child: const Text('Reset Settings'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class DraftActivityListScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const DraftActivityListScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<DraftActivityListScreen> createState() => _DraftActivityListScreenState();
}

class _DraftActivityListScreenState extends State<DraftActivityListScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      dbService.refreshItems(); // Force refresh when screen loads
    });
  }

  updateDraft(DraftActivity item) async {
    final items = await dbService.getItems();
    final index = items.indexWhere((e) => e.id == item.id);
    if (index != -1) {
      final updatedItem = DraftActivity(
        id: item.id,
        title: item.title,
        details: item.details,
        date: item.date,
        status: UploadStatus.uploaded,
      );
      items[index] = updatedItem;

      final jsonString = jsonEncode(items.map((e) => e.toJson()).toList());
      await getIt<StorageService>().storeItem(key: 'activity_list', value: jsonString);

      dbService.refreshItems();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _uploadItem(DraftActivity item) async {
    // Simulate API upload
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2)); // Simulated network delay

    // Replace item in list with updated status
    final items = await dbService.getItems();
    final index = items.indexWhere((e) => e.id == item.id);
    if (index != -1) {
      final updatedItem = DraftActivity(
        id: item.id,
        title: item.title,
        details: item.details,
        date: item.date,
        status: UploadStatus.uploaded,
      );
      items[index] = updatedItem;

      final jsonString = jsonEncode(items.map((e) => e.toJson()).toList());
      await getIt<StorageService>().storeItem(key: 'activity_list', value: jsonString);

      dbService.refreshItems();
    }
  }

  // Add this method to your class:
  Future<void> _deleteWithSimpleAnimation(DraftActivity item) async {
    // Find the widget to animate
    final context = this.context;

    // Simple fade and slide animation
    await showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (context) => const Center(
        child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
      ),
    );

    // Simulate brief delay for animation effect
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300));

    // Perform the actual deletion
    final success = await dbService.deleteDraftById(item.id);

    // Close loading dialog
    Navigator.of(context).pop();

    if (success) {
      // Show success message with animation
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: const Row(
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Colors.white),
              SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text('Draft deleted successfully'),
            ],
          ),
          backgroundColor: Colors.green,
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
        ),
      );
    } else {
      // Show error message
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Failed to delete draft'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    }
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/dropdown-click.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class DropdownOnClick<T> extends StatefulWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final Function(T) onSelect;
  final List<T>? list;
  final List<T>? exclude;
  final String Function(T) titleBuilder;

  const DropdownOnClick({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    required this.onSelect,
    this.exclude,
    this.list,
    required this.titleBuilder,
  });

  @override
  DropdownOnClickState<T> createState() => DropdownOnClickState<T>();
}

class DropdownOnClickState<T> extends State<DropdownOnClick<T>> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return IntrinsicHeight(
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTapUp: (details) {
          _showPopupMenu(details.globalPosition);
        },
        child: widget.child,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showPopupMenu(Offset offset) async {
    double left = offset.dx;
    double top = offset.dy;

    await showMenu(
      context: context,
      position: RelativeRect.fromLTRB(left, top, left + 1, top + 1),
      items: _getMenuItems(),
      elevation: 8.0,
    ).then((value) {
      if (value != null) {
        widget.onSelect(value);
      }
    });
  }

  List<PopupMenuEntry<T>> _getMenuItems() {
    return (widget.list ?? [])
        .where((e) => !(widget.exclude ?? []).contains(e))
        .map((e) => PopupMenuItem<T>(
              value: e,
              child: Text(widget.titleBuilder(e)),
            ))
        .toList();
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_screenutil/flutter_screenutil.dart';
import 'package:flutter_svg/flutter_svg.dart';

import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/widget_extensions.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';

class GenericBottomsheetList extends StatefulWidget {
  List<dynamic> list;
  final String title;
  Function(dynamic)? onTap;
  dynamic? old;
  GenericBottomsheetList({Key? key, this.onTap, this.old, required this.list, required this.title}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<GenericBottomsheetList> createState() => _GenericBottomsheetListState();
}

class _GenericBottomsheetListState extends State<GenericBottomsheetList> {
  ValueNotifier<dynamic?> selected = ValueNotifier(null);
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.old != null) {
      selected = ValueNotifier(widget.old!);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      margin: EdgeInsets.only(top: 70.h),
      child: ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.only(topLeft: Radius.circular(20), topRight: Radius.circular(20)),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Container(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(
                // right: 20,
                // left: 20,
                bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom),
            color: Colors.white,
            // height: 500,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16.0, vertical: 20.0),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  12.sbH,
                  12.0.sbH,
                  Align(
                    alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                    child: Text(
                      widget.title,
                      style: GoogleFonts.plusJakartaSans(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 24.sp),
                    ),
                  ),
                  24.0.sbH,
                  ...widget.list
                      .map((e) => GestureDetector(
                            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                            onTap: () {
                              selected.value = e;
                              widget.onTap!(selected.value!);
                              Navigator.pop(context);
                            },
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12.h),
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  12.sbW,
                                  Text(
                                    e.toString().capitalizeFirstOfEach,
                                    style: GoogleFonts.plusJakartaSans(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 16.sp),
                                  ),
                                  const Spacer(),
                                  ValueListenableBuilder(
                                      valueListenable: selected, builder: (context, currency_, _) => currency_ == e ? SvgPicture.asset('radio-a'.svg) : SvgPicture.asset('radio'.svg))
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ))
                      .toList(),
                  32.sbH,
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

showGenericSheet(BuildContext context, {Function(dynamic)? onTap, dynamic? old, required String title, required List<dynamic> list}) {
  showModalBottomSheet(
      enableDrag: true,
      isDismissible: true,
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (context) {
        return GenericBottomsheetList(
          onTap: onTap,
          old: old,
          list: list,
          title: title,
        );
      });
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/header.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_screenutil/flutter_screenutil.dart';
import 'package:flutter_svg/flutter_svg.dart';
import 'package:flutter_svg/svg.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/core/services/user.service.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/string-extensions.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/circular-image.dart';

import '../../routes/routes.dart';

class HeaderWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  final bool showBackBtn;
  final List<Widget>? action;
  final String? customBackRoute; // Optional custom route for back button
  final Map<String, dynamic>? routeArguments; // Optional arguments for the route

  HeaderWidget({
    super.key,
    this.showBackBtn = true,
    this.action,
    this.customBackRoute,
    this.routeArguments,
  });

  void _handleBackNavigation(BuildContext context) {
    if (customBackRoute != null) {
      // Navigate to the specified custom route
      if (routeArguments != null) {
        Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(
          context,
          customBackRoute!,
          arguments: routeArguments,
        );
      } else {
        Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, customBackRoute!);
      }
    } else {
      // Default behavior - pop the current route
      Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 70.h),
      child: ValueListenableBuilder(
        valueListenable: uService.userCredentialsNotifier,
        builder: (context, user, child) => Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.max,
          children: [
            (showBackBtn)
                ? GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => _handleBackNavigation(context),
                behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                child: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios)
            )
                : const CircularCachedNetworkImage(
              imageUrl: "google.com",
              // "https://paperpillar-acresal-html.netlify.app/assets/images/acresal-open-graph.png",
            ),
            SizedBox(width: 12.w),
            Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  timeOfTheDayGreeting(),
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.grey, // You can customize textLight color
                    fontSize: 12.sp,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                  ),
                ),
                SizedBox(height: 2.h),
                Text(
                  user.userName ?? "Loading",
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.black, // You can customize primaryDarkColor here
                    fontSize: 16.sp,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const Spacer(),
            Routes.homeRoute == true?
            SvgPicture.asset('notification'.svg): SizedBox.shrink(),
            ...?action // Ensure the correct path to SVG
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

String timeOfTheDayGreeting() {
  var hour = DateTime.now().hour;
  if (hour < 12) {
    return 'Good Morning,';
  }
  if (hour < 17) {
    return 'Good Afternoon,';
  }
  return 'Good Evening,';
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/info-dialogue.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// Types of info dialogs
enum InfoDialogType {
  success,
  error,
  warning,
  info,
}

/// A reusable info dialog for showing success, error, warning, or general information
class InfoDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final String buttonText;
  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
  final InfoDialogType type;
  final IconData? customIcon;
  final Color? customColor;
  final bool autoDismiss;
  final int autoDismissSeconds;

  const InfoDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    required this.subtitle,
    this.buttonText = 'OK',
    this.onPressed,
    this.type = InfoDialogType.info,
    this.customIcon,
    this.customColor,
    this.autoDismiss = false,
    this.autoDismissSeconds = 3,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);

    // Get default colors and icons based on type
    final (color, icon) = _getTypeDefaults();
    final effectiveColor = customColor ?? color;
    final effectiveIcon = customIcon ?? icon;

    return AlertDialog(
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      ),
      title: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: effectiveColor.withOpacity(0.1),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Icon(
              effectiveIcon,
              color: effectiveColor,
              size: 24,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              title,
              style: theme.textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: effectiveColor,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      content: Text(
        subtitle,
        style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
          color: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.color?.withOpacity(0.8),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        ElevatedButton(
          onPressed: () {
            Navigator.of(context).pop();
            onPressed?.call();
          },
          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: effectiveColor,
            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            ),
            minimumSize: const Size(80, 40),
          ),
          child: Text(buttonText),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  /// Get default color and icon based on dialog type
  (Color, IconData) _getTypeDefaults() {
    switch (type) {
      case InfoDialogType.success:
        return (Colors.green, Icons.check_circle_outline);
      case InfoDialogType.error:
        return (Colors.red, Icons.error_outline);
      case InfoDialogType.warning:
        return (Colors.orange, Icons.warning_outlined);
      case InfoDialogType.info:
        return (Colors.blue, Icons.info_outline);
    }
  }
}

/// Auto-dismissing info dialog with countdown
class AutoDismissInfoDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final InfoDialog infoDialog;
  final int seconds;

  const AutoDismissInfoDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.infoDialog,
    this.seconds = 3,
  });

  @override
  State<AutoDismissInfoDialog> createState() => _AutoDismissInfoDialogState();
}

class _AutoDismissInfoDialogState extends State<AutoDismissInfoDialog> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late int _remainingSeconds;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _remainingSeconds = widget.seconds;
    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: Duration(seconds: widget.seconds),
      vsync: this,
    );

    _controller.addListener(() {
      final newSeconds = (widget.seconds * (1 - _controller.value)).ceil();
      if (newSeconds != _remainingSeconds) {
        setState(() {
          _remainingSeconds = newSeconds;
        });
      }
    });

    _controller.forward().then((_) {
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.of(context).pop();
        widget.infoDialog.onPressed?.call();
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AlertDialog(
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      ),
      title: widget.infoDialog.title.isNotEmpty
          ? Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: (widget.infoDialog.customColor ?? widget.infoDialog._getTypeDefaults().$1).withOpacity(0.1),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    widget.infoDialog.customIcon ?? widget.infoDialog._getTypeDefaults().$2,
                    color: widget.infoDialog.customColor ?? widget.infoDialog._getTypeDefaults().$1,
                    size: 24,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    widget.infoDialog.title,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge?.copyWith(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          color: widget.infoDialog.customColor ?? widget.infoDialog._getTypeDefaults().$1,
                        ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            )
          : null,
      content: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Text(
            widget.infoDialog.subtitle,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  color: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.color?.withOpacity(0.8),
                ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                  value: _controller.value,
                  backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade300,
                  valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation(
                    widget.infoDialog.customColor ?? widget.infoDialog._getTypeDefaults().$1,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Text(
                '${_remainingSeconds}s',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                      color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                    ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () {
            _controller.stop();
            Navigator.of(context).pop();
          },
          child: const Text('Dismiss'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Utility class to show info dialogs easily
class InfoDialogUtils {
  /// Show a basic info dialog
  static Future<bool?> showInfo({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    String buttonText = 'OK',
    VoidCallback? onPressed,
    InfoDialogType type = InfoDialogType.info,
    IconData? customIcon,
    Color? customColor,
    bool autoDismiss = false,
    int autoDismissSeconds = 3,
  }) {
    final dialog = InfoDialog(
      title: title,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      buttonText: buttonText,
      onPressed: onPressed,
      type: type,
      customIcon: customIcon,
      customColor: customColor,
      autoDismiss: autoDismiss,
      autoDismissSeconds: autoDismissSeconds,
    );

    if (autoDismiss) {
      return showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: true,
        builder: (context) => AutoDismissInfoDialog(
          infoDialog: dialog,
          seconds: autoDismissSeconds,
        ),
      );
    } else {
      return showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: true,
        builder: (context) => dialog,
      );
    }
  }

  /// Show a success dialog
  static Future<bool?> showSuccess({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    String buttonText = 'Great!',
    VoidCallback? onPressed,
    bool autoDismiss = false,
    int autoDismissSeconds = 3,
  }) {
    return showInfo(
      context: context,
      title: title,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      buttonText: buttonText,
      onPressed: onPressed,
      type: InfoDialogType.success,
      autoDismiss: autoDismiss,
      autoDismissSeconds: autoDismissSeconds,
    );
  }

  /// Show an error dialog
  static Future<bool?> showError({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    String buttonText = 'OK',
    VoidCallback? onPressed,
  }) {
    return showInfo(
      context: context,
      title: title,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      buttonText: buttonText,
      onPressed: onPressed,
      type: InfoDialogType.error,
    );
  }

  /// Show a warning dialog
  static Future<bool?> showWarning({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    String buttonText = 'Understood',
    VoidCallback? onPressed,
  }) {
    return showInfo(
      context: context,
      title: title,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      buttonText: buttonText,
      onPressed: onPressed,
      type: InfoDialogType.warning,
    );
  }

  /// Quick success message for completed actions
  static Future<bool?> showActionSuccess({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String actionName,
    String? additionalInfo,
    VoidCallback? onPressed,
    bool autoDismiss = true,
  }) {
    return showSuccess(
      context: context,
      title: '$actionName Successful',
      subtitle: additionalInfo ?? 'Your $actionName has been completed successfully.',
      onPressed: onPressed,
      autoDismiss: autoDismiss,
    );
  }

  /// Quick error message for failed actions
  static Future<bool?> showActionError({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String actionName,
    String? errorMessage,
    VoidCallback? onTryAgain,
  }) {
    return showError(
      context: context,
      title: '$actionName Failed',
      subtitle: errorMessage ?? 'Something went wrong while performing $actionName. Please try again.',
      buttonText: onTryAgain != null ? 'Try Again' : 'OK',
      onPressed: onTryAgain,
    );
  }
}

/// Extension method for easy access
extension InfoDialogExtension on BuildContext {
  /// Quick success dialog
  Future<bool?> showSuccessDialog({
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    String buttonText = 'Great!',
    VoidCallback? onPressed,
    bool autoDismiss = false,
  }) {
    return InfoDialogUtils.showSuccess(
      context: this,
      title: title,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      buttonText: buttonText,
      onPressed: onPressed,
      autoDismiss: autoDismiss,
    );
  }

  /// Quick error dialog
  Future<bool?> showErrorDialog({
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    VoidCallback? onPressed,
  }) {
    return InfoDialogUtils.showError(
      context: this,
      title: title,
      subtitle: subtitle,
      onPressed: onPressed,
    );
  }

  /// Quick action success dialog
  Future<bool?> showActionSuccessDialog({
    required String actionName,
    String? additionalInfo,
    bool autoDismiss = true,
  }) {
    return InfoDialogUtils.showActionSuccess(
      context: this,
      actionName: actionName,
      additionalInfo: additionalInfo,
      autoDismiss: autoDismiss,
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/input-activity-controller.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/input.dart';

class InputController extends StatefulWidget {
  final String? initialValue;
  final String hintText;
  final Function(String) onChanged;
  final TextInputType keyboardType;
  final Key? key;
  final bool obscureText;
  final Widget? prefix;
  final Widget? suffix;
  final bool readOnly;
  final int? maxLines;
  final bool enabled;
  // Add any other properties your Input widget uses

  const InputController({
    this.key,
    required this.initialValue,
    required this.hintText,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.keyboardType = TextInputType.text,
    this.obscureText = false,
    this.prefix,
    this.suffix,
    this.readOnly = false,
    this.maxLines = 1,
    this.enabled = true,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _InputControllerState createState() => _InputControllerState();
}

class _InputControllerState extends State<InputController> {
  late TextEditingController _controller;
  bool _internalChange = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = TextEditingController(text: widget.initialValue ?? '');
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(InputController oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);

    // Only update controller if the value actually changed and wasn't caused by this widget
    if (widget.initialValue != _controller.text && !_internalChange) {
      final selection = _controller.selection;
      _controller.text = widget.initialValue ?? '';

      // Try to maintain cursor position if possible
      if (_controller.text.length >= selection.start) {
        _controller.selection = selection;
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Input(
      key: widget.key,
      hintText: widget.hintText,
      controller: _controller,
      enabled: widget.enabled,
      onChanged: (value) {
        _internalChange = true;
        widget.onChanged(value);
        _internalChange = false;
      },
      keyboardType: widget.keyboardType,
      obscureText: widget.obscureText,
      // prefix: widget.prefix,
      suffix: widget.suffix,
      readOnly: widget.readOnly,
      maxLines: widget.maxLines,
      // Pass through any other properties your Input widget uses
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/palette.dart';

class Input extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool? readOnly;
  final bool? enabled;
  final bool? obscureText;
  final bool? autocorrect;
  final bool? enableSuggestions;
  final TextEditingController? controller;
  final Widget? suffixIcon;
  final String? labelText;
  final String? hintText;
  final Function()? onTap;
  final Function(String?)? onSaved;
  final TextInputType? keyboardType;
  final TextInputAction? textInputAction;
  final String? helperText;
  final int? maxLines;
  final Function(String)? onChanged;
  final Function(String)? onSubmit;
  final Widget? suffix;
  final bool? autofocus;
  final String? prefixText;
  final String? errorText;
  final String? initialValue;
  final Widget? prefixWidget;
  final List<TextInputFormatter>? inputFormatters;
  final double borderRadius;
  final Widget? prefixIcon;
  final List<String>? autofillHints;
  final int? maxLength;

  const Input(
      {Key? key,
      this.labelText,
      this.hintText,
      this.onChanged,
      this.helperText,
      this.controller,
      this.autofillHints,
      this.onSubmit,
      this.suffixIcon,
      this.keyboardType,
      this.prefixWidget,
      this.onTap,
      this.onSaved,
      this.autofocus,
      this.maxLines,
      this.textInputAction,
      this.borderRadius = 8,
      this.autocorrect = false,
      this.enableSuggestions = true,
      this.obscureText = false,
      this.suffix,
      this.prefixText,
      this.readOnly = false,
      this.enabled = true,
      this.inputFormatters,
      this.prefixIcon,
      this.maxLength,
      this.initialValue,
      this.errorText})
      : super(key: key);

  @override
  State<Input> createState() => _InputState();
}

class _InputState extends State<Input> {
  late FocusNode _focus;
  bool _isFocus = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _focus = FocusNode();
    _focus.addListener(_onFocusChange);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    super.dispose();
    _focus.removeListener(_onFocusChange);
    _focus.dispose();
  }

  void _onFocusChange() {
    setState(() {
      _isFocus = _focus.hasFocus;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: 12.0,
            vertical: 1.0,
          ),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: _isFocus ? inputFocus : white, // (!widget.enabled! == true ? const Color(0xFFEFF2EE) : white),
            border: Border.all(
              width: 2,
              color: _isFocus ? primaryColor : textFieldBorder,
            ),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(widget.borderRadius),
          ),
          child: TextFormField(
            initialValue: widget.initialValue,
            maxLength: widget.maxLength,
            autofillHints: widget.autofillHints,
            onFieldSubmitted: widget.onSubmit,
            style: TextStyle(color: primaryDarkColor),
            enabled: widget.enabled,
            readOnly: widget.readOnly!,
            inputFormatters: widget.inputFormatters ?? [],
            autofocus: widget.autofocus ?? false,
            focusNode: _focus,
            onChanged: widget.onChanged,
            maxLines: widget.maxLines ?? 1,
            controller: widget.controller,
            autocorrect: widget.autocorrect ?? true,
            enableSuggestions: widget.enableSuggestions ?? true,
            obscureText: widget.obscureText ?? false,
            keyboardType: widget.keyboardType,
            textInputAction: widget.textInputAction,
            onTap: widget.onTap,
            onSaved: widget.onSaved,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              counterText: "",
              // border: OutlineInputBorder(borderSide: BorderSide.none),
              contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(0, 4, 0, 4),
              hintStyle: const TextStyle(height: 0, fontSize: 15, color: Color(0xff98A2B3)),
              labelStyle: TextStyle(height: 1, fontSize: 15, color: primaryDarkColor),
              border: InputBorder.none,
              labelText: widget.labelText,
              hintText: widget.hintText,
              suffixIcon: widget.suffixIcon,
              errorText: widget.errorText,
              // prefixText: widget.prefixText,
              prefix: widget.prefixText != null
                  ? Text(
                      widget.prefixText!,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: "inter"),
                    )
                  : null,
              prefixIcon: widget.prefixWidget,
              // suffixIconConstraints: BoxConstraints.tight(Size(30.w, 40.h)),
              suffix: widget.suffix,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        if (widget.helperText != null)
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4.0),
            child: Text(
              widget.helperText!,
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: textDark),
            ),
          )
      ],
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/list-bottomsheet.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_screenutil/flutter_screenutil.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/input.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/optimised-list-bottomsheet.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/optimised-list-list-bottomsheet.dart';
import 'package:sliding_up_panel/sliding_up_panel.dart';

class ListBottomSheet<T> extends StatefulWidget {
  final String? title;
  final List<T> list;
  final Function(T) onSelected;
  final Widget Function(T item) itemBuilder;
  final bool showSearch;
  final String? searchHintText;
  final bool Function(T item, String query)? searchFilter;

  const ListBottomSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.list,
    required this.onSelected,
    required this.itemBuilder,
    this.title,
    this.showSearch = true,
    this.searchHintText,
    this.searchFilter,
  });

  @override
  _ListBottomSheetState<T> createState() => _ListBottomSheetState<T>();
}

class _ListBottomSheetState<T> extends State<ListBottomSheet<T>> {
  late List<T> list_;
  late List<T> queryResult;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initializeList();
  }

  void _initializeList() {
    list_ = widget.list;
    queryResult = widget.list;
  }

  void _searchQuery(String query) {
    setState(() {
      if (query.isNotEmpty) {
        if (widget.searchFilter != null) {
          queryResult = list_.where((item) => widget.searchFilter!(item, query)).toList();
        } else {
          queryResult = list_.where((item) => item.toString().toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase())).toList();
        }
      } else {
        queryResult = List.from(list_);
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Stack(
      children: [
        // Detect taps outside the panel
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          child: Container(
            color: Colors.transparent,
          ),
        ),

        SlidingUpPanel(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height - 40.h,
          minHeight: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height / 1.5.h,
          backdropEnabled: false, // Important to avoid conflict
          panelBuilder: (ScrollController sc) => ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.only(
              topLeft: Radius.circular(20),
              topRight: Radius.circular(20),
            ),
            child: Container(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom),
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 20.0),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    if (widget.title != null)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20.0),
                        child: Text(
                          widget.title!,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: const Color(0xFF0B0806),
                            fontSize: 18.r,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    if (widget.title != null) SizedBox(height: 20.h),
                    if (widget.showSearch)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20.0),
                        child: TextField(
                          onChanged: _searchQuery,
                          decoration: InputDecoration(
                            prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search),
                            labelText: widget.searchHintText ?? "Search",
                            border: OutlineInputBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    if (widget.showSearch) SizedBox(height: 20.h),
                    Expanded(
                      child: SingleChildScrollView(
                        controller: sc,
                        child: ListView.builder(
                          shrinkWrap: true,
                          physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                          itemCount: queryResult.length,
                          itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index) {
                            final item = queryResult[index];
                            return GestureDetector(
                              onTap: () {
                                Navigator.pop(context);
                                widget.onSelected(item);
                              },
                              child: widget.itemBuilder(item),
                            );
                          },
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

showListBottomSheet<T>(
  BuildContext context, {
  required List<T> list,
  required Function(T) onSelected,
  required Widget Function(T item) itemBuilder,
  String? title,
  bool showSearch = true,
  String? searchHintText, // nullable
  bool Function(T item, String query)? searchFilter, // nullable
}) {
  showModalBottomSheet(
    enableDrag: true,
    isDismissible: true,
    context: context,
    isScrollControlled: true,
    backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
    builder: (context) {
      return ListBottomSheet<T>(
        list: list,
        onSelected: onSelected,
        itemBuilder: itemBuilder,
        title: title,
        showSearch: showSearch,
        searchHintText: searchHintText,
        searchFilter: searchFilter,
      );
    },
  );
}

class DropdownInput<T> extends StatelessWidget {
  final bool readOnly;
  final String labelText;
  final String title;
  final List<T> items;
  final Widget Function(T)? itemBuilder;
  final Widget Function(T, bool)? listItemBuilder;
  final Function(T)? onSelected;
  final Function(List<T>)? onListSelected;
  final bool showSearch;
  final bool? enableSearch; // Made nullable with default handling
  final bool isList;
  final String? searchHintText; // Already nullable
  final bool Function(T item, String query)? searchFilter; // Already nullable

  const DropdownInput({
    Key? key,
    required this.labelText,
    required this.title,
    required this.items,
    this.itemBuilder,
    this.onSelected,
    this.onListSelected,
    this.listItemBuilder,
    this.showSearch = false,
    this.enableSearch, // No default value, will be handled in logic
    this.readOnly = false,
    this.isList = false,
    this.searchHintText,
    this.searchFilter,
  }) : super(key: key);

  void _showBottomSheet(BuildContext context) {
    // Handle nullable enableSearch with proper default
    final shouldShowSearch = showSearch || (enableSearch ?? false);

    isList
        ? showOptimizedMultiSelectBottomSheet<T>(
            context,
            onSelected: onListSelected ?? (v) {},
            list: items,
            itemBuilder: listItemBuilder ??
                (b, i) {
                  return const SizedBox.shrink();
                },
            showSearch: shouldShowSearch,
            title: title,
          )
        : showOptimizedListBottomSheet<T>(
            context,
            onSelected: onSelected ?? (v) {},
            list: items,
            itemBuilder: itemBuilder ??
                (b) {
                  return const SizedBox.shrink();
                },
            showSearch: shouldShowSearch,
            title: title,
            searchHintText: searchHintText, // Will be null if not provided
            searchFilter: searchFilter, // Will be null if not provided
          );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => readOnly
          ? null
          : _showBottomSheet(
              context,
            ),
      child: Opacity(
        opacity: readOnly ? .5 : 1,
        child: Input(
          labelText: labelText,
          suffixIcon: const Icon(Icons.keyboard_arrow_down_sharp),
          enabled: false,
          readOnly: true,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/list-list-sheet.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_screenutil/flutter_screenutil.dart';
import 'package:sliding_up_panel/sliding_up_panel.dart';

showListListBottomSheet<T>(
  BuildContext context, {
  required List<T> list,
  required Function(List<T>) onSelected,
  required Widget Function(T item, bool i) itemBuilder,
  String? title,
  bool showSearch = true,
}) {
  showModalBottomSheet(
    enableDrag: true,
    isDismissible: true,
    context: context,
    isScrollControlled: true,
    backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
    builder: (context) {
      return ListBottomSheet<T>(
        list: list,
        onSelected: onSelected,
        itemBuilder: itemBuilder,
        title: title,
        showSearch: showSearch,
      );
    },
  );
}

class ListBottomSheet<T> extends StatefulWidget {
  final String? title;
  final List<T> list;
  final Function(List<T>) onSelected;
  final Widget Function(T item, bool isSelected) itemBuilder;
  final bool showSearch;
  final List<T>? initiallySelected;

  const ListBottomSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.list,
    required this.onSelected,
    required this.itemBuilder,
    this.title,
    this.showSearch = true,
    this.initiallySelected,
  });

  @override
  _ListBottomSheetState<T> createState() => _ListBottomSheetState<T>();
}

class _ListBottomSheetState<T> extends State<ListBottomSheet<T>> {
  late List<T> list_;
  late List<T> queryResult;
  late Set<T> selectedItems;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initializeList();
    _initializeSelection();
  }

  void _initializeList() {
    list_ = widget.list;
    queryResult = widget.list;
  }

  void _initializeSelection() {
    selectedItems = widget.initiallySelected != null ? Set<T>.from(widget.initiallySelected!) : <T>{};
  }

  void _searchQuery(String query) {
    setState(() {
      if (query.isNotEmpty) {
        queryResult = list_.where((item) => item.toString().toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase())).toList();
      } else {
        queryResult = List.from(list_);
      }
    });
  }

  void _toggleSelection(T item) {
    setState(() {
      if (selectedItems.contains(item)) {
        selectedItems.remove(item);
      } else {
        selectedItems.add(item);
      }
    });
  }

  void _onDone() {
    Navigator.pop(context);
    widget.onSelected(selectedItems.toList());
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Stack(
      children: [
        // Detect taps outside the panel
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          child: Container(
            color: Colors.transparent,
          ),
        ),

        SlidingUpPanel(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height - 40.h,
          minHeight: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height / 1.5.h,
          backdropEnabled: false, // Important to avoid conflict
          panelBuilder: (ScrollController sc) => ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.only(
              topLeft: Radius.circular(20),
              topRight: Radius.circular(20),
            ),
            child: Container(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom),
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 20.0),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    // Header with title and done button
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20.0),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          if (widget.title != null)
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text(
                                widget.title!,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: const Color(0xFF0B0806),
                                  fontSize: 18.r,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                ),
                              ),
                            )
                          else
                            const Spacer(),
                          // Done button
                          ElevatedButton(
                            onPressed: _onDone,
                            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                              ),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              'Done${selectedItems.isNotEmpty ? ' (${selectedItems.length})' : ''}',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    SizedBox(height: 20.h),

                    // Search field
                    if (widget.showSearch)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20.0),
                        child: TextField(
                          onChanged: _searchQuery,
                          decoration: InputDecoration(
                            prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search),
                            labelText: "Search",
                            border: OutlineInputBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    if (widget.showSearch) SizedBox(height: 20.h),

                    // Selection summary (optional)
                    if (selectedItems.isNotEmpty)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20.0),
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor.withOpacity(0.1),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            children: [
                              Icon(
                                Icons.check_circle,
                                color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                size: 16,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Text(
                                '${selectedItems.length} item${selectedItems.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} selected',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                                ),
                              ),
                              const Spacer(),
                              if (selectedItems.isNotEmpty)
                                GestureDetector(
                                  onTap: () {
                                    setState(() {
                                      selectedItems.clear();
                                    });
                                  },
                                  child: Text(
                                    'Clear all',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                                      decoration: TextDecoration.underline,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    if (selectedItems.isNotEmpty) SizedBox(height: 16.h),

                    // List items
                    Expanded(
                      child: SingleChildScrollView(
                        controller: sc,
                        child: ListView.builder(
                          shrinkWrap: true,
                          physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                          itemCount: queryResult.length,
                          itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index) {
                            final item = queryResult[index];
                            final isSelected = selectedItems.contains(item);

                            return GestureDetector(
                              onTap: () => _toggleSelection(item),
                              child: Container(
                                margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 4),
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: isSelected ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor.withOpacity(0.1) : Colors.transparent,
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                  border: Border.all(
                                    color: isSelected ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor.withOpacity(0.3) : Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.2),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                child: Row(
                                  children: [
                                    // Checkbox
                                    Container(
                                      width: 20,
                                      height: 20,
                                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                        border: Border.all(
                                          color: isSelected ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor : Colors.grey,
                                          width: 2,
                                        ),
                                        color: isSelected ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor : Colors.transparent,
                                      ),
                                      child: isSelected
                                          ? const Icon(
                                              Icons.check,
                                              color: Colors.white,
                                              size: 14,
                                            )
                                          : null,
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                                    // Custom item widget
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: widget.itemBuilder(item, isSelected),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            );
                          },
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/palette.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/widget_extensions.dart';

class CustomNumberPad extends StatelessWidget {
  final Function(String) onNumberPressed;
  final VoidCallback onDeletePressed;

  const CustomNumberPad({
    super.key,
    required this.onNumberPressed,
    required this.onDeletePressed,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        ...[
          ['1', '2', '3'],
          ['4', '5', '6'],
          ['7', '8', '9'],
          [
            '0',
          ]
        ].map((row) {
          return Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: row.map((number) {
              return number == "0"
                  ? Row(
                      children: [
                        Visibility(
                          visible: true,
                          child: IconButton(
                            icon: Icon(Icons.backspace, color: AppColors.white),
                            onPressed: () {},
                          ),
                        ),
                        22.sbW,
                        _NumberButton(
                          number: number,
                          onPressed: () => onNumberPressed(number),
                        ),
                        22.sbW,
                        IconButton(
                          icon: Icon(Icons.backspace, color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                          onPressed: onDeletePressed,
                        ),
                      ],
                    )
                  : _NumberButton(
                      number: number,
                      onPressed: () => onNumberPressed(number),
                    );
            }).toList(),
          );
        }),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _NumberButton extends StatelessWidget {
  final String number;

          color: Colors.grey.shade800.withOpacity(.4),
          shape: BoxShape.circle,
        ),
        child: Center(
