/* ===== lib/src/widgets/test/currency-formatter.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class CurrencyInputFormatter extends TextInputFormatter {
  @override
  TextEditingValue formatEditUpdate(TextEditingValue oldValue, TextEditingValue newValue) {
    if (newValue.text.isEmpty) {
      return newValue;
    }

    // Only allow digits and decimal point
    final regExp = RegExp(r'[0-9.]');
    String newText = newValue.text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\d.]'), '');

    // Ensure only one decimal point
    if (newText.split('.').length > 2) {
      newText = oldValue.text;
    }

    // Format with commas for thousands
    if (newText.contains('.')) {
      List<String> parts = newText.split('.');
      if (parts[1].length > 2) {
        parts[1] = parts[1].substring(0, 2);
      }

      String integerPart = _formatWithCommas(parts[0]);
      return TextEditingValue(
        text: '$integerPart.${parts[1]}',
        selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: '$integerPart.${parts[1]}'.length),
      );
    } else {
      String formatted = _formatWithCommas(newText);
      return TextEditingValue(
        text: formatted,
        selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: formatted.length),
      );
    }
  }

  String _formatWithCommas(String value) {
    final format = NumberFormat('#,###', 'en_US');
    if (value.isEmpty) return '';
    final number = int.parse(value);
    return format.format(number);
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/test/date-picker.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class DatePickerFormField extends StatefulWidget {
  final String initialValue;
  final String labelText;
  final FormFieldValidator<String>? validator;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final FormFieldSetter<String> onSaved;

  const DatePickerFormField({
    Key? key,
    this.initialValue = '',
    required this.labelText,
    this.validator,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onSaved,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _DatePickerFormFieldState createState() => _DatePickerFormFieldState();
}

class _DatePickerFormFieldState extends State<DatePickerFormField> {
  late TextEditingController _controller;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = TextEditingController(text: widget.initialValue);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(DatePickerFormField oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    // Update controller if initialValue changes from parent
    if (widget.initialValue != oldWidget.initialValue && widget.initialValue != _controller.text) {
      _controller.text = widget.initialValue;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FormField<String>(
      initialValue: widget.initialValue,
      validator: widget.validator,
      onSaved: widget.onSaved,
      builder: (FormFieldState<String> field) {
        return Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            InkWell(
              onTap: () async {
                // Close keyboard if open
                FocusScope.of(context).requestFocus(FocusNode());

                // Set initial date from current value or default to today
                DateTime? initialDate;
                if (_controller.text.isNotEmpty) {
                  try {
                    initialDate = DateFormat('MM/dd/yyyy').parse(_controller.text);
                  } catch (e) {
                    initialDate = DateTime.now();
                  }
                } else {
                  initialDate = DateTime.now();
                }

                // Show date picker
                final date = await showDatePicker(
                  context: context,
                  initialDate: initialDate,
                  firstDate: DateTime(1900),
                  lastDate: DateTime.now().add(Duration(days: 365 * 10)), // Allow future dates if needed
                  builder: (context, child) {
                    return Theme(
                      data: Theme.of(context).copyWith(
                        colorScheme: ColorScheme.light(
                          primary: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: child!,
                    );
                  },
                );

                // Update if date was selected
                if (date != null) {
                  final formattedDate = DateFormat('MM/dd/yyyy').format(date);
                  setState(() {
                    _controller.text = formattedDate;
                  });

                  // Notify the form
                  field.didChange(formattedDate);
                  widget.onChanged(formattedDate);
                }
              },
              child: InputDecorator(
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: widget.labelText,
                  border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  errorText: field.errorText,
                  suffixIcon: Icon(Icons.calendar_today),
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 12),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  _controller.text.isEmpty ? 'Select a date' : _controller.text,
                  style: _controller.text.isEmpty ? TextStyle(color: Colors.grey[600]) : TextStyle(color: Colors.black87),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/test/form-indicator.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_screenutil/flutter_screenutil.dart';

class FormStepper extends StatelessWidget {
  final int currentStep;
  final int totalSteps;
  final List<String> stepTitles;

  const FormStepper({
    Key? key,
    required this.currentStep,
    required this.totalSteps,
    required this.stepTitles,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16.0, vertical: 8.0),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: List.generate(totalSteps, (index) {
              // Calculate if step is active, completed, or inactive
              final isCompleted = index < currentStep;
              final isActive = index == currentStep;
              final isInactive = index > currentStep;

              // Connect with a line, except for the first item
              return Expanded(
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    // First item doesn't have a line before it
                    if (index > 0)
                      Expanded(
                        child: AnimatedContainer(
                          duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                          height: 3,
                          color: isInactive ? Colors.grey[300] : Theme.of(context).primaryColor.withOpacity(0.8),
                        ),
                      ),

                    // Step indicator
                    _buildStepIndicator(context, index, isActive, isCompleted, isInactive),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }),
          ),
        ),

        // Step titles row
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16.0),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: List.generate(totalSteps, (index) {
              final isActive = index <= currentStep;

              return Expanded(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.only(
                    left: index == 0 ? 0 : 4.0,
                    right: index == totalSteps - 1 ? 0 : 4.0,
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    stepTitles[index],
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
                      color: isActive ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor : Colors.grey[600],
                    ),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                ),
              );
            }),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStepIndicator(
    BuildContext context,
    int index,
    bool isActive,
    bool isCompleted,
    bool isInactive,
  ) {
    // Define colors based on step state
    final Color backgroundColor = isCompleted
        ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor
        : isActive
            ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor.withOpacity(0.8)
            : Colors.grey[300]!;

    final Color borderColor = isCompleted || isActive ? Theme.of(context).primaryColor : Colors.grey[400]!;

    final Color textColor = isCompleted || isActive ? Colors.white : Colors.grey[600]!;

    return Stack(
      alignment: Alignment.center,
      children: [
        // Animated outer circle with growing effect for active step
        if (isActive)
          TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
            tween: Tween(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
            duration: Duration(milliseconds: 500),
            builder: (context, value, child) {
              return Container(
                width: 24 + (10 * value),
                height: 24 + (10 * value),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor.withOpacity(0.1 * value),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),

        // Main circle
        AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
          width: isActive ? 24 : 36,
          height: isActive ? 24 : 36,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
            color: backgroundColor,
            border: Border.all(
              color: borderColor,
              width: 2,
            ),
            boxShadow: isActive || isCompleted
                ? [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor.withOpacity(0.3),
                      blurRadius: 8,
                      offset: Offset(0, 3),
                    ),
                  ]
                : null,
          ),

          // Step number or check icon
          child: Center(
            child: isCompleted
                ? Icon(
                    Icons.check_rounded,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    size: 20,
                  )
                : Text(
                    '${index + 1}',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: textColor,
                      fontSize: 12.sp,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/test/form-type.dart ===== */
// Dynamic form widget to handle a single form step
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/test/image-widget.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/test/multi-step-form.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/test/tf-input-widgets.dart';

class DynamicForm extends StatefulWidget {
  final GlobalKey<FormState> formKey;
  final FormConfiguration configuration;
  final Map<String, dynamic> initialData;
  final Function(Map<String, dynamic>) onSaved;
  final Function(String, dynamic) onFieldChanged;

  const DynamicForm({Key? key, required this.formKey, required this.configuration, required this.initialData, required this.onSaved, required this.onFieldChanged}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _DynamicFormState createState() => _DynamicFormState();
}

class _DynamicFormState extends State<DynamicForm> {
  late Map<String, dynamic> _formValues;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _formValues = Map.from(widget.initialData);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(DynamicForm oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.initialData != oldWidget.initialData) {
      setState(() {
        _formValues = Map.from(widget.initialData);
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
      child: Form(
        key: widget.formKey,
        onChanged: () {
          // Update parent with current values
          widget.onSaved(_formValues);
        },
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              widget.configuration.title,
              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            ...widget.configuration.fields.map((field) {
              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16.0),
                child: _buildField(field),
              );
            }).toList(),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildField(FormFieldConfig field) {
    // Get initial value from form values or empty
    final initialValue = _formValues[field.name] ?? '';
    final isReadOnly = field.readOnly || field.isCalculated == true;
    // Common onChanged handler for fields
    void onFieldChanged(dynamic value) {
      _formValues[field.name] = value;
      widget.onFieldChanged(field.name, value);
    }

    switch (field.type) {
      case FieldType.text:
        return ModernTextField(
          labelText: field.label,
          initialValue: initialValue,
          placeholder: field.placeholder,
          validator: field.validator,
          onSaved: (value) {
            if (value != null) {
              _formValues[field.name] = value;
            }
          },
          onChanged: onFieldChanged,
        );

      case FieldType.amount:
        return ModernCurrencyField(
            labelText: field.label,
            initialValue: initialValue,
            currencySymbol: "",
            validator: field.validator,
            onSaved: (value) {
              if (value != null) {
                _formValues[field.name] = value;
              }
            },
            onChanged: onFieldChanged);

      case FieldType.number:
        return ModernNumberField(
            labelText: field.label,
            initialValue: initialValue,
            currencySymbol: "",
            validator: field.validator,
            onSaved: (value) {
              if (value != null) {
                _formValues[field.name] = value;
              }
            },
            onChanged: (value) {
              if (value.isNotEmpty) {
                try {
                  final numericValue = double.parse(value.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\d.]'), ''));
                  onFieldChanged(numericValue);
                } catch (e) {
                  onFieldChanged(value);
                }
              } else {
                onFieldChanged(value);
              }
            });

      case FieldType.date:
        return ModernDatePickerField(
          labelText: field.label,
          initialValue: initialValue,
          validator: field.validator,
          onSaved: (value) {
            if (value != null) {
              _formValues[field.name] = value;
            }
          },
          onChanged: (value) {
            _formValues[field.name] = value;
          },
        );

      case FieldType.dropdown:
        final options = field.options ?? [];

        return SizedBox(
          height: ModernFormStyles.fieldHeight + (field.validator != null ? 10 : 0),
          child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
            value: initialValue.isNotEmpty ? initialValue : null,
            decoration: ModernFormStyles.getDecoration(
              context,

              label: field.label,
              // prefixIcon: Padding(
              //   padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
              //   child: Icon(
              //     Icons.arrow_drop_down_circle_outlined,
              //     color: ModernFormStyles.primaryColor(context),
              //     size: ModernFormStyles.iconSize,
              //   ),
              // ),
            ).copyWith(
              hintText: field.label ?? 'Select an option',
              hintStyle: ModernFormStyles.placeholderStyle,
              contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
            ),
            // InputDecoration(
            //   labelText: field.label,
            //   border: OutlineInputBorder(),
            // ),
            items: field.options?.map((option) {
                  return DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: option,
                    child: Text(option),
                  );
                }).toList() ??
                [],
            validator: field.validator,
            onChanged: (value) {
              if (value != null) {
                isReadOnly
                    ? null
                    : (value) {
                        if (value != null) {
                          onFieldChanged(value);
                        }
                      };
              }
            },
            onSaved: (value) {
              if (value != null) {
                _formValues[field.name] = value;
              }
            },
          ),
        );

      // final getLabel = field.getLabel ?? (item) => item.toString();
      // final getValue = field.getValue ?? (item) => item;

      // return SizedBox(
      //   height: ModernFormStyles.fieldHeight + (field.validator != null ? 10 : 0),
      //   child: DropdownButtonFormField<dynamic>(
      //     value: initialValue.isNotEmpty ? initialValue : null,
      //     decoration: ModernFormStyles.getDecoration(
      //       context,
      //       label: field.label,
      //     ).copyWith(
      //       hintText: field.label ?? 'Select an option',
      //       hintStyle: ModernFormStyles.placeholderStyle,
      //       contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
      //     ),
      //     items: field.options?.map((item) {
      //           return DropdownMenuItem(
      //             value: "", //getValue(item),
      //             child: Text(''
      //                 // getLabel(item)
      //                 ),
      //           );
      //         }).toList() ??
      //         [],
      //     validator: field.required ? (value) => value == null ? 'Required' : null : null,
      //     onChanged: isReadOnly
      //         ? null
      //         : (value) {
      //             if (value != null) {
      //               onFieldChanged(value);
      //             }
      //             //   (value) {
      //             // if (value != null) {
      //             //   isReadOnly
      //             //       ? null
      //             //       : (value) {
      //             //           if (value != null) {
      //             //             onFieldChanged(value);
      //             //           }
      //             //         };
      //           },
      //     onSaved: (value) {
      //       if (value != null) {
      //         _formValues[field.name] = value;
      //       }
      //     },
      //   ),
      // );
      case FieldType.image:
        return ImagePickerFormField(
          labelText: field.label,
          initialValue: initialValue,
          validator: field.validator,
          uploadPhoto: widget.configuration.uploadPhoto!, // Pass the function from configuration
          onSaved: (value) {
            if (value != null) {
              _formValues[field.name] = value;
            }
          },
          onChanged: (value) {
            _formValues[field.name] = value;
            onFieldChanged(value);
          },
        );

      default:
        return const SizedBox();
    }
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/test/form.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/test/demo-form-config.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/test/multi-step-form.dart';

class MyFormScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Example of prefilled data
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> initialData = [
      {
        'name': 'John Doe',
        'birthdate': '01/15/1990',
      },
      {
        'income': '5,000.00',
        'incomeSource': 'Employment',
      },
    ];

    return Scaffold(
      body: MultiStepFormManager(
        initialData: initialData, // Pass empty list if no prefill needed
        onSubmit: (formData) {
          // Handle the completed form data
          print('Form submitted with data:');
          formData.forEach((stepData) {
            print(stepData);
          });

          // Navigate away or show success message
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(content: Text('Form submitted successfully!')),
          );

          // Optionally navigate away
          Navigator.of(context).pop();
        },
        formConfigurations: userProfileForm,
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:ui';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ImagePickerFormField extends StatefulWidget {
  final String labelText;
  final String? initialValue;
  final FormFieldValidator<String>? validator;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final FormFieldSetter<String> onSaved;
  final Function(BuildContext, Function(File)) uploadPhoto;

  const ImagePickerFormField({
    Key? key,
    required this.labelText,
    this.initialValue,
    this.validator,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onSaved,
    required this.uploadPhoto,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _ImagePickerFormFieldState createState() => _ImagePickerFormFieldState();
}

class _ImagePickerFormFieldState extends State<ImagePickerFormField> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  String? _imagePath;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  late AnimationController _animationController;
  late Animation<double> _scaleAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _imagePath = widget.initialValue;

    // Setup animations
    _animationController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
    );

    _scaleAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 1.0, end: 1.05).animate(CurvedAnimation(parent: _animationController, curve: Curves.easeInOut));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _animationController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final primaryColor = theme.primaryColor;
    final secondaryColor = theme.colorScheme.secondary;

    return FormField<String>(
      initialValue: _imagePath,
      validator: widget.validator,
      onSaved: widget.onSaved,
      builder: (FormFieldState<String> field) {
        return Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              widget.labelText,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Colors.black, // Replace with textDark
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              ),
              textAlign: TextAlign.left,
            ),
            AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
              margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                boxShadow: [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: field.hasError ? Colors.red.withOpacity(0.2) : primaryColor.withOpacity(0.1),
                    blurRadius: 12,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                  ),
                ],
                border: Border.all(
                  color: field.hasError
                      ? Colors.red.withOpacity(0.5)
                      : _imagePath != null && _imagePath!.isNotEmpty
                          ? primaryColor
                          : Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.3),
                  width: 1.5,
                ),
              ),
              child: ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    // Label with gradient background
                    Container(

                            Icons.photo_camera,
                            color: Colors.white,
                            size: 20,

                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            widget.labelText,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Colors.white,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              fontSize: 16,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),

                    // Image preview section
                    if (_imagePath != null && _imagePath!.isNotEmpty)
                      MouseRegion(

                          scale: _scaleAnimation,

                            children: [
                              Container(
                                height: 200,

                                  color: Colors.grey[200],
                                ),

                                    File(_imagePath!),
                                    fit: BoxFit.cover,

                              ),

                                child: Container(

                                        Colors.transparent,

                                      stops: [0.7, 1.0],
                                    ),

                                        color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.3),

                                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                        color: primaryColor.withOpacity(0.4),
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(25),
                                        border: Border.all(
                                          color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.2),
                                          width: 1,
                                        ),
                                      ),

                                        onTap: () => _pickImage(field),
                                        child: const Row(

                                          children: [

                                              color: Colors.white,

                      Container(

                    // Error message
                    if (field.hasError)
                      Container(

                            Text(
                              field.errorText!,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.red[700],
                                fontSize: 13,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildUploadArea(FormFieldState<String> field, Color primaryColor) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => _pickImage(field),
      child: Container(
        height: 140,
        width: double.infinity,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.grey[100],
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          border: Border.all(
            color: primaryColor.withOpacity(0.3),
            width: 2,
            style: BorderStyle.solid,
          ),
        ),
        child: DashedBorder(
          color: primaryColor.withOpacity(0.5),
          strokeWidth: 2,
          gap: 6,
          radius: const Radius.circular(14),
          child: Center(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: primaryColor.withOpacity(0.1),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.add_photo_alternate_rounded,
                    color: primaryColor,
                    size: 36,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Text(
                  'Tap to upload image',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: primaryColor,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    fontSize: 16,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLoadingIndicator(Color primaryColor) {
    return Container(
      height: 140,
      width: double.infinity,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.grey[100],
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      ),
      child: Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            SizedBox(
              width: 50,
              height: 50,
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(primaryColor),
                strokeWidth: 3,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
              'Uploading image...',
              style: TextStyle(
                color: primaryColor,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _pickImage(FormFieldState<String> field) {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
    });

    widget.uploadPhoto(context, (File file) {
      setState(() {
        _imagePath = file.path;
        _isLoading = false;
      });

      field.didChange(file.path);
      widget.onChanged(file.path);
    });
  }
}

// Custom dashed border painter
class DashedBorder extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final Color color;
  final double strokeWidth;
  final double gap;
  final Radius radius;

  const DashedBorder({
    Key? key,
    required this.child,
    required this.color,
    this.strokeWidth = 1.0,
    this.gap = 5.0,
    this.radius = const Radius.circular(0),
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CustomPaint(
      painter: _DashedBorderPainter(
        color: color,
        strokeWidth: strokeWidth,
        gap: gap,
        radius: radius,
      ),
      child: ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(radius),
        child: child,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _DashedBorderPainter extends CustomPainter {
  final Color color;
  final double strokeWidth;
  final double gap;
  final Radius radius;

  _DashedBorderPainter({
    required this.color,
    required this.strokeWidth,
    required this.gap,
    required this.radius,
  });

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Paint paint = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..strokeWidth = strokeWidth
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke;

    final Path path = Path()
      ..addRRect(RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
        Rect.fromLTWH(0, 0, size.width, size.height),
        radius,
      ));

    final Path dashPath = Path();

    double dashLength = 8.0;
    double currentDistance = 0;

    for (PathMetric pathMetric in path.computeMetrics()) {
      while (currentDistance < pathMetric.length) {
        dashPath.addPath(
          pathMetric.extractPath(currentDistance, currentDistance + dashLength),
          Offset.zero,
        );
        currentDistance += dashLength + gap;
      }
    }

    canvas.drawPath(dashPath, paint);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_DashedBorderPainter oldDelegate) {
    return oldDelegate.color != color || oldDelegate.strokeWidth != strokeWidth || oldDelegate.gap != gap || oldDelegate.radius != radius;
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/test/multi-step-form.dart ===== */
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/widget_extensions.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/test/form-indicator.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/test/form-type.dart';

class MultiStepFormManager extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<FormConfiguration> formConfigurations;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> initialData;
  final Function(List<Map<String, dynamic>>) onSubmit;
  final Widget? Function(BuildContext, int, int)? customProgressIndicator;

  const MultiStepFormManager({
    Key? key,
    required this.formConfigurations,
    this.initialData = const [],
    required this.onSubmit,
    this.customProgressIndicator,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _MultiStepFormManagerState createState() => _MultiStepFormManagerState();
}

class _MultiStepFormManagerState extends State<MultiStepFormManager> {
  late PageController _pageController;
  late List<GlobalKey<FormState>> _formKeys;
  late List<Map<String, dynamic>> _formData;
  int _currentStep = 0;

  // Get step titles from the configurations
  List<String> get _stepTitles => widget.formConfigurations.map((config) => config.title).toList();

  // Add a dependency graph to track which fields depend on other fields
  final Map<String, List<String>> _fieldDependencyGraph = {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _pageController = PageController();

    // Initialize form data with prefilled values if available
    _formData = List.from(widget.initialData);

    // If no initial data or not enough for all steps, pad with empty maps
    while (_formData.length < widget.formConfigurations.length) {
      _formData.add({});
    }

    // Create a form key for each step
    _formKeys = List.generate(
      widget.formConfigurations.length,
      (_) => GlobalKey<FormState>(),
    );

    // Build the dependency graph
    _buildDependencyGraph();
  }

  // This method builds a graph of field dependencies
  void _buildDependencyGraph() {
    // Clear existing dependencies
    _fieldDependencyGraph.clear();

    // Loop through all form configurations and fields
    for (var stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < widget.formConfigurations.length; stepIndex++) {
      final config = widget.formConfigurations[stepIndex];

      for (var field in config.fields) {
        // If the field has dependencies, add them to the graph
        if (field.dependencies != null && field.dependencies!.isNotEmpty) {
          for (var dependency in field.dependencies!) {
            // Add the dependent field to the list of dependents for the source field
            if (!_fieldDependencyGraph.containsKey(dependency)) {
              _fieldDependencyGraph[dependency] = [];
            }
            _fieldDependencyGraph[dependency]!.add('${stepIndex}_${field.name}');
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Update dependent fields when a source field changes
  void _updateDependentFields(int stepIndex, String fieldName, dynamic value) {
    // Check if this field has any dependents
    final key = '$stepIndex\_$fieldName';
    if (_fieldDependencyGraph.containsKey(key)) {
      // For each dependent field
      for (var dependentKey in _fieldDependencyGraph[key]!) {
        // Parse the step index and field name from the dependent key
        final parts = dependentKey.split('_');
        final depStepIndex = int.parse(parts[0]);
        final depFieldName = parts[1];

        // Find the field config for the dependent field
        final depConfig = widget.formConfigurations[depStepIndex];
        final depFieldConfig = depConfig.fields.firstWhere((f) => f.name == depFieldName, orElse: () => throw Exception('Dependent field not found: $depFieldName'));

        // If the field has a calculator function, use it to update the value
        if (depFieldConfig.calculator != null) {
          // Get current form data as a flat map
          final flatData = _getFlatFormData();

          // Calculate the new value
          final newValue = depFieldConfig.calculator!(flatData);

          // Update the form data
          setState(() {
            _formData[depStepIndex][depFieldName] = newValue;
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Helper method to get a flat map of all form data
  Map<String, dynamic> _getFlatFormData() {
    final result = <String, dynamic>{};

    for (var stepIndex = 0; stepIndex < _formData.length; stepIndex++) {
      for (var entry in _formData[stepIndex].entries) {
        // Use stepIndex_fieldName as the key to ensure uniqueness
        result['$stepIndex\_${entry.key}'] = entry.value;
        // Also add just the field name for easier access
        result[entry.key] = entry.value;
      }
    }

    return result;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _nextStep() {
    if (_currentStep < widget.formConfigurations.length - 1) {
      // Validate current form before proceeding
      if (_formKeys[_currentStep].currentState?.validate() ?? false) {
        // Save current form data
        _formKeys[_currentStep].currentState?.save();

        // Move to next step
        setState(() {
          _currentStep++;
        });
        _pageController.animateToPage(
          _currentStep,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
          curve: Curves.easeInOut,
        );
      }
    } else {
      // On final step, validate and submit
      if (_formKeys[_currentStep].currentState?.validate() ?? false) {
        _formKeys[_currentStep].currentState?.save();
        widget.onSubmit(_formData);
      }
    }
  }

  void _previousStep() {
    if (_currentStep > 0) {
      // Save current form data even when going back
      _formKeys[_currentStep].currentState?.save();

      setState(() {
        _currentStep--;
      });
      _pageController.animateToPage(
        _currentStep,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        curve: Curves.easeInOut,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        45.sbH,
        // Step indicator - either use custom or default modern one
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8.0),
          child: widget.customProgressIndicator != null
              ? widget.customProgressIndicator!(context, _currentStep, widget.formConfigurations.length)
              : FormStepper(
                  currentStep: _currentStep,
                  totalSteps: widget.formConfigurations.length,
                  stepTitles: _stepTitles,
                ),
        ),

        // Form pages
        Expanded(
          child: PageView.builder(
              controller: _pageController,
              physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(), // Disable swiping
              itemCount: widget.formConfigurations.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                return LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, constraints) {
                  return SingleChildScrollView(
                    physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                    child: ConstrainedBox(
                      constraints: BoxConstraints(
                        minHeight: constraints.maxHeight,
                      ),
                      child: IntrinsicHeight(
                        child: DynamicForm(
                          formKey: _formKeys[index],
                          configuration: widget.formConfigurations[index],
                          initialData: _formData[index],
                          onSaved: (data) {
                            setState(() {
                              _formData[index] = data;
                            });
                          },
                          onFieldChanged: (name, value) {
                            // Update the form data
                            setState(() {
                              _formData[index][name] = value;
                            });

                            // Update dependent fields
                            _updateDependentFields(index, name, value);
                          },
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                });
              }),
        ),

        // Navigation buttons
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12.0),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              if (_currentStep > 0)
                ElevatedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: _previousStep,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded),
                  label: const Text('Back'),
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    foregroundColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                    backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                    elevation: 2,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 12),
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
                      side: BorderSide(color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor),
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              else
                const SizedBox(width: 40),
              ElevatedButton.icon(
                onPressed: _nextStep,
                icon: Text(_currentStep < widget.formConfigurations.length - 1 ? 'Next' : 'Submit'),
                label: Icon(_currentStep < widget.formConfigurations.length - 1 ? Icons.arrow_forward_rounded : Icons.check_rounded),
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  elevation: 3,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 12),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// Base constants for consistent styling
class ModernFormStyles {
  // Colors - can be customized based on your theme
  static Color primaryColor(BuildContext context) => Theme.of(context).primaryColor;
  static Color secondaryColor(BuildContext context) => Theme.of(context).colorScheme.secondary;
  static Color errorColor(BuildContext context) => Colors.red.shade700;

  // Dimensions
  static const double borderRadius = 12.0;
  static const double fieldHeight = 60.0;
  static const double contentPadding = 16.0;
  static const double iconSize = 20.0;

  // Text Styles
  static TextStyle labelStyle = const TextStyle(
    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
    fontSize: 14,
  );

  static TextStyle inputStyle = const TextStyle(
    fontSize: 14,
    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
  );

  static TextStyle placeholderStyle = TextStyle(
    fontSize: 14,
    color: Colors.grey.shade600,
    fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
  );

  // Decoration
  static InputDecoration getDecoration(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String label,
    String? errorText,
    Widget? prefixIcon,
    Widget? suffixIcon,
    String? prefixText,
  }) {
    return InputDecoration(
      labelText: label,
      labelStyle: labelStyle.copyWith(color: primaryColor(context)),
      errorText: errorText,
      prefixIcon: prefixIcon,
      prefixText: prefixText,
      suffixIcon: suffixIcon,
      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: contentPadding,
        vertical: contentPadding,
      ),
      filled: true,
      fillColor: Colors.grey.shade50,
      border: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
        borderSide: BorderSide(
          color: Colors.grey.shade300,
          width: 1,
        ),
      ),
      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
        borderSide: BorderSide(
          color: Colors.grey.shade300,
          width: 1,
        ),
      ),
      focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
        borderSide: BorderSide(
          color: primaryColor(context),
          width: 2,
        ),
      ),
      errorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
        borderSide: BorderSide(
          color: errorColor(context),
          width: 1,
        ),
      ),
      focusedErrorBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
        borderSide: BorderSide(
          color: errorColor(context),
          width: 2,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// 1. Modern Text Field
class ModernTextField extends StatelessWidget {
  final String labelText;
  final String? initialValue;
  final FormFieldValidator<String>? validator;
  final ValueChanged<String>? onChanged;
  final FormFieldSetter<String>? onSaved;
  final TextInputType keyboardType;
  final List<TextInputFormatter>? inputFormatters;
  final bool obscureText;
  final IconData? prefixIcon;
  final Widget? suffixIcon;
  final String? placeholder;
  final bool readOnly;

  const ModernTextField({
    Key? key,
    required this.labelText,
    this.initialValue,
    this.validator,
    this.onChanged,
    this.onSaved,
    this.keyboardType = TextInputType.text,
    this.inputFormatters,
    this.obscureText = false,
    this.prefixIcon,
    this.suffixIcon,
    this.placeholder,
    this.readOnly = false,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      // height: ModernFormStyles.fieldHeight + (validator != null ? 24 : 0),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            labelText,
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: Colors.black, // Replace with textDark
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
            ),
            textAlign: TextAlign.left,
          ),
          8.sbH,
          TextFormField(
            initialValue: initialValue,
            decoration: ModernFormStyles.getDecoration(
              context,
              label: "",
              prefixIcon: prefixIcon != null
                  ? Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                      child: Icon(
                        prefixIcon,
                        color: ModernFormStyles.primaryColor(context),
                        size: ModernFormStyles.iconSize,
                      ),
                    )
                  : null,
              suffixIcon: suffixIcon,
            ).copyWith(
              hintText: placeholder,
              hintStyle: ModernFormStyles.placeholderStyle,
            ),
            style: ModernFormStyles.inputStyle,
            keyboardType: keyboardType,
            inputFormatters: inputFormatters,
            obscureText: obscureText,
            validator: validator,
            onSaved: onSaved,
            onChanged: onChanged,
            readOnly: readOnly,
            enabled: !readOnly,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class ModernDatePickerField extends StatefulWidget {
  final String labelText;
  final String initialValue;
  final FormFieldValidator<String>? validator;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final FormFieldSetter<String> onSaved;
  final DateTime? firstDate;
  final DateTime? lastDate;
  final String? placeholder;

  const ModernDatePickerField({
    Key? key,
    required this.labelText,
    this.initialValue = '',
    this.validator,
    required this.onChanged,
    required this.onSaved,
    this.firstDate,
    this.lastDate,
    this.placeholder,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _ModernDatePickerFieldState createState() => _ModernDatePickerFieldState();
}

class _ModernDatePickerFieldState extends State<ModernDatePickerField> {
  late TextEditingController _controller;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = TextEditingController(text: widget.initialValue);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(ModernDatePickerField oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (widget.initialValue != oldWidget.initialValue && widget.initialValue != _controller.text) {
      _controller.text = widget.initialValue;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      height: ModernFormStyles.fieldHeight + (widget.validator != null ? 25 : 28),
      child: FormField<String>(
        initialValue: widget.initialValue,
        validator: widget.validator,
        onSaved: (_) => widget.onSaved(_controller.text),
        builder: (FormFieldState<String> field) {
          return Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                widget.labelText,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.black, // Replace with textDark
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                ),
                textAlign: TextAlign.left,
              ),
              8.sbH,
              InkWell(
                onTap: () => _showDatePicker(context, field),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(ModernFormStyles.borderRadius),
                child: Container(
                  height: ModernFormStyles.fieldHeight,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.grey.shade50,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(ModernFormStyles.borderRadius),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: field.hasError
                          ? ModernFormStyles.errorColor(context)
                          : field.hasInteractedByUser
                              ? ModernFormStyles.primaryColor(context)
                              : Colors.grey.shade300,
                      width: field.hasInteractedByUser || field.hasError ? 2 : 1,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      // Icon on the left
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12.0),
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.calendar_today_rounded,
                          color: ModernFormStyles.primaryColor(context),
                          size: ModernFormStyles.iconSize,
                        ),
                      ),

                      // Center text section
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            // Label
                            // Text(
                            //   widget.labelText,
                            //   style: ModernFormStyles.labelStyle.copyWith(
                            //     color: ModernFormStyles.primaryColor(context),
                            //     fontSize: 12,
                            //   ),
                            // ),

                            // Date value or placeholder
                            Text(
                              _controller.text.isEmpty ? (widget.placeholder ?? 'Select a date') : _controller.text,
                              style: _controller.text.isEmpty ? ModernFormStyles.placeholderStyle : ModernFormStyles.inputStyle,
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),

                      // Arrow icon on the right
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12.0),
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.keyboard_arrow_down_rounded,
                          color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _showDatePicker(BuildContext context, FormFieldState<String> field) async {
    // Close keyboard if open
    FocusScope.of(context).requestFocus(FocusNode());

    // Set initial date from current value or default to today
    DateTime? initialDate;
    if (_controller.text.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        initialDate = DateFormat('MM/dd/yyyy').parse(_controller.text);
      } catch (e) {
        initialDate = DateTime.now();
      }
    } else {
      initialDate = DateTime.now();
    }

    // Show date picker with modern theme
    final date = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: initialDate,
      firstDate: widget.firstDate ?? DateTime(1900),
      lastDate: widget.lastDate ?? DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365 * 10)),
      builder: (context, child) {
        return Theme(
          data: Theme.of(context).copyWith(
            colorScheme: ColorScheme.light(
              primary: ModernFormStyles.primaryColor(context),
              onPrimary: Colors.white,
              onSurface: Colors.black,
            ),
            textButtonTheme: TextButtonThemeData(
              style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                foregroundColor: ModernFormStyles.primaryColor(context),
              ),
            ),
            datePickerTheme: DatePickerThemeData(
              backgroundColor: Colors.white,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(ModernFormStyles.borderRadius),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          child: child!,
        );
      },
    );

    // Update if date was selected
    if (date != null) {
      final formattedDate = DateFormat('MM/dd/yyyy').format(date);
      setState(() {
        _controller.text = formattedDate;
      });

      // Notify the form
      field.didChange(formattedDate);
      widget.onChanged(formattedDate);
    }
  }
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/transaction-pin.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/palette.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/utils/widget_extensions.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/number-pad.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/widgets/pin-input.dart';

class PinScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final Function(String) onDone;
  const PinScreen({super.key, required this.onDone});

  @override
  _PinScreenState createState() => _PinScreenState();
}

class _PinScreenState extends State<PinScreen> {
  List<String> pin = ["", "", "", ""]; // Holds the entered PIN

  void _updatePin(String value) {
    setState(() {
      for (int i = 0; i < pin.length; i++) {
        if (pin[i].isEmpty) {
          pin[i] = value;
          break;
        }
      }
    });
    widget.onDone(pin.join(""));
  }

  void _deletePin() {
    setState(() {
      for (int i = pin.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (pin[i].isNotEmpty) {
          pin[i] = "";
          break;
        }
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: AppColors.white,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            // Header Section
            Column(
              children: [
                Align(
                  alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                  child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 24),
                      child: GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                        child: Icon(
                          Icons.close,
                          color: primaryDarkColor,
                        ),
                      )),
                ),
                Icon(Icons.shield, size: 64, color: primaryLight),
                const SizedBox(height: 20),
                Text(
                  "Enter your PIN",
                  style: TextStyle(color: primaryDarkColor, fontSize: 24, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Text(
                  "To proceed please, enter your PIN",
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(color: primaryDarkColor, fontSize: 14),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 40),

            // PIN Input Section
            PinInputWidget(pin: pin),
            40.sbH,

            // Custom Number Pad
            CustomNumberPad(
              onNumberPressed: _updatePin,
              onDeletePressed: _deletePin,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

showTransactionPinBottomSheet(BuildContext context, Function(String) onDone) {
  showModalBottomSheet(
      enableDrag: true,
      isDismissible: true,
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.white,
      builder: (context) {
        return PinScreen(
          onDone: (v) => onDone(v),
        );
      });
}

/* ===== lib/src/widgets/unavailable-component.dart ===== */
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/constant/palette.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

class ComponentAccessDeniedScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  final String componentName;
  final String subComponentName;
  final VoidCallback? onContactSupport;
  final VoidCallback? onBackToDashboard;
  final String? supportEmail;
  final String? supportUrl;

  const ComponentAccessDeniedScreen({
    Key? key,
    required this.componentName,
    required this.subComponentName,
    this.onContactSupport,
    this.onBackToDashboard,
    this.supportEmail,
    this.supportUrl,
  }) : super(key: key);

  Future<void> _launchSupport() async {
    if (supportUrl != null) {
      final Uri url = Uri.parse(supportUrl!);
      if (await canLaunchUrl(url)) {
        await launchUrl(url);
      }
    } else if (supportEmail != null) {
      final Uri emailUri = Uri(
        scheme: 'mailto',
        path: supportEmail!,
        query: 'subject=Component Access Request - $componentName',
      );
      if (await canLaunchUrl(emailUri)) {
        await launchUrl(emailUri);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.white,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24.0),
          child: Column(
            children: [
              // Header
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
                child: IconButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),

              ),

              const Spacer(flex: 2),

              // Access Denied Icon with gradient background

                width: 120,

                  gradient: const LinearGradient(
                    colors: [
                      Color(0xff2B7C44),
                      Color(0xff2B7C44),
                    ],
                    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                  ),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(60),
                ),
                child: const Icon(
                  Icons.insert_page_break_outlined,
                  size: 60,
                  color: Colors.white,
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 32),

              // Access Denied Title
              const Text(
                'Please, you are not eligible to access this resource now.',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 22,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: Colors.black87,
                ),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              // Component Info Section
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.grey[50],
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey[200]!),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'Requested Component',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: Colors.grey[600],
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      componentName,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        color: Colors.black87,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (subComponentName.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Text(
                        'Sub-component',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          color: Colors.grey[600],
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        subComponentName,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                          color: Colors.black87,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              // Support Contact Link
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: () async {
                  if (onContactSupport != null) {
                    onContactSupport!();
                  } else {
                    await _launchSupport();
                  }
                },
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: greenDark.withOpacity(0.1),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    border: Border.all(color: greenDark.withOpacity(0.1)),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.support_agent,
                        size: 16,
                        color: greenDark.withOpacity(0.6),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Text(
                        'Contact support for quicker assistance',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 14,
                          color: greenDark.withOpacity(0.6),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                          decoration: TextDecoration.underline,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              const Spacer(flex: 3),

              // Buttons
              Column(
                children: [
                  // Primary Button - Contact Support
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    height: 52,
                    child: ElevatedButton(
                      onPressed: () async {
                        if (onContactSupport != null) {
                          onContactSupport!();
                        } else {
                          await _launchSupport();
                        }
                      },
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: primaryColor,
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(32),
                        ),
                        elevation: 0,
                      ),
                      child: const Text(
                        'Contact Support',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),

                  const SizedBox(height: 12),

                  // Secondary Button - Back to Dashboard
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    height: 52,
                    child: OutlinedButton(
                      onPressed: onBackToDashboard ?? () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: Colors.black87,
                        side: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey[300]!),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(32),
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: const Text(
                        'Back to Dashboard',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 24),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// Alternative version with different icon options
class ComponentAccessDeniedScreenAlt extends StatelessWidget {
  final String componentName;
  final String subComponentName;
  final VoidCallback? onContactSupport;
  final VoidCallback? onBackToDashboard;
  final AccessDeniedIconType iconType;

  const ComponentAccessDeniedScreenAlt({
    Key? key,
    required this.componentName,
    required this.subComponentName,
    this.onContactSupport,
    this.onBackToDashboard,
    this.iconType = AccessDeniedIconType.lock,
  }) : super(key: key);

  IconData _getIcon() {
    switch (iconType) {
      case AccessDeniedIconType.lock:
        return Icons.lock_outline;
      case AccessDeniedIconType.warning:
        return Icons.warning_amber_outlined;
      case AccessDeniedIconType.block:
        return Icons.block_outlined;
      case AccessDeniedIconType.error:
        return Icons.error_outline;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ComponentAccessDeniedScreen(
      componentName: componentName,
      subComponentName: subComponentName,
      onContactSupport: onContactSupport,
      onBackToDashboard: onBackToDashboard,
    );
  }
}

enum AccessDeniedIconType {
  lock,
  warning,
  block,
  error,
}

                  fontSize: 16,

                'Last updated: ${current.lastUpdated}',

                  fontSize: 14,
                  color: AppTheme.textSecondary,

              const SizedBox(height: 30),

              // Main Weather Card

                width: double.infinity,

  Widget _buildWeatherInfoItem(IconData icon, String value, String label) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Icon(
          icon,
          color: Colors.white70,
          size: 24,

        Text(

          style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 14,
            color: Colors.white70,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInfoCard(List<Widget> children) {
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: AppTheme.cardBackground,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.1),
            blurRadius: 10,
            offset: const Offset(0, 5),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: children,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDetailRow(String label, String value, IconData icon) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8.0),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Icon(
            icon,
            size: 20,
            color: AppTheme.primary,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Text(
            label,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
            ),
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          Text(
            value,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: AppTheme.textPrimary,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildGridCard(String title, String value, IconData icon) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.1),
            blurRadius: 10,
            offset: const Offset(0, 5),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text(
                title,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 14,
                  color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
                ),
              ),
              Icon(
                icon,
                size: 20,
                color: AppTheme.primary,
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          Text(
            value,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 20,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              color: AppTheme.textPrimary,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

  final VoidCallback? onTap;

    Key? key,
    required this.weatherData,
    this.onTap,

    final current = weatherData?.current;
    final location = weatherData?.location;

      return const SizedBox.shrink();

    final String iconUrl = 'https:${current.condition?.icon ?? '//cdn.weatherapi.com/weather/64x64/day/113.png'}';

                  minimumSize: Size.zero,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                  tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildWeatherDataPoint(IconData icon, String label, String value) {
    return Expanded(
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Icon(
            icon,
            size: 16,
            color: AppTheme.primary,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
          Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                label,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                value,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: AppTheme.textPrimary,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class WeatherCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final WeatherRes? weatherData;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  const WeatherCard({
    Key? key,
    required this.weatherData,
    this.onTap,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final current = weatherData?.current;
    final location = weatherData?.location;

    if (current == null || location == null) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final String iconUrl = 'https:${current.condition?.icon ?? '//cdn.weatherapi.com/weather/64x64/day/113.png'}';

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        if (onTap != null) {
          onTap!();
        } else {
          Navigator.push(
            context,
            MaterialPageRoute(
              builder: (context) => WeatherDetailView(weatherData: weatherData),
            ),
          );
        }
      },
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.1),
              blurRadius: 10,
              offset: const Offset(0, 3),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // Top row with location and temperature
            Row(
              children: [
                // Location info
                Expanded(
                  flex: 2,
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        location.name ?? 'Unknown location',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: AppTheme.textPrimary,
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        location.country ?? '',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),

                // Temperature
                Expanded(
                  flex: 1,
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        '${current.tempC?.toStringAsFixed(1)}°C',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 20,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: AppTheme.textPrimary,
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        '${current.tempF?.toStringAsFixed(1)}°F',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // Bottom row with condition and metrics
            Row(
              children: [
                // Weather icon and condition
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: const Color(0xFFE9F7EF),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: Image.network(
                        iconUrl,
                        width: 28,
                        height: 28,
                        errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => const Icon(
                          Icons.cloud,
                          size: 28,
                          color: AppTheme.primary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Text(
                      current.condition?.text ?? 'Unknown',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: AppTheme.textPrimary, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),

                // Quick metrics
                Expanded(
                  // flex: 2,
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
                    children: [
                      _buildCompactMetric(Icons.water_drop, '${current.humidity}%'),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      _buildCompactMetric(Icons.air, '${current.windKph} km/h'),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 4),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: AppTheme.primary,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)
                        ),
                        child: const Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            Icon(
                              Icons.arrow_forward,
                              size: 14,
                              color: Colors.white,
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCompactMetric(IconData icon, String value) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Icon(
          icon,
          size: 14,
          color: AppTheme.primary,
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 4),
        Text(
          value,
          style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
