import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_template/src/model/weather-response.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class WeatherDetailView extends StatelessWidget {
  final WeatherRes? weatherData;

  const WeatherDetailView({
    Key? key,
    required this.weatherData,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final current = weatherData?.current;
    final location = weatherData?.location;

    if (current == null || location == null) {
      return const Center(child: Text('Weather data is not available'));
    }

    // Format the local time properly
    final DateTime localTime = DateTime.parse(location.localtime?.replaceAll(' ', 'T') ?? DateTime.now().toIso8601String());
    final String formattedDate = DateFormat('EEEE, MMMM d').format(localTime);
    final String formattedTime = DateFormat('h:mm a').format(localTime);

    // Weather condition icon
    final String iconUrl = 'https:${current.condition?.icon ?? '//cdn.weatherapi.com/weather/64x64/day/113.png'}';

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.blueGrey[50],
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios, color: Colors.black87),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.more_vert, color: Colors.black87),
            onPressed: () {},
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20.0),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              // Location and Date Section
              Text(
                '${location.name}, ${location.country}',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 28,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Colors.blueGrey[800],
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                formattedDate,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 16,
                  color: Colors.blueGrey[600],
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                'Last updated: ${current.lastUpdated}',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 14,
                  color: Colors.blueGrey[400],
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 30),

              // Main Weather Card
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                    colors: [
                      Colors.blue[400]!,
                      Colors.blue[800]!,
                    ],
                  ),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  boxShadow: [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: Colors.blue.withOpacity(0.3),
                      blurRadius: 15,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 10),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              '${current.tempC?.toStringAsFixed(1)}°C',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 48,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: Colors.white,
                              ),
                            ),
                            Text(
                              'Feels like ${current.feelslikeC?.toStringAsFixed(1)}°C',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 16,
                                color: Colors.white70,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        Column(
                          children: [
                            Image.network(
                              iconUrl,
                              width: 80,
                              height: 80,
                              errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => const Icon(
                                Icons.cloud,
                                size: 80,
                                color: Colors.white,
                              ),
                            ),
                            Text(
                              current.condition?.text ?? 'Unknown',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 16,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                                color: Colors.white,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                    Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        _buildWeatherInfoItem(
                          Icons.water_drop,
                          '${current.humidity}%',
                          'Humidity',
                        ),
                        _buildWeatherInfoItem(
                          Icons.air,
                          '${current.windKph} km/h',
                          'Wind',
                        ),
                        _buildWeatherInfoItem(
                          Icons.compress,
                          '${current.pressureMb} mb',
                          'Pressure',
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 30),

              // Weather Details Section
              Text(
                'Weather Details',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 18,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: Colors.blueGrey[800],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 15),
              _buildDetailCard([

              Text(

              _buildDetailCard([

                _buildDetailRow('Wind Gust', '${current.gustKph} km/h', Icons.speed),
              ]),

              const SizedBox(height: 30),

              // Location details
              Text(
                'Location Details',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 18,

                  color: Colors.blueGrey[800],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 15),
              Container(

                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  boxShadow: [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.1),
                      blurRadius: 10,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 5),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Container(
                          width: 60,
                          height: 60,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.amber[100],
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
                          ),
                          child: Icon(
                            Icons.location_on,

                            color: Colors.amber[700],
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 15),
                        Expanded(

                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                location.name ?? 'Unknown Location',
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 18,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                              ),
                              Text(
                                '${location.region}, ${location.country}',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 14,
                                  color: Colors.grey[600],
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 5),
                              Row(
                                children: [

                                  const SizedBox(width: 5),
                                  Text(
                                    'Local Time: $formattedTime',

                            current.isDay == 1 ? Icons.wb_sunny : Icons.nightlight_round,

              const SizedBox(height: 30),

  Widget _buildWeatherInfoItem(IconData icon, String value, String label) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Icon(
          icon,
          color: Colors.white70,
          size: 24,
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(
          value,
          style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
            color: Colors.white,
          ),
        ),
        Text(
          label,
          style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 14,
            color: Colors.white70,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDetailCard(List<Widget> children) {
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.1),
            blurRadius: 10,
            offset: const Offset(0, 5),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: children,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDetailRow(String label, String value, IconData icon) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8.0),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Icon(
            icon,
            size: 20,
            color: Colors.blue[700],
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.normal,
              color: Colors.grey[700],
            ),
          ),
          const Spacer(),
          Text(
            value,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: Colors.blueGrey[800],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLocationDetailItem(String label, String value, IconData icon) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.grey[50],
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Icon(
                icon,
                size: 16,
                color: Colors.blue[700],
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 5),
              Text(
                label,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color: Colors.grey[600],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 5),
          Text(
            value,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: Colors.blueGrey[800],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class WeatherCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final WeatherRes? weatherData;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  const WeatherCard({
    Key? key,
    required this.weatherData,

  }) : super(key: key);

  @override

    final current = weatherData?.current;
    final location = weatherData?.location;

      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final String iconUrl = 'https:${current.condition?.icon ?? '//cdn.weatherapi.com/weather/64x64/day/113.png'}';

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        if (onTap != null) {
          onTap!();

                      Icons.air,
                      size: 16,
                      color: Colors.white70,
                    ),

class WeatherCardShimmer extends StatelessWidget {
  const WeatherCardShimmer({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(

      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20.0),
      child: Shimmer.fromColors(
        baseColor: Colors.grey[300]!,
        highlightColor: Colors.grey[100]!,
        child: Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // Weather icon placeholder
            Container(
              width: 60,
              height: 60,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8.0),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 16),
            // Weather text information
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  // Location text
                  Container(
                    width: 100,
                    height: 14,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  // City name
                  Container(
                    width: 80,
                    height: 20,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  // Temperature
                  Container(
                    width: 120,
                    height: 16,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            // Weather data on the right
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                children: [
                  // Precipitation
                  Container(
                    width: 150,
                    height: 14,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  // Humidity
                  Container(
                    width: 150,
                    height: 14,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  // Wind
                  Container(
                    width: 150,
                    height: 14,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class ActualWeatherCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final WeatherRes? data;
  const ActualWeatherCard({super.key, this.data});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: const Color(0xFFEAF6E8), // Primary light color from your image
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      ),
      margin: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Container(
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                // Weather Icon on the left

                SvgPicture.asset(
                  'weather'.svg,
                  height: 50,
                  width: 50,
                ),
                30.sbW,
                // Middle column for location and temperature
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    const Text(
                      "Location",
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.black54,
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                    4.sbH,
                    Text(
                      data?.location?.name ?? "",
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.black87,
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      "${data?.current?.tempC} °C | ${data?.current?.tempF} °F",
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.black54,
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const Spacer(),

                // Right column for weather details
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      "Precipitation: ${data?.current?.precipMm}%",
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.black54,
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                      ),
                    ),
                    4.sbH,
                    Text(
                      "Humidity: ${data?.current?.humidity}%",
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.black54,
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      "Wind: ${data?.current?.windKph} km/h",
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.black54,
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          8.sbH,
          Align(
              alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
              child: Text(
                " updated at: ${DateTime.parse((data?.current?.lastUpdated ?? DateTime.now().toString()).toString()).formattedCustom}",
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.sp, color: Colors.grey),
              ))
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
